        let allLinks = [];

        async function fetchLinks() {
            const res = await fetch('api.php?action=read');
            allLinks = await res.json();
            renderLinks(allLinks);
        }

        function renderLinks(data) {
            const container = document.getElementById('linkList');
            container.innerHTML = data.map(item => `
                <div class="glass-card p-4 flex items-center justify-between group">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4 cursor-pointer" onclick="window.open('${item.url}', '_blank')">
                        <div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-blue-900/30 flex items-center justify-center text-blue-400">
                            <i class="fas fa-code text-xl"></i>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="font-bold text-white">${item.title}</div>
                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-500">${item.url.replace('https://','')}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex gap-3">
                        <button onclick="openModal('edit', ${item.id}, '${item.title}', '${item.url}')" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-white"><i class="fas fa-pencil-alt"></i></button>
                        <button onclick="deleteLink(${item.id})" class="text-red-900 group-hover:text-red-500"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
                        <i class="fas fa-chevron-right text-gray-600 ml-2"></i>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        // 搜尋功能
        document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            const val = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
            const filtered = allLinks.filter(l => l.title.toLowerCase().includes(val) || l.url.toLowerCase().includes(val));
            renderLinks(filtered);
        });

        // Modal 操作與 CRUD 串接 (省略部分細節，邏輯同留言系統)
        function openModal(type, id='', title='', url='') {
            document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('flex');
            document.getElementById('editId').value = id;
            document.getElementById('linkTitle').value = title;
            document.getElementById('linkUrl').value = url;
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').innerText = id ? '編輯連結' : '新增連結';
        }

        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('flex');
        }

        async function saveLink() {
            const id = document.getElementById('editId').value;
            const title = document.getElementById('linkTitle').value;
            const url = document.getElementById('linkUrl').value;
            const action = id ? 'update' : 'create';

            await fetch('api.php?action=' + action, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                body: `id=${id}&title=${encodeURIComponent(title)}&url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`
            });
            closeModal();
            fetchLinks();
        }

        async function deleteLink(id) {
            if(confirm('確定要刪除嗎？')) {
                await fetch('api.php?action=delete', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
                    body: `id=${id}`
                });
                fetchLinks();
            }
        }

        fetchLinks(); // 初始化載入
    </script>

--- ### 3. 後端 API (api.php) 這裡沿用你之前的 SQL Server 連線設定模式（使用 `sqlsrv` 擴展或 `PDO`）。
php
<?php
header('Content-Type: application/json');

// --- 資料庫連線設定 (請比照你之前的 message4 專案) ---
$serverName = "YOUR_SERVER_ADDRESS"; 
$connectionOptions = array(
    "Database" => "YOUR_DB_NAME",
    "Uid" => "YOUR_USERNAME",
    "PWD" => "YOUR_PASSWORD",
    "CharacterSet" => "UTF-8"
);
$conn = sqlsrv_connect($serverName, $connectionOptions);

if (!$conn) {
    die(json_encode(array("error" => "Connection failed")));
}

$action = $_GET['action'] ?? '';

switch($action) {
    case 'read':
        $sql = "SELECT * FROM Hyperlinks ORDER BY id DESC";
        $stmt = sqlsrv_query($conn, $sql);
        $data = [];
        while($row = sqlsrv_fetch_array($stmt, SQLSRV_FETCH_ASSOC)) {
            $data[] = $row;
        }
        echo json_encode($data);
        break;

    case 'create':
        $title = $_POST['title'];
        $url = $_POST['url'];
        $sql = "INSERT INTO Hyperlinks (title, url) VALUES (?, ?)";
        $params = array($title, $url);
        sqlsrv_query($conn, $sql, $params);
        echo json_encode(["status" => "success"]);
        break;

    case 'update':
        $id = $_POST['id'];
        $title = $_POST['title'];
        $url = $_POST['url'];
        $sql = "UPDATE Hyperlinks SET title = ?, url = ? WHERE id = ?";
        $params = array($title, $url, $id);
        sqlsrv_query($conn, $sql, $params);
        echo json_encode(["status" => "success"]);
        break;

    case 'delete':
        $id = $_POST['id'];
        $sql = "DELETE FROM Hyperlinks WHERE id = ?";
        $params = array($id);
        sqlsrv_query($conn, $sql, $params);
        echo json_encode(["status" => "success"]);
        break;
}

sqlsrv_close($conn);
?>

🧠 Gemini 的思考路徑：
Designing the Link System I'm currently focused on the hyperlink management system design, envisioning a CRUD structure within VB.NET, leveraging ASP.NET WebForms WebMethods for backend functionality. The mobile UI concept, featuring a dark theme and search bar, is inspiring the front-end approach. I'm drawing parallels to a previous "message4" system, optimizing code reusability. Refining the UI/UX I'm now integrating list items with icons, alongside edit/delete buttons and an "Add Link" button, ensuring full mobile responsiveness. Search, Delete, Edit, and Add actions are essential. The SQL Server interaction focuses on a `Hyperlinks` table, with columns for ID, title, URL, icon type, and creation date. The VB.NET ASPX page will define WebMethods for all CRUD operations, and I've decided to prioritize a single `GetLinks` call with search, rather than paging, for this use case. I'll utilize Tailwind CSS for the dark theme and FontAwesome for the icons.
🤖 GEMINI
沒問題！既然你的後端是使用 VB.NET ASP.NET WebForms (WebMethods) 且資料存在 SQL Server，我將為你量身打造這套程式碼。 這套代碼會沿用你 `message4` 的架構：使用 `WebMethod`、處理跨網域 (CORS) 以及相同的資料庫連線方式。 ### 1. SQL Server 資料表準備 請執行此 SQL 以建立專屬資料表：
sql
CREATE TABLE Hyperlinks (
    id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    title NVARCHAR(100),
    url NVARCHAR(500),
    icon_type NVARCHAR(50), -- 儲存像是 'fa-code', 'fa-folder' 等
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
);
--- ### 2. 後端 API (Hyperlinks.aspx.vb) 請將此邏輯放入你的專案中（檔名可自訂，例如 `Hyperlinks.aspx.vb`）。
vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

Public Class Hyperlinks
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("fromaccessdatabaseConnectionString").ConnectionString

    Protected Sub Page_Load(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles Me.Load
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        If Request.HttpMethod = "OPTIONS" Then Response.End()
    End Sub

    ' 1. 查詢功能 (包含搜尋)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetLinks(ByVal searchKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT * FROM Hyperlinks WHERE title LIKE @key OR url LIKE @key ORDER BY id DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@key", "%" & searchKey & "%")
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("id", dr("id"))
                    row.Add("title", dr("title").ToString())
                    row.Add("url", dr("url").ToString())
                    row.Add("icon", dr("icon_type").ToString())
                    rows.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 2. 新增功能
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function InsertLink(ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "INSERT INTO Hyperlinks (title, url, icon_type) VALUES (@title, @url, @icon)"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 3. 編輯功能
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function UpdateLink(ByVal id As Integer, ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "UPDATE Hyperlinks SET title=@title, url=@url, icon_type=@icon WHERE id=@id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 4. 刪除功能
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function DeleteLink(ByVal id As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM Hyperlinks WHERE id = @id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

    <script>
        const API_URL = 'Hyperlinks.aspx'; // 指向你的 VB 頁面

        async function callApi(method, data = {}) {
            const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/${method}`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(data)
            });
            const json = await res.json();

                        <i class="fas fa-chevron-right text-white/30 text-xs"></i>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function openModal(item = null) {
            document.getElementById('modal').classList.replace('hidden', 'flex');
            document.getElementById('editId').value = item ? item.id : '';
            document.getElementById('title').value = item ? item.title : '';
            document.getElementById('url').value = item ? item.url : '';
            document.getElementById('icon').value = item ? item.icon : 'fa-code';
            document.getElementById('modalTitle').innerText = item ? '編輯連結' : '新增連結';
        }

        function closeModal() {
            document.getElementById('modal').classList.replace('flex', 'hidden');
        }

        async function saveData() {
            const id = document.getElementById('editId').value;
            const data = {
                title: document.getElementById('title').value,
                url: document.getElementById('url').value,
                icon: document.getElementById('icon').value
            };

            if (id) {
                await callApi('UpdateLink', { id: parseInt(id), ...data });
            } else {
                await callApi('InsertLink', data);
            }
            closeModal();
            loadLinks();
        }

        async function deleteData(id) {
            if (confirm('確定要刪除嗎？')) {
                await callApi('DeleteLink', { id });
                loadLinks();
            }
        }

        loadLinks(); // 初始載入
    </script>
</body>
</html>

vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

Public Class Hyperlinks
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    ' 使用你原本的連線字串名稱
    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("fromaccessdatabaseConnectionString").ConnectionString

    Protected Sub Page_Load(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles Me.Load
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        If Request.HttpMethod = "OPTIONS" Then Response.End()
    End Sub

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetData(ByVal searchKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 模糊搜尋標題或網址
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT * FROM Hyperlinks WHERE (title LIKE @key OR url LIKE @key) ORDER BY id DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@key", "%" & (searchKey & "").Trim() & "%")
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("id", dr("id"))
                    row.Add("title", dr("title").ToString())
                    row.Add("url", dr("url").ToString())
                    row.Add("icon", dr("icon_type").ToString())
                    rows.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function InsertData(ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "INSERT INTO Hyperlinks (title, url, icon_type) VALUES (@title, @url, @icon)"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function UpdateData(ByVal id As Integer, ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "UPDATE Hyperlinks SET title=@title, url=@url, icon_type=@icon WHERE id=@id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function DeleteData(ByVal id As Integer, ByVal pwd As String) As Object
        ' 沿用你的密碼保護邏輯
        If pwd <> "pw123456789pw" Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "密碼錯誤！"}
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM Hyperlinks WHERE id = @id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

<body>

    <div class="app-container">
        <!-- Header -->
        <div class="text-center">
            <div class="header-icon"><i class="fas fa-sun text-white fa-2x"></i></div>
            <h4 class="fw-bold mb-1">My favorite hyperlinks</h4>
            <p class="small text-secondary px-4">透過我們為高效生產力設計的精簡工具門戶，存取多項強大資源。</p>

        <div class="search-box">
            <i class="fas fa-search text-secondary"></i>
            <input type="text" id="inputSearch" placeholder="搜尋常用的快取連結..." onkeyup="loadGrid()">
        </div>

        <!-- Links List -->
        <div id="linkContainer">
            <!-- JS 動態產生 -->
            <div class="text-center py-5 text-secondary">載入中...</div>
        </div>

        <button class="btn-add-dashed" onclick="openAddModal()">
            <i class="fas fa-plus"></i> 新增連結
        </button>

        <div class="text-center mt-4 small text-secondary">
            <i class="fas fa-external-link-alt me-1"></i> 外部連結將於新分頁開啟
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- [Modal] 新增/編輯視窗 -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="dataModal" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
            <div class="modal-content p-3">
                <div class="modal-header border-0">
                    <h5 class="modal-title fw-bold" id="modalTitle">新增連結</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <input type="hidden" id="dataId">
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label small text-secondary">連結標題</label>
                        <input type="text" id="dataTitle" class="form-control" placeholder="例如: mygithub1">
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label small text-secondary">網址 (URL)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="dataUrl" class="form-control" placeholder="https://...">
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label small text-secondary">圖示類型</label>
                        <select id="dataIcon" class="form-select">
                            <option value="fa-code">程式碼 (Code)</option>
                            <option value="fa-folder">資料夾 (Folder)</option>
                            <option value="fa-eye">眼睛 (Eye)</option>
                            <option value="fa-link">一般連結 (Link)</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer border-0">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-dark w-25" data-bs-dismiss="modal">取消</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary flex-grow-1" onclick="submitData()">儲存連結</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const SERVER_URL = "Hyperlinks.aspx"; // 指向你的 VB 頁面
        var dataModal;

        $(document).ready(function () {
            dataModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('dataModal'));
            loadGrid();
        });

        // 沿用你 message4 的呼叫方式
        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: SERVER_URL + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); },
                error: function () { Swal.fire("錯誤", "無法連線至伺服器", "error"); }
            });
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            var key = $("#inputSearch").val();
            callAPI("GetData", { searchKey: key }, function (r) {
                if (!r.success) return;
                renderLinks(r.data);
            });
        }

        function renderLinks(list) {
            var html = "";
            if (!list || list.length === 0) {
                html = "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary'>尚無連結資料</div>";
            } else {
                list.forEach(function (item, index) {
                    // 第一筆高亮 (如圖所示)
                    var highlightClass = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "") ? "highlight" : "";
                    // 簡化網址顯示
                    var displayUrl = item.url.replace("https://", "").replace("http://", "");

                    html += `
                        <div class="link-card ${highlightClass}">
                            <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center cursor-pointer" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="window.open('${item.url}', '_blank')">
                                <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                                <div class="link-info">
                                    <div class="link-title">${item.title}</div>
                                    <div class="link-url">${displayUrl}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="action-btns">
                                <button class="btn-icon" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id}, '${item.title}', '${item.url}', '${item.icon}')"><i class="fas fa-pencil-alt"></i></button>
                                <button class="btn-icon btn-delete" onclick="askDelete(${item.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
                                <i class="fas fa-chevron-right text-secondary ms-2" style="font-size:10px; opacity:0.5"></i>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                });
            }
            $("#linkContainer").html(html);
        }

        function openAddModal() {
            $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結");
            $("#dataId").val("");
            $("#dataTitle").val("");
            $("#dataUrl").val("https://");
            $("#dataIcon").val("fa-code");
            dataModal.show();
        }

        function openEditModal(id, title, url, icon) {
            $("#modalTitle").text("修改連結內容");
            $("#dataId").val(id);
            $("#dataTitle").val(title);
            $("#dataUrl").val(url);
            $("#dataIcon").val(icon);
            dataModal.show();
        }

        function submitData() {
            var id = $("#dataId").val();
            var d = { 
                title: $("#dataTitle").val(), 
                url: $("#dataUrl").val(), 
                icon: $("#dataIcon").val() 
            };

            if (!d.title || !d.url) { Swal.fire("提示", "標題與網址為必填", "warning"); return; }

            var method = id ? "UpdateData" : "InsertData";
            var params = id ? { id: parseInt(id), ...d } : d;

            callAPI(method, params, function (r) {
                if (r.success) {
                    dataModal.hide();
                    loadGrid();
                } else {
                    Swal.fire("錯誤", r.msg, "error");
                }
            });
        }

        function askDelete(id) {
            Swal.fire({
                title: '確認刪除？',
                text: "刪除後將無法還原！",
                icon: 'warning',
                input: 'password',
                inputPlaceholder: '請輸入刪除密碼',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonColor: '#d33',
                confirmButtonText: '確定刪除',
                cancelButtonText: '取消'
            }).then(res => {
                if (res.isConfirmed) {
                    callAPI("DeleteData", { id: id, pwd: res.value }, function (r) {
                        if (r.success) { loadGrid(); }
                        else { Swal.fire("錯誤", r.msg, "error"); }
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

既然你的 `GridView` 可以正常顯示，這代表 資料庫連線字串 和 SQL 語法 是沒問題的。 AJAX 報錯「無法連線至伺服器」，最常見的原因是 ASP.NET 的 WebMethod 沒有開啟 JSON 支援，或是 連線字串名稱不一致。 請按照以下三個步驟修改，保證能通： ### 步驟 1：修改 VB 後端 (Hyperlinks.aspx.vb) 請注意這兩個關鍵： 1. 類別上方必須加上 `<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()>`。 2. 連線字串名稱必須改為你 GridView 使用的 `"stockchangedateConnectionString3"`。
vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

' * 關鍵：必須加上這個屬性，AJAX 才能呼叫 *
<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class Hyperlinks
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    ' 修正為你 GridView 使用的連線字串名稱
    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    Protected Sub Page_Load(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles Me.Load
        ' 跨網域設定 (如果你是本地測試或同網域，這部分保留即可)
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        If Request.HttpMethod = "OPTIONS" Then Response.End()
    End Sub

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetData(ByVal searchKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 修正為你的資料表欄位名稱
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT id, title, url, icon_type FROM Hyperlinks WHERE (title LIKE @key OR url LIKE @key) ORDER BY id DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@key", "%" & (searchKey & "").Trim() & "%")
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("id", dr("id"))
                    row.Add("title", dr("title").ToString())
                    row.Add("url", dr("url").ToString())
                    row.Add("icon", dr("icon_type").ToString())
                    rows.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ... 其餘 InsertData, UpdateData, DeleteData 也要確保有 <WebMethod()> _ ...
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function DeleteData(ByVal id As Integer, ByVal pwd As String) As Object
        If pwd <> "pw123456789pw" Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "密碼錯誤！"}
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM Hyperlinks WHERE id = @id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
    
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function InsertData(ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "INSERT INTO Hyperlinks (title, url, icon_type, created_at) VALUES (@title, @url, @icon, GETDATE())"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

### 步驟 3：檢查 Web.config (非常重要) 如果 AJAX 還是回報無法連線，通常是 `Web.config` 擋住了。請檢查是否有這段配置：

<configuration>

      <protocols>
        <add name="HttpGet"/>
        <add name="HttpPost"/>
      </protocols>
    </webServices>
  </system.web>
  
  <!-- 如果有 system.webServer，確保不擋 JSON -->

    <directoryBrowse enabled="true" />
  </system.webServer>
</configuration>
### 為什麼 GridView 有通，但 AJAX 沒通？ 1. GridView 是後端渲染：它是直接在伺服器端讀取資料，不需要透過 HTTP JSON 請求。 2. AJAX 是前端請求：它需要伺服器開放「WebMethod 序列化服務」。如果類別上方沒加 `<ScriptService()>`，伺服器會拒絕 JSON 格式的 POST 請求，導致報錯。 建議調錯小撇步： 按下瀏覽器的 F12 -> 切換到 Network (網路) 分頁。 再次重新整理頁面，看紅色的 `GetData` 請求。 * 如果是 404：代表 `SERVER_URL` 路徑寫錯了。 * 如果是 500：代表 VB 程式碼報錯（可能是 SQL 欄位名稱寫錯）。 * 如果是 401/403：代表權限或 Web.config 設定問題。 你先把 VB 那個 `stockchangedateConnectionString3` 和 `<ScriptService()>` 改好，應該就通了！

    <script>
        // 確保路徑與你的檔名一致
        const SERVER_URL = "Hyperlinks.aspx"; 
        var dataModal;

        $(document).ready(function () {
            dataModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('dataModal'));
            loadGrid();
        });

        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: SERVER_URL + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); },
                error: function (xhr) { 
                    console.log(xhr.responseText); // 在控制台看詳細錯誤
                    Swal.fire("連線錯誤", "請檢查後端是否已加入 ScriptService 屬性", "error"); 
                }
            });
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            callAPI("GetData", { searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val() }, function (r) {
                if (!r.success) return;
                let html = "";
                r.data.forEach((item, index) => {
                    let highlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "") ? "highlight" : "";
                    html += `<div class="link-card ${highlight}">
                        <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="window.open('${item.url}', '_blank')">
                            <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                            <div class="link-info"><div class="link-title">${item.title}</div><div class="link-url">${item.url}</div></div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="action-btns">
                            <button class="btn-icon" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id},'${item.title}','${item.url}','${item.icon}')"><i class="fas fa-pencil-alt"></i></button>
                            <button class="btn-icon" onclick="askDelete(${item.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                });
                $("#linkContainer").html(html || "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary'>查無資料</div>");
            });
        }

        function openAddModal() { $("#dataId").val(""); $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結"); dataModal.show(); }
        function openEditModal(id, t, u, i) { $("#dataId").val(id); $("#dataTitle").val(t); $("#dataUrl").val(u); $("#dataIcon").val(i); $("#modalTitle").text("編輯連結"); dataModal.show(); }

        function submitData() {
            let id = $("#dataId").val();
            let method = id ? "UpdateData" : "InsertData";
            let d = { title: $("#dataTitle").val(), url: $("#dataUrl").val(), icon: $("#dataIcon").val() };
            if(id) d.id = parseInt(id);
            callAPI(method, d, function(r) { if(r.success) { dataModal.hide(); loadGrid(); } });
        }

        function askDelete(id) {
            Swal.fire({ title: '確認刪除？', text: '請輸入密碼', input: 'password', showCancelButton: true }).then(res => {
                if (res.isConfirmed) callAPI("DeleteData", { id: id, pwd: res.value }, function(r) { if(r.success) loadGrid(); else Swal.fire("錯誤", r.msg, "error"); });
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>

ConnectionString: 你的 `Web.config` 中有多個連線字串，我幫你指定了 GridView 正在使用的 `stockchangedateConnectionString3`。 3. 欄位對應: 我根據你的 GridView 欄位（`id`, `title`, `url`, `icon_type`）調整了 SQL 語法。 現在請將這兩個檔案存檔後執行，就能看到漂亮的連結清單了！

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class Hyperlinks
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetData(ByVal searchKey As String, ByVal category As String, ByVal sortBy As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 動態組合 SQL
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT * FROM Hyperlinks WHERE (title LIKE @key OR url LIKE @key)"
                If category <> "全部" Then sql &= " AND category = @cat"
                
                ' 排序邏輯
                Select Case sortBy
                    Case "最常使用" : sql &= " ORDER BY clicks DESC"
                    Case "最新加入" : sql &= " ORDER BY id DESC"
                    Case "自訂順序" : sql &= " ORDER BY sort_index ASC, id DESC"
                End Select

                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@key", "%" & (searchKey & "").Trim() & "%")
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("id", dr("id"))
                    row.Add("title", dr("title").ToString())
                    row.Add("url", dr("url").ToString())
                    row.Add("icon", dr("icon_type").ToString())
                    row.Add("category", dr("category").ToString())
                    row.Add("clicks", dr("clicks"))
                    rows.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 新增功能：點擊計數
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function LogClick(ByVal id As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "UPDATE Hyperlinks SET clicks = clicks + 1 WHERE id = @id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False}
        End Try
    End Function

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function InsertData(ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String, ByVal category As String) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "INSERT INTO Hyperlinks (title, url, icon_type, category, created_at) VALUES (@title, @url, @icon, @cat, GETDATE())"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' ... UpdateData 也要記得補上 category 欄位更新，邏輯同上 ...
End Class

    <div class="app-container">
        <!-- 下拉排序選單 -->

            <select id="selSort" class="sort-select" onchange="loadGrid()">
                <option value="最新加入">排序：最新加入</option>

        <!-- 搜尋與新增按鈕 -->
        <div class="tool-bar">
            <div class="search-wrapper">
                <i class="fas fa-search"></i>
                <input type="text" id="inputSearch" class="search-input" placeholder="搜尋常用連結..." onkeyup="loadGrid()">
            </div>
            <button class="btn-add-top" onclick="openAddModal()"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i></button>
        </div>

        <!-- 分類 Pills (3個主分類+全部) -->
        <div class="category-pills" id="catPills">
            <div class="pill active" onclick="setCategory('全部', this)">全部</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('常用', this)">常用</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('開發', this)">開發</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('個人', this)">個人</div>
        </div>

        <!-- 連結清單 -->
        <div id="linkContainer" class="mt-2"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Modal (略，與之前相同但增加 Category 下拉選單) -->
    <!-- ... 此處加入 Category 下拉選單: 常用, 開發, 個人 ... -->

    <script>
        const SERVER_URL = "Hyperlinks.aspx";
        let currentCategory = "全部";

        $(document).ready(function () { loadGrid(); });

        function setCategory(cat, el) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            $(".pill").removeClass("active");
            $(el).addClass("active");
            loadGrid();
        }

        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: SERVER_URL + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); }
            });
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            let params = { 
                searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val(),
                category: currentCategory,
                sortBy: $("#selSort").val()
            };
            callAPI("GetData", params, function (r) {
                if (!r.success) return;
                renderLinks(r.data);
            });
        }

        function renderLinks(list) {
            let html = "";
            list.forEach((item, index) => {
                let highlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "" && currentCategory === "全部") ? "highlight" : "";
                html += `
                    <div class="link-card ${highlight}">
                        <div class="click-badge"><i class="fas fa-mouse-pointer me-1"></i>${item.clicks}</div>
                        <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="handleLinkClick(${item.id}, '${item.url}')">
                            <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                            <div class="link-info">
                                <div class="link-title">${item.title}</div>
                                <div class="link-url">${item.url.replace('https://','')}</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="d-flex flex-column gap-2">
                            <button class="btn-icon" onclick="copyToClipboard('${item.url}')" title="複製"><i class="far fa-copy"></i></button>
                            <button class="btn-icon" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id},'${item.title}','${item.url}','${item.icon}','${item.category}')"><i class="fas fa-ellipsis-v"></i></button>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
            });
            $("#linkContainer").html(html || "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary'>此分類尚無資料</div>");
        }

        function handleLinkClick(id, url) {
            callAPI("LogClick", { id: id }, function(){}); // 非同步紀錄點擊
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        function copyToClipboard(text) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            Swal.fire({ toast: true, position: 'top-end', icon: 'success', title: '網址已複製', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 1500 });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

' 關鍵：開啟 AJAX 呼叫權限
<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class Hyperlinks
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    ' 使用您指定的連線字串
    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    Protected Sub Page_Load(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) Handles Me.Load
        ' 處理跨網域 (CORS)
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS")
        Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        If Request.HttpMethod = "OPTIONS" Then Response.End()
    End Sub

    ''' <summary>
    ''' 取得連結清單 (支援搜尋、分類、排序)
    ''' </summary>
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetData(ByVal searchKey As String, ByVal category As String, ByVal sortBy As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 基礎 SQL
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT * FROM Hyperlinks WHERE (title LIKE @key OR url LIKE @key)"
                
                ' 分類過濾
                If category <> "全部" Then
                    sql &= " AND category = @cat"
                End If

                ' 排序邏輯
                Select Case sortBy
                    Case "點擊次數"
                        sql &= " ORDER BY clicks DESC, id DESC"
                    Case "自訂順序"
                        sql &= " ORDER BY sort_index ASC, title ASC"
                    Case Else ' 最新加入
                        sql &= " ORDER BY id DESC"
                End Select

                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@key", "%" & (searchKey & "").Trim() & "%")
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
                
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("id", dr("id"))
                    row.Add("title", If(IsDBNull(dr("title")), "", dr("title").ToString()))
                    row.Add("url", If(IsDBNull(dr("url")), "", dr("url").ToString()))
                    row.Add("icon", If(IsDBNull(dr("icon_type")), "fa-link", dr("icon_type").ToString()))
                    row.Add("category", If(IsDBNull(dr("category")), "常用", dr("category").ToString()))
                    row.Add("clicks", If(IsDBNull(dr("clicks")), 0, dr("clicks")))
                    rows.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = rows}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ''' <summary>
    ''' 紀錄點擊次數 (每次點開連結時呼叫)
    ''' </summary>
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function LogClick(ByVal id As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "UPDATE Hyperlinks SET clicks = clicks + 1 WHERE id = @id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False}
        End Try
    End Function

    ''' <summary>
    ''' 新增連結
    ''' </summary>
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function InsertData(ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String, ByVal category As String) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "INSERT INTO Hyperlinks (title, url, icon_type, category, created_at) VALUES (@title, @url, @icon, @cat, GETDATE())"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ''' <summary>
    ''' 修改連結
    ''' </summary>
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function UpdateData(ByVal id As Integer, ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String, ByVal category As String) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "UPDATE Hyperlinks SET title=@title, url=@url, icon_type=@icon, category=@cat WHERE id=@id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ''' <summary>
    ''' 刪除連結
    ''' </summary>
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function DeleteData(ByVal id As Integer, ByVal pwd As String) As Object
        If pwd <> "pw123456789pw" Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "密碼錯誤！"}
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM Hyperlinks WHERE id = @id"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
                conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

End Class

javascript
function submitData() {
    var id = $("#dataId").val();
    
    // 取得所有欄位值
    var d = { 
        title: $("#dataTitle").val(), 
        url: $("#dataUrl").val(), 
        icon: $("#dataIcon").val(),
        category: $("#dataCategory").val() // 確保有抓到分類
    };

    if (!d.title || !d.url) { 
        Swal.fire("提示", "標題與網址為必填", "warning"); 
        return; 
    }

    if (id) {
        // 修改模式：多傳一個 id 參數
        var updateParams = { 
            id: parseInt(id), 
            title: d.title, 
            url: d.url, 
            icon: d.icon, 
            category: d.category 
        };
        callAPI("UpdateData", updateParams, function (r) {
            if (r.success) {
                dataModal.hide();
                loadGrid();
            } else {
                Swal.fire("錯誤", "修改失敗: " + r.msg, "error");
            }
        });
    } else {
        // 新增模式
        callAPI("InsertData", d, function (r) {
            if (r.success) {
                dataModal.hide();
                loadGrid();
                // 成功後清空欄位
                $("#dataTitle, #dataUrl").val("");
            } else {
                Swal.fire("錯誤", "新增失敗: " + r.msg, "error");
            }
        });
    }
}

// 修改 openAddModal 確保每次打開時欄位清空
function openAddModal() {
    $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結");
    $("#dataId").val("");
    $("#dataTitle").val("");
    $("#dataUrl").val("https://");
    $("#dataCategory").val("常用");
    $("#dataIcon").val("fa-link");
    dataModal.show();

    <div class="app-container">

                <i class="fas fa-plus"></i>
            </button>

        <!-- 分類標籤 -->
        <div class="category-scroll" id="catPills">
            <div class="pill active" onclick="setCategory('全部', this)">全部</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('常用', this)">常用</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('開發', this)">開發</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('個人', this)">個人</div>
        </div>

        <!-- 連結清單 -->
        <div id="linkContainer">
            <div class="text-center py-5"><div class="spinner-border text-primary" role="status"></div></div>
        </div>

        <div class="text-center mt-4 small text-secondary">
            <i class="fas fa-info-circle me-1"></i> 點擊卡片可直接開啟分頁
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- [Modal] 新增/編輯視窗 -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="dataModal" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
            <div class="modal-content p-2">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title fw-bold" id="modalTitle">新增連結</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <input type="hidden" id="dataId">
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label small text-secondary">連結名稱</label>
                        <input type="text" id="dataTitle" class="form-control" placeholder="例如: My GitHub">
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label small text-secondary">網址 (URL)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="dataUrl" class="form-control" placeholder="https://...">
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="col-6 mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label small text-secondary">所屬分類</label>
                            <select id="dataCategory" class="form-select">
                                <option value="常用">常用</option>
                                <option value="開發">開發</option>
                                <option value="個人">個人</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-6 mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label small text-secondary">圖示類型</label>
                            <select id="dataIcon" class="form-select">
                                <option value="fa-link">一般連結</option>
                                <option value="fa-code">程式開發</option>
                                <option value="fa-folder">資料夾</option>
                                <option value="fa-eye">檢視圖示</option>

                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

    <script>
        const SERVER_URL = "Hyperlinks.aspx"; // 確保檔名正確
        var dataModal;
        var currentCategory = "全部";

        $(document).ready(function () {
            dataModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('dataModal'));
            loadGrid();
        });

        // 核心 API 呼叫 (對應 VB WebMethod)
        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: SERVER_URL + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); },
                error: function (xhr) { 
                    console.error(xhr.responseText);
                    Swal.fire("API 錯誤", "伺服器通訊失敗，請檢查後端 ScriptService 屬性。", "error"); 
                }
            });
        }

        function setCategory(cat, el) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            $(".pill").removeClass("active");
            $(el).addClass("active");
            loadGrid();
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            var params = { 
                searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val(),
                category: currentCategory,
                sortBy: $("#selSort").val()
            };
            callAPI("GetData", params, function (r) {
                if (!r.success) { Swal.fire("載入失敗", r.msg, "error"); return; }
                renderLinks(r.data);
            });
        }

        function renderLinks(list) {
            var html = "";
            if (!list || list.length === 0) {
                html = "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary opacity-50'>— 尚無資料 —</div>";
            } else {
                list.forEach(function (item, index) {
                    // 第一筆高亮邏輯 (搜尋時不亮)
                    var isHighlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "") ? "highlight" : "";
                    var displayUrl = item.url.replace("https://", "").replace("http://", "");

                    html += `
                        <div class="link-card ${isHighlight}">
                            <div class="click-badge"><i class="fas fa-mouse-pointer me-1"></i>${item.clicks}</div>
                            <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="handleLinkOpen(${item.id}, '${item.url}')">
                                <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                                <div class="link-info">
                                    <div class="link-title">${item.title}</div>
                                    <div class="link-url">${displayUrl}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="card-actions ps-3">
                                <button class="btn-mini" onclick="copyUrl('${item.url}')" title="複製連結"><i class="far fa-copy"></i></button>
                                <button class="btn-mini" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id}, '${item.title}', '${item.url}', '${item.icon}', '${item.category}')"><i class="fas fa-pencil-alt"></i></button>
                                <button class="btn-mini" onclick="askDelete(${item.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-danger opacity-50"></i></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                });
            }
            $("#linkContainer").html(html);
        }

        function handleLinkOpen(id, url) {
            callAPI("LogClick", { id: id }, function(){}); // 背景紀錄點擊次數
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        function copyUrl(text) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            const Toast = Swal.mixin({ toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 1500 });
            Toast.fire({ icon: 'success', title: '網址已複製' });
        }

        // --- CRUD 操作 ---
        function openAddModal() {
            $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結");
            $("#dataId").val("");
            $("#dataTitle").val("");
            $("#dataUrl").val("https://");
            $("#dataCategory").val("常用");
            $("#dataIcon").val("fa-link");
            dataModal.show();
        }

        function openEditModal(id, title, url, icon, category) {
            $("#modalTitle").text("編輯連結內容");
            $("#dataId").val(id);
            $("#dataTitle").val(title);
            $("#dataUrl").val(url);
            $("#dataCategory").val(category || "常用");
            $("#dataIcon").val(icon || "fa-link");
            dataModal.show();
        }

        function submitData() {
            var id = $("#dataId").val();
            var d = { 
                title: $("#dataTitle").val(), 
                url: $("#dataUrl").val(), 
                icon: $("#dataIcon").val(),
                category: $("#dataCategory").val()
            };

            if (!d.title || !d.url) { Swal.fire("填寫不完整", "標題與網址為必填項", "warning"); return; }

            var method = id ? "UpdateData" : "InsertData";
            var params = id ? { id: parseInt(id), ...d } : d;

            callAPI(method, params, function (r) {
                if (r.success) {
                    dataModal.hide();
                    loadGrid();
                } else {
                    Swal.fire("儲存失敗", r.msg, "error");
                }
            });
        }

        function askDelete(id) {
            Swal.fire({
                title: '確認刪除？',
                text: "刪除後將無法還原資料！",
                icon: 'warning',
                input: 'password',
                inputPlaceholder: '請輸入刪除密碼',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonColor: '#d33',
                confirmButtonText: '確認刪除',
                cancelButtonText: '取消'
            }).then(res => {
                if (res.isConfirmed) {
                    callAPI("DeleteData", { id: id, pwd: res.value }, function (r) {
                        if (r.success) { loadGrid(); }
                        else { Swal.fire("錯誤", r.msg, "error"); }
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

「自訂順序」最直覺的作法是在新增/編輯時，給予一個「排序權重 (Sort Index)」欄位。數字越小排越前面（例如 1 比 10 優先）。 為了實現這個功能，我們需要對資料庫、VB 後端、HTML 前端進行三位一體的更新。 ### 1. SQL Server 欄位確認 請確認您的 `Hyperlinks` 資料表中有 `sort_index` 欄位。如果沒有，請執行：
sql
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('Hyperlinks') AND name = 'sort_index')
BEGIN
    ALTER TABLE Hyperlinks ADD sort_index INT DEFAULT 100; -- 預設給 100，方便往前往後排
END
--- ### 2. VB.NET 後端更新 (`Hyperlinks.aspx.vb`) 我們需要更新 `InsertData` 與 `UpdateData` 的參數，讓它們能接收並儲存排序值。
vb
' 更新新增功能：加入 sortIndex 參數
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function InsertData(ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String, ByVal category As String, ByVal sortIndex As Integer) As Object
    Try
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            Dim sql As String = "INSERT INTO Hyperlinks (title, url, icon_type, category, sort_index, created_at) VALUES (@title, @url, @icon, @cat, @sort, GETDATE())"
            Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@sort", sortIndex)
            conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
        End Using
        Return New With {.success = True}
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function

' 更新修改功能：加入 sortIndex 參數
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function UpdateData(ByVal id As Integer, ByVal title As String, ByVal url As String, ByVal icon As String, ByVal category As String, ByVal sortIndex As Integer) As Object
    Try
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            Dim sql As String = "UPDATE Hyperlinks SET title=@title, url=@url, icon_type=@icon, category=@cat, sort_index=@sort WHERE id=@id"
            Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", id)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@title", title)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@url", url)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@icon", icon)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@sort", sortIndex)
            conn.Open() : cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
        End Using
        Return New With {.success = True}
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function

    $("#dataCategory").val(category || "常用");
    $("#dataIcon").val(icon || "fa-link");
    $("#dataSort").val(sortIndex || 100); // 帶入現有的權重
    dataModal.show();
}

// 修改 renderLinks 裡面呼叫 openEditModal 的地方
// html += `<button onclick="openEditModal(..., ${item.sort_index})">`
--- ### 如何使用「自訂順序」？ 1. 設定權重： * 如果您想讓某個連結永遠在最上面，將它的權重設為 `1`。 * 如果您想讓它在後面，設為 `999`。 2. 操作排序： * 在主畫面的下拉選單選擇「排序：自訂順序」。 * 這時網頁會執行 `ORDER BY sort_index ASC`。 * 如果您之後想調整位置，只需點擊「編輯」，修改權重數字後儲存即可。 ### 專業判斷：為什麼不直接用拖拽（Drag & Drop）？ 雖然拖拽很酷，但在手機瀏覽器上，拖拽排序容易跟「網頁上下滑動」產生衝突，導致誤觸。 手動輸入權重數字的好處是： 1. 精準：您可以直接指定它是第 1 名。 2. 穩定：跨瀏覽器、跨系統（iOS/Android）絕對不會出錯。 3. 效能：不需要載入額外的拖拽外掛（如 Sortable.js），網頁開啟速度最快。 這套邏輯配合您原本的 SQL 排序語句 `ORDER BY sort_index ASC, id DESC` 是最完美的，因為當兩個權重一樣時，它會自動把比較新的放在上面！

<%@ Page Language="VB" AutoEventWireup="false" CodeFile="Hyperlinks.aspx.vb" Inherits="Hyperlinks" %>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>Zen LinkHub v2.5</title>
    <!-- 引入核心資源 -->
    <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11"></script>

    <style>
        /* 深色背景風格 */
        body {
            background-color: #050a15;
            color: #ffffff;
            font-family: "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif;
            padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
        }

        .app-container { max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 15px; }

        /* 頂部 Meta 區 */
        .top-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 5px; }
        .sort-select { 
            background: transparent; border: none; color: #64748b; font-size: 13px; 
            outline: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 5px 0;
        }
        .sort-select option { background: #0f172a; color: white; }

        /* 搜尋列與新增按鈕 (並排) */
        .action-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
        .search-group { flex-grow: 1; position: relative; }
        .search-group i { position: absolute; left: 15px; top: 13px; color: #475569; }
        .search-input { 
            width: 100%; background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #1e293b; 
            border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 15px 10px 42px; color: white; 
        }
        
        .btn-add-hero { 
            background: #3b82f6; color: white; border: none; width: 48px; height: 46px; 
            border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            font-size: 18px; transition: 0.2s;
        }
        .btn-add-hero:active { transform: scale(0.9); background: #2563eb; }

        /* 分類 Pills */
        .category-bar { 
            display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 15px; 
            scrollbar-width: none; 
        }
        .category-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        .pill { 
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 18px; border-radius: 20px; 
            font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; 
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); 
        }
        .pill.active { background: #3b82f6; border-color: #3b82f6; font-weight: 600; }

        /* 連結卡片清單 */
        .link-card { 
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); 
            border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; 
            display: flex; align-items: center; position: relative; transition: 0.2s;
        }
        /* 第一筆亮藍色 */
        .link-card.highlight { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #1e3a8a 100%); border: none; }
        
        .icon-box { 
            width: 44px; height: 44px; background: rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.3); 
            border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; 
            margin-right: 15px; color: #60a5fa; font-size: 18px;
        }
        .highlight .icon-box { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); color: white; }

        .link-info { flex-grow: 1; min-width: 0; }
        .link-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 1px; }
        .link-url { font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; opacity: 0.8; }
        .highlight .link-url { color: #bfdbfe; }

        /* 數據徽章 */
        .stat-badge { 
            position: absolute; right: 55px; top: 10px; font-size: 9px; 
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; color: #475569;
        }
        .highlight .stat-badge { color: #93c5fd; }

        /* 操作按鈕 */
        .card-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding-left: 10px; }
        .btn-mini-tool { background: transparent; border: none; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); font-size: 13px; padding: 4px; }
        .btn-mini-tool:hover { color: white; }

        /* Modal 樣式改進 */
        .modal-content { background-color: #111827; color: white; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 25px; }
        .form-control, .form-select { 
            background-color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #1e293b; color: white; 
            border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px;
        }
        .form-control:focus { background-color: #0f172a; color: white; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: none; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="app-container">
        <!-- 頂部功能條 -->
        <div class="top-meta">
            <select id="selSort" class="sort-select" onchange="loadGrid()">
                <option value="最新加入">排序：最新加入</option>
                <option value="點擊次數">排序：點擊次數</option>
                <option value="自訂順序">排序：自訂順序</option>
            </select>
            <span class="small text-secondary" style="font-size: 10px;">Zen Pro Hub v2.5</span>
        </div>

        <!-- 搜尋列與新增按鈕 -->
        <div class="action-row">
            <div class="search-group">
                <i class="fas fa-search"></i>
                <input type="text" id="inputSearch" class="search-input" placeholder="搜尋關鍵字..." onkeyup="loadGrid()">
            </div>
            <button class="btn-add-hero" onclick="openAddModal()">
                <i class="fas fa-plus"></i>
            </button>
        </div>

        <!-- 分類切換標籤 -->
        <div class="category-bar" id="catBar">
            <div class="pill active" onclick="setCategory('全部', this)">全部</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('常用', this)">常用</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('開發', this)">開發</div>
            <div class="pill" onclick="setCategory('個人', this)">個人</div>
        </div>

        <!-- 連結清單容器 -->
        <div id="linkContainer">
            <div class="text-center py-5 opacity-25"><i class="fas fa-circle-notch fa-spin fa-2x"></i></div>
        </div>

        <div class="text-center mt-4 mb-5 small text-secondary">
            <i class="fas fa-external-link-alt me-1"></i> 點擊卡片開啟，長按圖示可編輯
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- [Modal] 新增與編輯視窗 -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="dataModal" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
            <div class="modal-content p-2">
                <div class="modal-header border-0">
                    <h5 class="modal-title fw-bold" id="modalTitle">新增連結</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <input type="hidden" id="dataId">
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label small text-secondary">標題名稱</label>
                        <input type="text" id="dataTitle" class="form-control" placeholder="輸入名稱...">
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label small text-secondary">連結地址 (URL)</label>
                        <input type="text" id="dataUrl" class="form-control" placeholder="https://...">
                    </div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="col-6 mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label small text-secondary">分類</label>
                            <select id="dataCategory" class="form-select">
                                <option value="常用">常用</option>
                                <option value="開發">開發</option>
                                <option value="個人">個人</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-6 mb-3">
                            <label class="form-label small text-secondary">權重 (1最優先)</label>
                            <input type="number" id="dataSort" class="form-control" value="100">
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label class="form-label small text-secondary">圖示</label>
                        <select id="dataIcon" class="form-select">
                            <option value="fa-link">🔗 一般連結</option>
                            <option value="fa-code">💻 程式開發</option>
                            <option value="fa-folder">📁 資料夾</option>
                            <option value="fa-eye">👁️ 檢視圖示</option>
                            <option value="fa-github">🐙 GitHub</option>
                            <option value="fa-server">🖥️ 伺服器</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer border-0">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-dark px-4" data-bs-dismiss="modal">取消</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary px-5" onclick="submitData()">儲存變更</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const API_PATH = "Hyperlinks.aspx"; // VB 頁面檔名
        var dataModal;
        var currentCategory = "全部";

        $(document).ready(function () {
            dataModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('dataModal'));
            loadGrid();
        });

        // 統一 callAPI 函數
        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: API_PATH + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); },
                error: function (xhr) { 
                    console.error(xhr.responseText);
                    Swal.fire("API 連線失敗", "請檢查後端 ScriptService 設定。", "error"); 
                }
            });
        }

        // 分類切換
        function setCategory(cat, el) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            $(".pill").removeClass("active");
            $(el).addClass("active");
            loadGrid();
        }

        // 讀取列表
        function loadGrid() {
            var params = { 
                searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val(),
                category: currentCategory,
                sortBy: $("#selSort").val()
            };
            callAPI("GetData", params, function (r) {
                if (!r.success) { Swal.fire("讀取錯誤", r.msg, "error"); return; }
                renderLinks(r.data);
            });
        }

        // 渲染畫面
        function renderLinks(list) {
            var html = "";
            if (!list || list.length === 0) {
                html = "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary opacity-50'>— 無資料 —</div>";
            } else {
                list.forEach(function (item, index) {
                    // 第一筆高亮判斷 (搜尋或過濾分類時不強制亮)
                    var isHighlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "" && currentCategory === "全部") ? "highlight" : "";
                    var displayUrl = item.url.replace("https://", "").replace("http://", "");

                    html += `
                        <div class="link-card ${isHighlight}">
                            <div class="stat-badge"><i class="fas fa-chart-line me-1"></i>${item.clicks}</div>
                            <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openLink(${item.id}, '${item.url}')">
                                <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                                <div class="link-info">
                                    <div class="link-title">${item.title}</div>
                                    <div class="link-url">${displayUrl}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="card-actions ps-3">
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="copyText('${item.url}')"><i class="far fa-copy"></i></button>
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id}, '${item.title}', '${item.url}', '${item.icon}', '${item.category}', ${item.sort_index})"><i class="fas fa-edit"></i></button>
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="doDelete(${item.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-danger opacity-50"></i></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                });
            }
            $("#linkContainer").html(html);
        }

        function openLink(id, url) {
            callAPI("LogClick", { id: id }, function(){}); 
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        function copyText(val) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(val);
            const Toast = Swal.mixin({ toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 1000 });
            Toast.fire({ icon: 'success', title: '已複製網址' });
        }

        // 新增/編輯彈窗
        function openAddModal() {
            $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結資源");
            $("#dataId").val("");
            $("#dataTitle").val("");
            $("#dataUrl").val("https://");
            $("#dataCategory").val("常用");
            $("#dataSort").val("100");
            $("#dataIcon").val("fa-link");
            dataModal.show();
        }

        function openEditModal(id, title, url, icon, category, sort) {
            $("#modalTitle").text("編輯資源內容");
            $("#dataId").val(id);
            $("#dataTitle").val(title);
            $("#dataUrl").val(url);
            $("#dataCategory").val(category || "常用");
            $("#dataSort").val(sort || 100);
            $("#dataIcon").val(icon || "fa-link");
            dataModal.show();
        }

        function submitData() {
            var id = $("#dataId").val();
            var d = { 
                title: $("#dataTitle").val(), 
                url: $("#dataUrl").val(), 
                icon: $("#dataIcon").val(),
                category: $("#dataCategory").val(),
                sortIndex: parseInt($("#dataSort").val()) || 100
            };

            if (!d.title || !d.url) { Swal.fire("提示", "名稱與網址必填", "warning"); return; }

            var method = id ? "UpdateData" : "InsertData";
            var params = id ? { id: parseInt(id), ...d } : d;

            callAPI(method, params, function (r) {
                if (r.success) {
                    dataModal.hide();
                    loadGrid();
                } else {
                    Swal.fire("儲存失敗", r.msg, "error");
                }
            });
        }

        function doDelete(id) {
            Swal.fire({
                title: '確認刪除？',
                text: "刪除後將無法恢復！",
                icon: 'warning',
                input: 'password',
                inputPlaceholder: '請輸入刪除密碼',
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonColor: '#d33',
                confirmButtonText: '確定刪除'
            }).then(res => {
                if (res.isConfirmed) {
                    callAPI("DeleteData", { id: id, pwd: res.value }, function (r) {
                        if (r.success) { loadGrid(); }
                        else { Swal.fire("錯誤", r.msg, "error"); }
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
