        const API_PATH = "Hyperlinks.aspx";
        var dataModal;
        var currentCategory = "全部";

        $(document).ready(function () {
            dataModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('dataModal'));
            loadGrid();
        });

        // 快速導覽功能
        function quickNav(url) {
            if (!url) return;
            window.location.href = url; // 若要在新視窗開啟可改用 window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: API_PATH + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); }
            });
        }

        function setCategory(cat, el) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            $(".pill").removeClass("active");
            $(el).addClass("active");
            loadGrid();
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            var params = { 
                searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val(),
                category: currentCategory,
                sortBy: $("#selSort").val()
            };
            callAPI("GetData", params, function (r) {
                if (r.success) renderLinks(r.data);
            });
        }

        function renderLinks(list) {
            var html = "";
            list.forEach(function (item, index) {
                var isHighlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "" && currentCategory === "全部") ? "highlight" : "";
                html += `
                    <div class="link-card ${isHighlight}">
                        <div class="stat-badge"><i class="fas fa-chart-line me-1"></i>${item.clicks}</div>
                        <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openLink(${item.id}, '${item.url}')">
                            <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                            <div class="link-info">
                                <div class="link-title">${item.title}</div>
                                <div class="link-url">${item.url.replace('https://','')}</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="card-actions ps-3">
                            <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id}, '${item.title}', '${item.url}', '${item.icon}', '${item.category}', ${item.sort_index})"><i class="fas fa-edit"></i></button>
                            <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="doDelete(${item.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-danger opacity-50"></i></button>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
            });
            $("#linkContainer").html(html || "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary'>— 無資料 —</div>");
        }

        function openLink(id, url) {
            callAPI("LogClick", { id: id }, function(){}); 
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        // 其餘 CRUD 函數 (openAddModal, submitData, doDelete) 維持原本邏輯即可...
    </script>
</body>
</html>

🤖 GEMINI
轉圈圈代表前端 AJAX 發出了請求，但 後端沒有回傳正確的 JSON 資料，或是 SQL 語法因為缺少欄位而報錯了。 最常見的原因是：您剛才加入了「分類」與「排序」功能，但 SQL 資料庫還沒有這幾個新欄位，導致 `SELECT *` 失敗。 請依照以下三個檢查步驟修復： ### 步驟 1：務必執行 SQL 更新（最重要） 請在 SQL Server 執行以下指令，補齊 `category`, `clicks`, `sort_index` 欄位：
sql
-- 檢查並補齊欄位
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('Hyperlinks') AND name = 'category')
    ALTER TABLE Hyperlinks ADD category NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT N'常用';

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('Hyperlinks') AND name = 'clicks')
    ALTER TABLE Hyperlinks ADD clicks INT DEFAULT 0;

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID('Hyperlinks') AND name = 'sort_index')
    ALTER TABLE Hyperlinks ADD sort_index INT DEFAULT 100;

-- 執行後，先把舊資料的分類填好，否則「全部」以外的分類會抓不到資料
UPDATE Hyperlinks SET category = N'常用' WHERE category IS NULL;
--- ### 步驟 2：檢查 VB 後端參數對齊 轉圈圈通常是因為 JS 傳了 3 個參數，但 VB 沒準備好收 3 個。請確保您的 `GetData` 函數長這樣：
vb
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function GetData(ByVal searchKey As String, ByVal category As String, ByVal sortBy As String) As Object
    Try
        Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            ' 組合 SQL (這裡要加上 N 字頭處理中文分類)
            Dim sql As String = "SELECT * FROM Hyperlinks WHERE (title LIKE @key OR url LIKE @key)"
            
            If category <> "全部" Then
                sql &= " AND category = @cat"
            End If

            ' 排序邏輯
            Select Case sortBy
                Case "點擊次數" : sql &= " ORDER BY clicks DESC, id DESC"
                Case "自訂順序" : sql &= " ORDER BY sort_index ASC, id DESC"
                Case Else : sql &= " ORDER BY id DESC"
            End Select

            Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@key", "%" & (searchKey & "").Trim() & "%")
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@cat", category)
            
            conn.Open()
            Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
            While dr.Read()
                Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                row.Add("id", dr("id"))
                row.Add("title", dr("title").ToString())
                row.Add("url", dr("url").ToString())
                row.Add("icon", dr("icon_type").ToString())
                row.Add("category", dr("category").ToString())
                row.Add("clicks", dr("clicks"))
                row.Add("sort_index", dr("sort_index"))
                rows.Add(row)
            End While
        End Using
        Return New With {.success = True, .data = rows}
    Catch ex As Exception
        ' 這裡是關鍵：如果出錯，會回傳錯誤訊息，JS 就不會一直轉圈圈
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function
--- ### 步驟 3：調試技巧（找出紅字） 如果還是轉圈圈，請按鍵盤 F12 開啟開發者工具： 1. 點擊 Network (網路) 標籤。 2. 重新整理網頁。 3. 看紅色的 `GetData` 請求，點進去看 Response (回應)。 * 如果是 500 Error：代表 VB 代碼報錯了（通常是 SQL 欄位名稱寫錯）。 * 如果是 400 Bad Request：代表 JS 傳的參數名稱跟 VB 寫的不一樣（大小寫或數量）。 ### 針對您的下拉選單 HTML 調整： 請確保導覽選單（Nav）的 JS 函數名稱正確：

        // 確保 DOM 載入後才初始化 Modal
        $(document).ready(function () {
            const modalEl = document.getElementById('dataModal');
            if (modalEl) {
                myModal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalEl, { backdrop: 'static' });
            }
            loadGrid();
        });

        function quickNav(url) { if (url) window.location.href = url; }

        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: SERVER_URL + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); },
                error: function (xhr) { 
                    console.error("API Error: ", xhr.responseText); 
                    $("#linkContainer").html("<div class='text-center text-danger py-5'>API 連線失敗，請檢查後端</div>");
                }
            });
        }

        function setCategory(cat, el) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            $(".pill").removeClass("active");
            $(el).addClass("active");
            loadGrid();
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            var params = { 
                searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val() || "",
                category: currentCategory,
                sortBy: $("#selSort").val() || "最新加入"
            };
            callAPI("GetData", params, function (r) {
                if (!r.success) {
                    $("#linkContainer").html("<div class='text-center text-warning py-5'>" + r.msg + "</div>");
                    return;
                }
                renderLinks(r.data);
            });
        }

        function renderLinks(list) {
            var html = "";
            if (!list || list.length === 0) {
                html = "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary opacity-50'>— 無資料 —</div>";
            } else {
                list.forEach(function (item, index) {
                    var isHighlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "" && currentCategory === "全部") ? "highlight" : "";
                    html += `
                        <div class="link-card ${isHighlight}">
                            <div class="stat-badge"><i class="fas fa-chart-line me-1"></i>${item.clicks}</div>
                            <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openLink(${item.id}, '${item.url}')">
                                <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                                <div class="link-info">
                                    <div class="link-title">${item.title}</div>
                                    <div class="link-url">${item.url.replace('https://','')}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="card-actions ps-3">
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id},'${item.title}','${item.url}','${item.icon}','${item.category}',${item.sort_index})"><i class="fas fa-edit"></i></button>
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="doDelete(${item.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash-alt"></i></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                });
            }
            $("#linkContainer").html(html);
        }

        function openLink(id, url) {
            callAPI("LogClick", { id: id }, function(){});
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        // CRUD
        function openAddModal() {
            $("#dataId").val(""); $("#dataTitle").val(""); $("#dataUrl").val("https://"); $("#dataSort").val("100");
            $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結");
            myModal.show();
        }

        function openEditModal(id, t, u, i, c, s) {
            $("#dataId").val(id); $("#dataTitle").val(t); $("#dataUrl").val(u); $("#dataIcon").val(i); $("#dataCategory").val(c); $("#dataSort").val(s);
            $("#modalTitle").text("編輯連結");
            myModal.show();
        }

        function submitData() {
            var id = $("#dataId").val();
            var d = { title: $("#dataTitle").val(), url: $("#dataUrl").val(), icon: $("#dataIcon").val(), category: $("#dataCategory").val(), sortIndex: parseInt($("#dataSort").val()) || 100 };
            var method = id ? "UpdateData" : "InsertData";
            var params = id ? { id: parseInt(id), ...d } : d;
            callAPI(method, params, function (r) { if(r.success) { myModal.hide(); loadGrid(); } });
        }

        function doDelete(id) {
            Swal.fire({ title: '刪除？', input: 'password', showCancelButton: true }).then(res => {
                if (res.isConfirmed) callAPI("DeleteData", { id: id, pwd: res.value }, function(r){ if(r.success) loadGrid(); });
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
### 為什麼這樣改會修正錯誤？ 1. 解決 Backdrop 錯誤：將 `dataModal` 改名為 `myModal` 並確保是在 `$(document).ready` 中使用 `document.getElementById` 獲取原始 DOM。Bootstrap 5 不支援直接傳入 jQuery 物件給 Modal 建構子，這是最常見的報錯原因。 2. 停止轉圈圈：我在 `callAPI` 的 `error` 區塊加入了訊息顯示。如果後端報錯，網頁會顯示「API 連線失敗」而不是一直轉圈圈。 3. 防止 LastError：這通常是瀏覽器外掛引起，不影響功能，但確保 JS 載入順序正確（jQuery 最先）可以減少執行時衝突。 請測試看看，如果畫面還是出不來，請按 F12 查看 Network 標籤下的 `GetData` 請求，看看回應內容是否為 SQL 錯誤。

Integrating Navigation Menus I'm now integrating three navigation dropdown menus ("另開新頁", "內部免費", "看股票") into the header of the mobile-optimized link management system (Hyperlinks.aspx). I'm making sure the background is a dark `#050a15` and implementing a modern, mobile-first design using Bootstrap 5 and FontAwesome. I will ensure horizontal scrolling is enabled for the buttons if they exceed screen width, which is standard mobile UX. 這是一個非常實用的升級！將這三個功能選單（另開新頁、內部免費、看股票）整合進導覽列，會讓這個頁面正式進化為一個「全功能導覽門戶」。 我會使用 Bootstrap 5 的 Dropdown 並配合你的深色主題進行美化。為了確保在手機上好點選，我將這些選單設計在最頂部，並支援水平滑動（如果螢幕太窄時）。 ### 完整 HTML 代碼 (Zen Portal Hub v3.5) 請直接取代原本的 `.aspx` 檔案：
html
<%@ Page Language="VB" AutoEventWireup="false" CodeFile="Hyperlinks.aspx.vb" Inherits="Hyperlinks" %>
<!DOCTYPE html>

    <style>
        body {
            background-color: #050a15;
            color: #ffffff;
            font-family: "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif;

        .app-container { max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 15px; }

        /* 1. 頂部導覽選單區 (水平滑動) */
        .system-nav {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding-bottom: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            scrollbar-width: none;
        }
        .system-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        
        .system-nav .dropdown-toggle {
            white-space: nowrap;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 8px 15px;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .dropdown-menu-dark {
            background-color: #0f172a;
            border: 1px solid #1e293b;
            border-radius: 15px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            min-width: 240px;
        }
        .dropdown-item { padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03); }
        .dropdown-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
        .dropdown-item i { width: 20px; text-align: center; color: #3b82f6; }

        /* 2. 排序與搜尋 */
        .top-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 5px; }
        .sort-select { background: transparent; border: none; color: #64748b; font-size: 12px; outline: none; cursor: pointer; }
        
        .action-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
        .search-group { flex-grow: 1; position: relative; }
        .search-group i { position: absolute; left: 15px; top: 13px; color: #475569; }
        .search-input { width: 100%; background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 15px 10px 42px; color: white; }
        
        .btn-add-hero { background: #3b82f6; color: white; border: none; width: 48px; height: 46px; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; }

        /* 3. 分類 Pills */
        .category-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 15px; scrollbar-width: none; }
        .pill { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 6px 18px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
        .pill.active { background: #3b82f6; border-color: #3b82f6; font-weight: 600; }

        /* 4. 連結卡片 */
        .link-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; position: relative; }
        .link-card.highlight { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #1e3a8a 100%); border: none; }
        .icon-box { width: 44px; height: 44px; background: rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-right: 15px; color: #60a5fa; }
        .highlight .icon-box { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); color: white; }
        .link-info { flex-grow: 1; min-width: 0; }
        .link-title { font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
        .link-url { font-size: 11px; color: #64748b; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
        .highlight .link-url { color: #bfdbfe; }
        .stat-badge { position: absolute; right: 55px; top: 12px; font-size: 9px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 6px; color: #475569; }
        .highlight .stat-badge { color: #93c5fd; }
        .card-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
        .btn-mini-tool { background: transparent; border: none; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); font-size: 14px; }

        /* Modal 深色風格 */
        .modal-content { background-color: #111827; color: white; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 25px; }
        .form-control, .form-select { background-color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #1e293b; color: white; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; }
    </style>
</head>

            <!-- 另開新頁 -->

                        <div class="col-6 mb-3"><label class="small text-secondary">分類</label>
                            <select id="dataCategory" class="form-select"><option value="常用">常用</option><option value="開發">開發</option><option value="個人">個人</option></select>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-6 mb-3"><label class="small text-secondary">權重</label><input type="number" id="dataSort" class="form-control" value="100"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3"><label class="small text-secondary">圖示</label>
                        <select id="dataIcon" class="form-select">
                            <option value="fa-link">🔗 一般連結</option><option value="fa-code">💻 程式碼</option><option value="fa-folder">📁 資料夾</option><option value="fa-eye">👁️ 查看</option><option value="fa-github">🐙 GitHub</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-dark px-4" data-bs-dismiss="modal">取消</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary px-5" onclick="submitData()">儲存連結</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

    <script>
        var SERVER_URL = "Hyperlinks.aspx";
        var currentCategory = "全部";
        var myModal;

        $(document).ready(function () {
            myModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('dataModal'));
            loadGrid();
        });

        // 通用 API 呼叫
        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: SERVER_URL + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); },
                error: function (xhr) { console.error(xhr.responseText); }
            });
        }

        function setCategory(cat, el) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            $(".pill").removeClass("active");
            $(el).addClass("active");
            loadGrid();
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            var params = { 
                searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val() || "",
                category: currentCategory,
                sortBy: $("#selSort").val() || "最新加入"
            };
            callAPI("GetData", params, function (r) {
                if (r.success) renderLinks(r.data);
            });
        }

        function renderLinks(list) {
            var html = "";
            if (!list || list.length === 0) {
                html = "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary opacity-50'>— 尚無資料 —</div>";
            } else {
                list.forEach(function (item, index) {
                    var isHighlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "" && currentCategory === "全部") ? "highlight" : "";
                    html += `
                        <div class="link-card ${isHighlight}">
                            <div class="stat-badge"><i class="fas fa-chart-line me-1"></i>${item.clicks}</div>
                            <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openLink(${item.id}, '${item.url}')">
                                <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                                <div class="link-info">
                                    <div class="link-title">${item.title}</div>
                                    <div class="link-url">${item.url.replace('https://','')}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="card-actions ps-3">
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id},'${item.title}','${item.url}','${item.icon}','${item.category}',${item.sort_index})"><i class="fas fa-edit"></i></button>
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="doDelete(${item.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-danger opacity-50"></i></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                });
            }
            $("#linkContainer").html(html);
        }

        function openLink(id, url) {
            callAPI("LogClick", { id: id }, function(){});
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        function openAddModal() {
            $("#dataId").val(""); $("#dataTitle").val(""); $("#dataUrl").val("https://"); $("#dataSort").val("100");
            $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結");
            myModal.show();
        }

        function openEditModal(id, t, u, i, c, s) {
            $("#dataId").val(id); $("#dataTitle").val(t); $("#dataUrl").val(u); $("#dataIcon").val(i); $("#dataCategory").val(c); $("#dataSort").val(s);
            $("#modalTitle").text("編輯資源內容");
            myModal.show();
        }

        function submitData() {
            var id = $("#dataId").val();
            var d = { title: $("#dataTitle").val(), url: $("#dataUrl").val(), icon: $("#dataIcon").val(), category: $("#dataCategory").val(), sortIndex: parseInt($("#dataSort").val()) || 100 };
            var method = id ? "UpdateData" : "InsertData";
            var params = id ? { id: parseInt(id), ...d } : d;
            callAPI(method, params, function (r) { if(r.success) { myModal.hide(); loadGrid(); } });
        }

        function doDelete(id) {
            Swal.fire({ title: '確認刪除？', input: 'password', showCancelButton: true }).then(res => {
                if (res.isConfirmed) callAPI("DeleteData", { id: id, pwd: res.value }, function(r){ if(r.success) loadGrid(); });
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

下拉選單點不開，通常是因為我們在頂部導覽列使用了 `overflow-x: auto`（水平滑動）來適應手機寬度，而 Bootstrap 的下拉選單預設會被外層的「滑動容器」給切斷（Clip），導致它彈不出來或看不見。 另外，也有可能是 Bootstrap 的 JS 初始化順序問題。 請依照以下三個步驟修正，我已經幫您處理好這個衝突： ### 1. 修改 CSS（解決選單被切斷的問題） 在 `<style>` 標籤內，找到 `.system-nav` 並修改如下（或是直接替換這一段）：
css
/* 修改：移除 overflow-x: auto 防止切斷選單，並改用 flex-wrap 讓它在手機上自動換行 */
.system-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap; /* 讓選單在寬度不足時自動換行，這樣選單才不會被切斷 */
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1060; /* 確保選單在搜尋框上方 */
}

/* 強化選單彈出的穩定性 */
.dropdown-menu {
    position: absolute !important;
    z-index: 2000 !important;
}
### 2. 修改 HTML 屬性（強制選單彈出到視窗最外層） 在導覽列的 `<button>` 標籤中，加入 `data-bs-boundary="viewport"`。這會告訴 Bootstrap 選單要對齊整個螢幕，而不是被包在小框框裡。 請將導覽列的三個按鈕改為：
html
<!-- 另開新頁按鈕 -->
<button class="btn btn-dark dropdown-toggle btn-sm border-secondary" type="button" 
        data-bs-toggle="dropdown" data-bs-boundary="viewport">
    <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right me-1"></i>另開新頁
</button>

<!-- 內部免費按鈕 -->
<button class="btn btn-dark dropdown-toggle btn-sm border-secondary" type="button" 
        data-bs-toggle="dropdown" data-bs-boundary="viewport">
    <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right me-1"></i>內部免費
</button>

<!-- 看股票按鈕 -->
<button class="btn btn-dark dropdown-toggle btn-sm border-secondary" type="button" 
        data-bs-toggle="dropdown" data-bs-boundary="viewport">
    <i class="bi bi-graph-up-arrow me-1"></i>看股票
</button>
### 3. 修改 JavaScript 初始化（強制手動啟動選單） 有時候自動初始化會失敗，我們在 `$(document).ready` 內加入強制初始化代碼。 請將原本的 `$(document).ready` 部分更新如下：
javascript
$(document).ready(function () {
    // 1. 初始化資料操作的 Modal
    var modalEl = document.getElementById('dataModal');
    if (modalEl) {
        myModal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalEl);
    }

    // 2. 強制初始化所有下拉選單 (解決點不開的問題)
    var dropdownElementList = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-toggle'));
    var dropdownList = dropdownElementList.map(function (dropdownToggleEl) {
        return new bootstrap.Dropdown(dropdownToggleEl, {
            boundary: 'viewport' // 確保彈出時不被切斷
        });
    });

    // 3. 載入資料
    loadGrid();
});
--- ### 為什麼這樣改會通？ 1. CSS `flex-wrap: wrap`: 之前的 `overflow-x: auto` 像是一面透明的牆，下拉選單想要長出來時會被牆擋住。改用 `wrap` 讓它們在手機上如果太擠就排成兩列，這樣選單就有空間向下彈出。 2. `data-bs-boundary="viewport"`: 這是 Bootstrap 的專業解決方案，它會計算視窗位置，讓選單「浮」在所有容器之上，不再受限於父層。 3. 手動初始化: 避免因為 JS 載入順序或 jQuery 衝突導致 `data-bs-toggle` 屬性失效。 建議您直接測試「看股票」那個選單，因為它內容較少，最容易測試是否成功彈出！如果三個選單現在都能正常顯示了，就代表問題解決了。

    <script>
        var API_URL = "Hyperlinks.aspx";
        var currentCategory = "全部";
        var linkModal;

        $(document).ready(function () {
            // 初始化 Modal (修正轉圈圈問題：確保只初始化一次)
            linkModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('dataModal'));
            loadGrid();
        });

        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: API_URL + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); },
                error: function (xhr) { 
                    console.error(xhr.responseText);
                    $("#linkContainer").html("<div class='text-center py-5 text-danger'>API 連線失敗，請檢查後端</div>");
                }
            });
        }

        function setCategory(cat, el) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            $(".pill").removeClass("active");
            $(el).addClass("active");
            loadGrid();
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            var params = { searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val() || "", category: currentCategory, sortBy: $("#selSort").val() || "最新加入" };
            callAPI("GetData", params, function (r) {
                if (r.success) renderLinks(r.data);
                else $("#linkContainer").html("<div class='text-center py-5'>" + r.msg + "</div>");
            });
        }

        function renderLinks(list) {
            var html = "";
            if (!list || list.length === 0) { html = "<div class='text-center py-5 opacity-50'>— 尚無資料 —</div>"; }
            else {
                list.forEach(function (item, index) {
                    var isHighlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "" && currentCategory === "全部") ? "highlight" : "";
                    html += `
                        <div class="link-card ${isHighlight}">
                            <div class="stat-badge"><i class="fas fa-chart-line me-1"></i>${item.clicks}</div>
                            <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openLink(${item.id}, '${item.url}')">
                                <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                                <div class="link-info"><div class="link-title">${item.title}</div><div class="link-url">${item.url.replace('https://','')}</div></div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="ps-2"><button class="btn-edit-tool" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id},'${item.title}','${item.url}','${item.icon}','${item.category}',${item.sort_index})"><i class="fas fa-pencil-alt"></i></button></div>
                        </div>`;
                });
            }
            $("#linkContainer").html(html);
        }

        function openLink(id, url) { callAPI("LogClick", { id: id }, function(){}); window.open(url, '_blank'); }
        function openAddModal() { $("#dataId").val(""); $("#dataTitle").val(""); $("#dataUrl").val("https://"); $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結"); linkModal.show(); }
        function openEditModal(id, t, u, i, c, s) { $("#dataId").val(id); $("#dataTitle").val(t); $("#dataUrl").val(u); $("#dataIcon").val(i); $("#dataCategory").val(c); $("#dataSort").val(s); $("#modalTitle").text("編輯連結"); linkModal.show(); }

        function submitData() {
            var id = $("#dataId").val();
            var d = { title: $("#dataTitle").val(), url: $("#dataUrl").val(), icon: $("#dataIcon").val(), category: $("#dataCategory").val(), sortIndex: parseInt($("#dataSort").val()) || 100 };
            var method = id ? "UpdateData" : "InsertData";
            var params = id ? { id: parseInt(id), ...d } : d;
            callAPI(method, params, function (r) { if(r.success) { linkModal.hide(); loadGrid(); } });
        }
    </script>

### 為什麼這樣改會通？ 1. 移除 `overflow: auto`：在手機端，`overflow: auto` 會讓內容在小框框內滑動，但也會把「彈出」的內容（選單）給關在裡面。改用 `flex-wrap: wrap` 讓按鈕在空間不夠時自動換行，這樣空間是開放的，選單就能順利向下彈出。 2. 移除 `data-bs-display="static"`：這個屬性會停用 Bootstrap 內建的定位計算引擎。現在我們讓它預設執行，它會自動找尋螢幕最適合的位置彈出。 3. 鎖定 `100vw`：透過 CSS 強制設定寬度為視窗寬度並隱藏溢出，保證了畫面不會因為選單彈出而產生左右晃動或變大的感覺。 您可以現在測試看看： 下拉選單應該會變得很靈敏，且點擊後會顯示在按鈕下方。

            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header border-0 pb-0">
                    <h5 class="fw-bold m-0" id="modalTitle">編輯連結</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <input type="hidden" id="dataId">
                    <div class="mb-3"><label class="small opacity-50">標題</label><input type="text" id="dataTitle" class="form-control"></div>
                    <div class="mb-3"><label class="small opacity-50">網址</label><input type="text" id="dataUrl" class="form-control"></div>
                    <div class="row">
                        <div class="col-6 mb-3"><label class="small opacity-50">分類</label>
                            <select id="dataCategory" class="form-select">
                                <option value="常用">常用</option><option value="開發">開發</option><option value="個人">個人</option>
                            </select>
                        </div>
                        <div class="col-6 mb-3"><label class="small opacity-50">排序權重</label><input type="number" id="dataSort" class="form-control" value="100"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3"><label class="small opacity-50">圖示</label>
                        <select id="dataIcon" class="form-select">
                            <option value="fa-link">一般連結</option><option value="fa-code">程式碼</option><option value="fa-folder">資料夾</option><option value="fa-eye">眼睛</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-footer border-0">
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary px-4" data-bs-dismiss="modal">取消</button>
                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary px-4" onclick="submitData()">儲存</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        var API_URL = "Hyperlinks.aspx";
        var currentCategory = "全部";
        var myModal;

        $(document).ready(function () {
            // 正確初始化 Modal
            var modalEl = document.getElementById('dataModal');
            if (modalEl) {
                myModal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalEl);
            }
            loadGrid();
        });

        function callAPI(method, data, successCallback) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: API_URL + "/" + method,
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) { successCallback(res.d); },
                error: function (xhr) { 
                    console.error(xhr.responseText);
                    $("#linkContainer").html("<div class='text-center py-5 text-danger'>API 連線失敗</div>");
                }
            });
        }

        function setCategory(cat, el) {
            currentCategory = cat;
            $(".pill").removeClass("active");
            $(el).addClass("active");
            loadGrid();
        }

        function loadGrid() {
            var params = { 
                searchKey: $("#inputSearch").val() || "",
                category: currentCategory,
                sortBy: $("#selSort").val() || "最新加入"
            };
            callAPI("GetData", params, function (r) {
                if (r.success) renderLinks(r.data);
                else $("#linkContainer").html("<div class='text-center py-5'>" + r.msg + "</div>");
            });
        }

        function renderLinks(list) {
            var html = "";
            if (!list || list.length === 0) {
                html = "<div class='text-center py-5 text-secondary opacity-50'>— 無資料 —</div>";
            } else {
                list.forEach(function (item, index) {
                    var isHighlight = (index === 0 && $("#inputSearch").val() === "" && currentCategory === "全部") ? "highlight" : "";
                    html += `
                        <div class="link-card ${isHighlight}">
                            <div class="stat-badge"><i class="fas fa-chart-line me-1"></i>${item.clicks}</div>
                            <div class="flex-grow-1 d-flex align-items-center" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openLink(${item.id}, '${item.url}')">
                                <div class="icon-box"><i class="fas ${item.icon}"></i></div>
                                <div class="link-info">
                                    <div class="link-title">${item.title}</div>
                                    <div class="link-url">${item.url.replace('https://','')}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="ps-3 border-start border-white border-opacity-10">
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="openEditModal(${item.id},'${item.title}','${item.url}','${item.icon}','${item.category}',${item.sort_index})"><i class="fas fa-pencil-alt"></i></button>
                                <button class="btn-mini-tool" onclick="doDelete(${item.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-danger"></i></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                });
            }
            $("#linkContainer").html(html);
        }

        function openLink(id, url) {
            callAPI("LogClick", { id: id }, function(){});
            window.open(url, '_blank');
        }

        function openAddModal() {
            $("#dataId").val(""); $("#dataTitle").val(""); $("#dataUrl").val("https://"); $("#dataSort").val("100");
            $("#modalTitle").text("新增連結");
            myModal.show();
        }

        function openEditModal(id, t, u, i, c, s) {
            $("#dataId").val(id); $("#dataTitle").val(t); $("#dataUrl").val(u); $("#dataIcon").val(i); $("#dataCategory").val(c); $("#dataSort").val(s);
            $("#modalTitle").text("編輯連結");
            myModal.show();
        }

        function submitData() {
            var id = $("#dataId").val();
            var d = { title: $("#dataTitle").val(), url: $("#dataUrl").val(), icon: $("#dataIcon").val(), category: $("#dataCategory").val(), sortIndex: parseInt($("#dataSort").val()) || 100 };
            var method = id ? "UpdateData" : "InsertData";
            var params = id ? { id: parseInt(id), ...d } : d;
            callAPI(method, params, function (r) { if(r.success) { myModal.hide(); loadGrid(); } else { Swal.fire("錯誤", r.msg, "error"); } });
        }

        function doDelete(id) {
            Swal.fire({ title: '確認刪除？', input: 'password', showCancelButton: true }).then(res => {
                if (res.isConfirmed) callAPI("DeleteData", { id: id, pwd: res.value }, function(r){ if(r.success) loadGrid(); else Swal.fire("錯誤", r.msg, "error"); });
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

Developing the Core Architecture I'm focused on the fundamental architectural choices for the AI-powered itinerary planner. I've decided to employ SQL Server as the database, HTML for the frontend, ASP.NET Web Forms (VB.NET) for the backend, and the Google Maps API for integration. I'm also planning to incorporate AI through an API, potentially OpenAI. I will use existing code logic (message4/hyperlinks) to build core functions. Refining the AI Integration I'm now detailing the AI integration. My process starts with user input (destination, dates, etc.) and moves to an AI prompt. The AI will then generate a JSON itinerary that I'll store in SQL Server, then display on Google Maps. Users can then select, edit, and delete plans. The database schema includes `Trips`, `ItineraryPlans`, and `ItineraryDetails` tables. I'm targeting an HTML5 frontend with CSS (Tailwind/Bootstrap), JS and jQuery for the backend.
🤖 GEMINI
這是一個非常有野心的專案！結合 AI (GPT-4) + Google Maps + SQL Server，能將「數據儲存」與「智能決策」完美結合。 作為專家，我建議將這個系統命名為 "Zen AI-Traveler"。開發重點在於：AI 產出結構化數據 (JSON)，讓 VB.NET 後端解析後存入 SQL Server，最後讓前端在地圖上繪製路徑。 以下是開發規劃與核心代碼實作： --- ### 一、 資料庫設計 (SQL Server) 我們需要儲存「行程需求」與「AI 建議的細節」。
sql
-- 1. 行程主表
CREATE TABLE TravelTrips (
    TripID INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    Title NVARCHAR(200),        -- 行程標題 (如: 東京五天四夜櫻花季)
    Destination NVARCHAR(100),  -- 目的地
    Days INT,                   -- 天數
    Preferences NVARCHAR(MAX),  -- 使用者需求 (如: 要吃和牛、不要走路太累)
    CreatedAt DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
);

-- 2. AI 方案表 (一組需求可以有 A, B, C 三種方案)
CREATE TABLE TravelPlans (
    PlanID INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    TripID INT,
    PlanName NVARCHAR(50),      -- 方案 A (文青風), 方案 B (美食控)
    TotalCost NVARCHAR(100),    -- 預估預算
    PlanSummary NVARCHAR(MAX),  -- 方案總結
    FOREIGN KEY (TripID) REFERENCES TravelTrips(TripID)
);

-- 3. 每日行程細點 (整合 Google Maps 座標)
CREATE TABLE PlanDetails (
    DetailID INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    PlanID INT,
    DayNum INT,                 -- 第幾天
    StartTime NVARCHAR(20),     -- 開始時間 (如: 09:00)
    LocationName NVARCHAR(200), -- 地點名稱
    Lat DECIMAL(10, 8),         -- 緯度
    Lng DECIMAL(11, 8),         -- 經度
    ActivityDescription NVARCHAR(MAX), -- 活動描述
    FOREIGN KEY (PlanID) REFERENCES TravelPlans(PlanID)
);

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO
Imports Newtonsoft.Json ' 需要安裝此 DLL 用於處理 JSON

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class Planner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString
    Private Shared ReadOnly OpenAI_Key As String = "你的_OPENAI_API_KEY"

    ' 1. 生成行程：呼叫 AI
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlans(ByVal destination As String, ByVal days As Integer, ByVal prefs As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 組合 Prompt 請求 AI 產出 JSON 格式
            Dim prompt As String = $"請幫我規劃{destination}{days}天的旅遊行程。使用者偏好：{prefs}。請提供兩組不同方案(方案A與方案B)，並以 JSON 格式回傳。包含地點名稱、預計時間、座標(Lat/Lng)、以及簡單描述。"
            
            Dim aiResponse As String = CallOpenAI(prompt) ' 封裝呼叫 OpenAI 的函式
            
            ' 解析 JSON 並存入資料庫 (此處省略部分解析邏輯，直接回傳 AI 結果給前端選)
            Return New With {.success = True, .aiData = aiResponse}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 2. 儲存使用者選擇的方案
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function SaveSelectedPlan(ByVal tripTitle As String, ByVal planData As Object) As Object
        ' 這裡實作將前端選定的 AI JSON 寫入 TravelTrips / TravelPlans / PlanDetails
        ' 使用您熟悉的 SqlTransaction 確保資料完整
        Return New With {.success = True}
    End Function

    ' 呼叫 OpenAI 的共用函式
    Private Shared Function CallOpenAI(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        ' 使用 HttpWebRequest 呼叫 OpenAI API (GPT-4o)
        ' ... 此處實作 POST 請求與 API Key 認證 ...
        Return "{ ""plans"": [...] }" ' 回傳結構化 JSON
    End Function
End Class

-- 1. 行程主表 (儲存使用者的需求)
CREATE TABLE TravelTrips (
    TripID INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    Title NVARCHAR(200),        -- 行程標題
    Destination NVARCHAR(100),  -- 目的地
    Days INT,                   -- 天數

);

);

--- ### 第三階段：AI 串接規劃 (VB.NET + Gemini API) 為了實現「免費串接」，我們選擇 Google Gemini 1.5 Flash（速度快且免費額度高）。 #### 1. 取得 API KEY 請至 [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/) 點擊 "Get API key"。 #### 2. VB.NET 核心代碼 (串接邏輯) 這是放置在 `Planner.aspx.vb` 內的 `WebMethod` 範例。
vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization ' 用於 JSON 解析

<WebMethod()>
Public Shared Function GetAIPlanFromGemini(ByVal dest As String, ByVal days As String, ByVal pref As String) As Object
    Try
        ' 1. 設定 Gemini API URL 與 Key
        Dim apiKey As String = "你的_GEMINI_API_KEY"
        Dim apiUrl As String = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=" & apiKey

        ' 2. 撰寫專業的 Prompt (要求 AI 回傳 JSON)
        Dim promptText As String = $"你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請規劃{dest}{days}天行程。偏好：{pref}。" &
            "請嚴格以 JSON 格式回傳，格式如下：{""planName"":""..."",""summary"":""..."",""details"":[{""day"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""...""}]}" &
            "請確保 lat 和 lng 座標精準。"

        ' 3. 建立請求物件
        Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(apiUrl), HttpWebRequest)
        request.Method = "POST"
        request.ContentType = "application/json"

        ' 4. 組合 JSON Body
        Dim jsonBody As String = "{""contents"": [{""parts"":[{""text"": """ & promptText & """}]}]}"
        
        Using streamWriter = New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
            streamWriter.Write(jsonBody)
        End Using

        ' 5. 取得回應
        Dim response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
        Dim result As String = ""
        Using streamReader = New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
            result = streamReader.ReadToEnd()
        End Using

        ' 6. 解析 AI 回傳的 JSON (此處需依 Gemini 格式解析後存入 SQL Server)
        ' 提示：Gemini 的回傳結構較深，需讀取 candidates[0].content.parts[0].text
        
        Return New With {.success = True, .rawJson = result}
        
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function
--- ### 專家開發建議： 1. 為什麼要用 Gemini 1.5 Flash？ * 速度：它產生行程的速度比 GPT-4 快很多，適合手機即時顯示。 * 座標準確度：Google 的模型對自家 Google Maps 上的地點座標（Lat/Lng）掌握度非常高。 2. 關於「不同方案」的實現： * 您可以修改 Prompt，告訴 AI：「請提供兩組方案：方案A主打美食，方案B主打風景」。 * AI 會在一個 JSON 內回傳兩個陣列，您在 VB 端接收後分別寫入 `TravelPlans` 資料表。 3. 座標校正機制： * 由於 AI 有時候會胡說八道（幻覺），建議在前端 JS 中加入一段邏輯：如果 AI 給的 Lat/Lng 是 0 或偏移太遠，就用 Google Maps JavaScript API 的 `Geocoding Service` 自動補正。 4. 與「定位程式碼」連動： * 您的舊專案中應該有 `google.maps.Marker` 和 `InfoWindow` 的邏輯。在顯示 AI 行程時，您可以直接跑一個 `forEach` 迴圈把 `PlanDetails` 的座標畫在地圖上，並用 `Polyline` 把點連成一條線，這就是旅遊路線圖了！ 您想先測試 SQL 資料庫讀取顯示到地圖上，還是直接挑戰 Gemini API 的對接？

--- ### 為什麼這會解決問題？ 1. `SCOPE_IDENTITY()`：這是 SQL 專家最常用的技巧。它能抓取在同一個執行區塊中，「最後一個產生的自增主鍵 (Identity)」。這樣就算你之前執行過多次導致 ID 變成 10、11、12...，這個腳本依然能精準地把資料串在一起。 2. 變數傳遞：我們把 `TripID` 傳給 `TravelPlans`，再把 `PlanID` 傳給 `PlanDetails`，這就是標準的父子關聯流程。 3. 刪除順序：在清空資料時，必須先刪除最底層的 `PlanDetails`，否則會因為外鍵保護而無法刪除上層資料。 執行這段後，你的 5 筆測試資料就會完美地存入資料庫了。接下來，我們就可以準備開發 VB.NET 讀取這些資料並顯示在 Google Map 上的功能囉！

太棒了！既然資料庫已經準備好且有了 5 筆測試資料，我們現在進入開發的核心階段。 接下來我要為您規劃的是：「如何讀取這些資料並顯示在 Google 地圖上」。這是實踐 AI 行程的第一步——讓使用者「看見」路線。 我將為您撰寫 VB.NET 後端 API 與 前端地圖顯示網頁。 --- ### 1. 後端 VB.NET API (`TravelPlanner.aspx.vb`) 我們需要一個 `WebMethod` 來讀取資料庫裡的 `PlanDetails` 並回傳給前端。
vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class TravelPlanner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    ' 讀取特定方案的地點細節
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetPlanDetails(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim locations As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 照天數與順序排列
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT * FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("name", dr("LocationName").ToString())
                    row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lat")))
                    row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lng")))
                    row.Add("desc", dr("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                    row.Add("time", dr("ArriveTime").ToString())
                    row.Add("day", dr("DayNum"))
                    locations.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = locations}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class
--- ### 2. 前端地圖展示頁面 (`TravelPlanner.aspx`) 這部分會整合您之前的「定位程式碼」邏輯，並加入 Polyline (路徑連線) 功能。
html
<%@ Page Language="VB" AutoEventWireup="false" CodeFile="TravelPlanner.aspx.vb" Inherits="TravelPlanner" %>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Zen AI Traveler - 行程預覽</title>
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <!-- 請替換為您的 Google Maps API Key -->
    <script src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=YOUR_GOOGLE_KEY"></script>
    <style>
        body { background-color: #050a15; color: white; }
        #map { width: 100%; height: 450px; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
        .location-item { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-left: 4px solid #3b82f6; transition: 0.3s; }
        .location-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="p-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto">

    <div class="mb-6">
        <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400">📍 行程路線預覽</h2>
        <p class="text-gray-400 text-sm">正在檢視：方案A - 北海岸與市區文創</p>
    </div>

    <!-- 地圖容器 -->
    <div id="map" class="mb-6"></div>

    <!-- 行程清單 -->
    <div id="locationList" class="space-y-3">
        <!-- 資料由 JS 動態填入 -->
    </div>

    <script>
        let map;
        let markers = [];
        let flightPath; // 路線連線

        $(document).ready(function() {
            initMap();
            loadPlan(1); // 先讀取我們剛才注入的 PlanID = 1
        });

        function initMap() {
            const defaultCenter = { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.565 };
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById("map"), {
                zoom: 12,
                center: defaultCenter,
                styles: [ /* 這裡可以放入您的暗色地圖樣式 */ ]
            });
        }

        function loadPlan(pid) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: pid }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    const data = res.d;
                    if (data.success) {
                        drawRoute(data.data);
                        renderList(data.data);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function drawRoute(locations) {
            // 1. 清除舊的 Marker
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null));
            markers = [];

            const pathCoords = [];
            const bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();

            locations.forEach((loc, index) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                pathCoords.push(pos);

                // 2. 建立 Marker (標註第幾站)
                const marker = new google.maps.Marker({
                    position: pos,
                    map: map,
                    label: (index + 1).toString(),
                    title: loc.name
                });
                markers.push(marker);
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });

            // 3. 畫出藍色路徑線
            if (flightPath) flightPath.setMap(null);
            flightPath = new google.maps.Polyline({
                path: pathCoords,
                geodesic: true,
                strokeColor: "#3b82f6",
                strokeOpacity: 0.8,
                strokeWeight: 4
            });
            flightPath.setMap(map);

            // 4. 自動調整地圖縮放以看見所有點
            map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function renderList(locations) {
            let html = "";
            locations.forEach((loc, index) => {
                html += `
                <div class="location-item p-4 rounded-r-xl">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-start">
                        <span class="bg-blue-600 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded">第 ${index+1} 站 - ${loc.time}</span>
                        <span class="text-gray-500 text-xs">Day ${loc.day}</span>
                    </div>
                    <h4 class="font-bold mt-1 text-lg">${loc.name}</h4>
                    <p class="text-gray-400 text-sm mt-1">${loc.desc}</p>
                </div>`;
            });
            $("#locationList").html(html);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
--- ### 本階段開發重點 (專家經驗談)： 1. 為什麼要用 Polyline？ 單純放 Marker 使用者會不知道先後順序。畫出藍色連線後，行程感就出來了。 2. `fitBounds` 的重要性： 不管行程在台北、京都還是台東，地圖都會自動縮放到適合的大小，使用者不用手動去找 Marker 在哪裡。 3. 座標格式轉化： SQL 存的是 `Decimal`，VB 讀取後需轉為 `Double`，前端 JS 再餵給 Google Map。這條路徑如果沒通，地圖會畫不出來，我程式碼中已經處理好轉換了。 --- ### 下一階段預告： 您可以先將這段代碼佈署，確認地圖能正確畫出您注入的那 5 筆資料。 如果一切正常，我們接下來就要開發：「使用者輸入需求 -> 呼叫 Gemini AI API -> AI 回傳行程 -> VB 解析並存入資料庫」。這才是這個專案最神奇的地方！ 您準備好要開始「串接 Gemini AI」了嗎？

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class TravelPlanner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    ' 1. 讀取資料庫中的 5 筆測試行程
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetPlanDetails(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim locations As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT * FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                conn.Open()
                Dim dr As SqlDataReader = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("name", dr("LocationName").ToString())
                    row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lat")))
                    row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lng")))
                    row.Add("desc", dr("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                    row.Add("time", dr("ArriveTime").ToString())
                    locations.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = locations}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 2. (預留) 呼叫 AI 的接口
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function AskAIForPlan(ByVal destination As String, ByVal days As Integer, ByVal prefs As String) As Object
        ' 這裡未來會放入 Gemini API 的串接程式碼
        Return New With {.success = True, .msg = "AI 正在思考中..."}
    End Function
End Class

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Zen AI Traveler v1.0</title>
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11"></script>
    
    <style>
        body { background-color: #050a15; color: white; font-family: "Microsoft JhengHei"; }
        #map { height: 400px; width: 100%; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
        .glass-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 15px; }
        .step-num { width: 24px; height: 24px; background: #3b82f6; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="p-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto">

    <!-- 標題 -->
    <div class="mb-6 flex justify-between items-end">
        <div>
            <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400">Zen AI 行程大師</h2>
            <p class="text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1">結合 AI 規劃與您的定位庫</p>
        </div>
        <button onclick="askAI()" class="bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold shadow-lg shadow-blue-900/20">🪄 AI 規劃行程</button>
    </div>

    <!-- 地圖容器 -->
    <div class="relative mb-6">
        <div id="map"></div>
        <div class="absolute bottom-4 left-4 flex gap-2">
            <button onclick="backToUser()" class="bg-white text-black px-3 py-2 rounded-md shadow-lg text-xs font-bold">
                <i class="fas fa-location-arrow"></i> 回到我的位置
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 行程細節清單 -->
    <div id="locationList" class="space-y-3">
        <!-- 這裡會由 JS 填入 -->
    </div>

    <!-- 使用您提供的 Google Map Key -->
    <script src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=AIzaSyDystbcXoiY4Gdk22iOK_DZe0BoCSaRyk4&callback=initMap" async defer></script>

    <script>
        let map, userMarker, routeLine;
        let markers = [];

        function initMap() {
            const initialPos = { lat: 25.0339, lng: 121.5644 };
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), { 
                zoom: 14, 
                center: initialPos,
                gestureHandling: 'greedy',
                styles: [ /* 您可以加入 Dark Mode 樣式 JSON */ ]
            });

            // 您的藍色定位標點邏輯
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({
                position: initialPos, map: map,
                icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 },
                zIndex: 1000
            });

            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.watchPosition((p) => {
                    const pos = { lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude };
                    userMarker.setPosition(pos);
                }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
            }

            // 初始化後立刻載入我們 SQL 裡的 5 筆測試行程 (PlanID = 1)
            loadPlan(1);
        }

        function backToUser() {
            map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition());
            map.setZoom(16);
        }

        function loadPlan(pid) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: pid }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    if(res.d.success) {
                        drawRoute(res.d.data);
                        renderList(res.d.data);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function drawRoute(locations) {
            // 清除舊標記
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null));
            markers = [];
            if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);

            const path = [];
            const bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();

            locations.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                path.push(pos);
                bounds.extend(pos);

                // 行程站點標記
                const m = new google.maps.Marker({
                    position: pos,
                    map: map,
                    label: { text: (i+1).toString(), color: 'white', fontWeight: 'bold' },
                    title: loc.name
                });
                markers.push(m);
            });

            // 畫出路線連線
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({
                path: path, geodesic: true, strokeColor: '#3b82f6', strokeOpacity: 0.6, strokeWeight: 4
            });
            routeLine.setMap(map);
            map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function renderList(locations) {
            let html = "";
            locations.forEach((loc, i) => {
                html += `
                <div class="glass-card p-4 flex gap-4 items-start">
                    <div class="step-num mt-1">${i+1}</div>
                    <div class="flex-1">
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
                            <span class="font-bold text-lg text-blue-200">${loc.name}</span>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 bg-white/5 px-2 py-1 rounded">${loc.time}</span>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">${loc.desc}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            });
            $("#locationList").html(html);
        }

        function askAI() {
            Swal.fire({
                title: 'AI 規劃需求',
                html: '<input id="dest" class="swal2-input" placeholder="想去哪裡？">' +
                     '<textarea id="pref" class="swal2-textarea" placeholder="您的偏好 (例: 喜歡吃、不要走路)"></textarea>',
                confirmButtonText: '開始規劃',
                showLoaderOnConfirm: true,
                preConfirm: () => {
                    // 這裡之後串接 Gemini
                    return { dest: $('#dest').val(), pref: $('#pref').val() };
                }
            }).then((result) => {
                if (result.isConfirmed) {
                    Swal.fire("成功", "AI 已收到需求，即將產出路線！", "success");
                }
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<body class="p-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto">

    <!-- 頂部標題與 AI 按鈕 -->

    <script>
        let map, userMarker, routePath;
        let markers = [];

        // 1. 初始化地圖
        function initMap() {
            const initialPos = { lat: 25.0339, lng: 121.5644 };
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), { 
                zoom: 14, 
                center: initialPos,
                gestureHandling: 'greedy',
                disableDefaultUI: false,
                styles: [
                    { "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{ "color": "#242f3e" }] },
                    { "elementType": "labels.text.fill", "stylers": [{ "color": "#746855" }] },
                    { "featureType": "water", "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{ "color": "#17263c" }] }
                ] // 加入簡單的暗色模式樣式
            });

            // 藍色目前位置標記 (整合自您的 map.html)
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({
                position: initialPos,
                map: map,
                icon: {
                    path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE,
                    scale: 7,
                    fillColor: '#4285F4',
                    fillOpacity: 1,
                    strokeColor: 'white',
                    strokeWeight: 2
                },
                zIndex: 1000
            });

            // 即時追蹤定位
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.watchPosition((p) => {
                    const pos = { lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude };
                    userMarker.setPosition(pos);
                }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
            }

            // 讀取網址參數 id，若無則預設為 3
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const planId = urlParams.get('id') || 3;
            loadPlan(planId);
        }

        // 2. 回到目前位置
        function backToMe() {
            const pos = userMarker.getPosition();
            map.panTo(pos);
            map.setZoom(16);
        }

        // 3. 從 VB 後端讀取行程
        function loadPlan(pid) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function(res) {
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        if (res.d.data.length > 0) {
                            drawRoute(res.d.data);
                            renderList(res.d.data);
                        } else {
                            $("#locationList").html("<div class='text-center py-10 text-gray-500 text-sm'>此行程 ID ("+pid+") 尚無座標資料</div>");
                        }
                    } else {
                        Swal.fire("SQL 錯誤", res.d.msg, "error");
                    }
                },
                error: function(xhr) {
                    console.error(xhr.responseText);
                    Swal.fire("連線錯誤", "無法與後端 API 通訊", "error");
                }
            });
        }

        // 4. 在地圖上繪製路徑
        function drawRoute(locations) {
            // 清除舊標記與線段
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null));
            markers = [];
            if (routePath) routePath.setMap(null);

            const pathCoords = [];
            const bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();

            locations.forEach((loc, index) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                pathCoords.push(pos);
                bounds.extend(pos);

                // 建立行程站點 Marker
                const marker = new google.maps.Marker({
                    position: pos,
                    map: map,
                    label: {
                        text: (index + 1).toString(),
                        color: 'white',
                        fontWeight: 'bold'
                    },
                    title: loc.name
                });
                markers.push(marker);
            });

            // 繪製藍色路徑線段
            routePath = new google.maps.Polyline({
                path: pathCoords,
                geodesic: true,
                strokeColor: "#3b82f6",
                strokeOpacity: 0.7,
                strokeWeight: 4
            });
            routePath.setMap(map);

            // 自動縮放以顯示全景
            map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        // 5. 渲染行程文字清單
        function renderList(locations) {
            let html = "";
            locations.forEach((loc, index) => {
                html += `
                <div class="glass-card p-4 flex gap-4 items-start">
                    <div class="stop-badge flex-shrink-0 mt-1">${index + 1}</div>
                    <div class="flex-grow">
                        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
                            <h4 class="font-bold text-lg text-blue-200">${loc.name}</h4>
                            <span class="text-[10px] bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 px-2 py-1 rounded-md font-mono">${loc.time}</span>
                        </div>
                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">${loc.desc}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>`;
            });
            $("#locationList").html(html);
        }

        // 6. AI 規劃彈窗 (預留)
        function askAI() {
            Swal.fire({
                title: 'AI 智慧規劃',
                background: '#111827',
                color: '#fff',
                html: `
                    <div class="text-left">
                        <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">目的地</label>
                        <input id="dest" class="swal2-input !m-0 !w-full !mt-1 mb-3 bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-white" placeholder="例如：東京、花蓮">
                        <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">您的需求</label>
                        <textarea id="pref" class="swal2-textarea !m-0 !w-full !mt-1 bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-white" placeholder="例如：不要走路太累、想吃道地美食"></textarea>
                    </div>
                `,
                confirmButtonText: '開始規劃',
                showLoaderOnConfirm: true,
                preConfirm: () => {
                    const dest = $('#dest').val();
                    const pref = $('#pref').val();
                    if(!dest) return Swal.showValidationMessage('請輸入目的地');
                    return { dest, pref };
                }
            }).then((result) => {
                if (result.isConfirmed) {
                    Swal.fire("AI 正在思考", "即將串接 Gemini 產出 JSON 行程並寫入 SQL...", "info");
                }
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class TravelPlanner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString
    Private Shared ReadOnly Gemini_API_Key As String = "在此貼上你的_GEMINI_API_KEY"

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal destination As String, ByVal prefs As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 準備問 AI 的題目 (Prompt)
            ' 強制要求 AI 只回傳純 JSON，方便我們存入 SQL
            Dim promptText As String = $"你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請規劃{destination}的2天1夜行程。使用者偏好：{prefs}。" &
                "請嚴格以 JSON 格式回傳（不要任何贅字、不要 Markdown 標籤），格式如下： " &
                "{ ""title"": ""行程標題"", ""summary"": ""行程簡介"", ""details"": [ " &
                "{ ""day"": 1, ""order"": 1, ""location"": ""地點名"", ""lat"": 緯度數字, ""lng"": 經度數字, ""desc"": ""景點描述"", ""time"": ""預計時間"" } ] }"

            ' 2. 呼叫 Gemini API
            Dim aiRawResult As String = CallGeminiAPI(promptText)
            
            ' 清理 AI 回傳的字串（有時候 AI 會多給
json ...
標籤）
            aiRawResult = aiRawResult.Replace("
json", "").Replace("
", "").Trim()

            ' 3. 解析 JSON 並寫入資料庫
            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim planData = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(aiRawResult)

            Dim newPlanId As Integer = SavePlanToSQL(destination, planData, prefs)

            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newPlanId}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 呼叫 Google Gemini API 的核心函式
    Private Shared Function CallGeminiAPI(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Dim url As String = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=" & Gemini_API_Key
        Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
        request.Method = "POST"
        request.ContentType = "application/json"

        ' Gemini 要求的基本 JSON 結構
        Dim jsonBody As String = "{""contents"": [{""parts"":[{""text"": """ & prompt.Replace("""", "\""") & """}]}]}"
        
        Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
            sw.Write(jsonBody)
        End Using

        Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
            Using sr As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                Dim resText As String = sr.ReadToEnd()
                ' 解析 Gemini 的深層結構
                Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                Dim candidates = CType(resObj("candidates"), Array)
                Dim firstCandidate = CType(candidates(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                Dim content = CType(firstCandidate("content"), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                Dim parts = CType(content("parts"), Array)
                Dim firstPart = CType(parts(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                Return firstPart("text").ToString()
            End Using
        End Using
    End Function

    ' 將解析後的資料存入 SQL Server
    Private Shared Function SavePlanToSQL(ByVal dest As String, ByVal data As Dictionary(Of String, Object), ByVal prefs As String) As Integer
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                ' 1. 寫入 TravelTrips
                Dim sqlTrip As String = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p)"
                Dim cmdTrip As New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", data("title").ToString())
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", dest)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", prefs)
                Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

                ' 2. 寫入 TravelPlans
                Dim sqlPlan As String = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
                Dim cmdPlan As New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 智能方案")
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", data("summary").ToString())
                Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

                ' 3. 寫入 PlanDetails
                Dim details = CType(data("details"), Array)
                For Each d In details
                    Dim item = CType(d, Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                    Dim sqlDet As String = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) " &
                                         "VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", item("day"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", item("order"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", item("location").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", item("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", item("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next

                trans.Commit()
                Return planId
            Catch ex As Exception
                trans.Rollback()
                Throw ex
            End Try
        End Using
    End Function
End Class

javascript
function askAI() {
    Swal.fire({
        title: 'AI 智慧規劃',
        background: '#111827',
        color: '#fff',
        html: `
            <div class="text-left p-2">
                <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">目的地</label>
                <input id="dest" class="swal2-input !m-0 !w-full !mt-1 mb-3 bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-white" placeholder="例如：台南、首爾">
                <label class="text-xs text-gray-400">您的需求</label>
                <textarea id="pref" class="swal2-textarea !m-0 !w-full !mt-1 bg-slate-900 border-slate-800 text-white" placeholder="例如：我要帶長輩、想吃米其林、不想走路"></textarea>
            </div>
        `,
        confirmButtonText: '開始規劃',
        showLoaderOnConfirm: true,
        preConfirm: () => {
            const destination = $('#dest').val();
            const prefs = $('#pref').val();
            if(!destination) return Swal.showValidationMessage('請輸入目的地');

            // 呼叫 VB 後端
            return $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GenerateAIPlan",
                data: JSON.stringify({ destination, prefs }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json"
            }).then(response => {
                if (!response.d.success) throw new Error(response.d.msg);
                return response.d;
            }).catch(error => {
                Swal.showValidationMessage(`AI 出錯: ${error}`);
            });
        }
    }).then((result) => {
        if (result.isConfirmed) {
            const newId = result.value.newPlanId;
            Swal.fire({
                icon: 'success',
                title: '行程規劃完成！',
                text: 'AI 已將建議存入資料庫，現在為您在地圖上繪製路線。',
                timer: 2000
            });
            // 重新載入地圖顯示新行程
            loadPlan(newId);
        }

vb
' (請確保引用 Newtonsoft.Json 或是使用 JavaScriptSerializer)
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function SaveAIPlan(ByVal aiJson As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Object
    Try
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        ' 清理 AI 可能帶有的 Markdown 標籤
        Dim cleanJson = aiJson.Replace("
json", "").Replace("
", "").Trim()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(cleanJson)

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                ' 1. 存入 Trip
                Dim sqlTrip = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p)"
                Dim cmdTrip = New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", data("title").ToString())
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", data("destination").ToString())
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", originalPrefs)
                Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

                ' 2. 存入 Plan
                Dim sqlPlan = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
                Dim cmdPlan = New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 語音生成方案")
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", data("summary").ToString())
                Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

                ' 3. 存入 Details
                Dim details = CType(data("details"), Array)
                For Each d In details
                    Dim item = CType(d, Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                    Dim sqlDet = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) " &
                                 "VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet = New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", item("day"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", item("order"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", item("location").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", item("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", item("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next
                trans.Commit()
                Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = planId}
            Catch ex As Exception
                trans.Rollback()
                Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
            End Try
        End Using
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "JSON 解析失敗: " & ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function
