<%@ Page Language="VB" AutoEventWireup="false" CodeFile="TravelPlanner.aspx.vb" Inherits="TravelPlanner" %>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Zen AI Traveler 4.0 - 語音智旅</title>
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.10.5/font/bootstrap-icons.css">

    <style>
        :root { --bg: #0d1117; --card: #161b22; --primary: #58a6ff; }
        body { background: var(--bg); color: #c9d1d9; font-family: sans-serif; height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
        
        /* 佈局：上方地圖，下方對話 */
        #map-section { height: 45%; width: 100%; border-bottom: 2px solid #30363d; position: relative; }
        #chat-section { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; }
        
        #chat-window { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
        .bubble { max-width: 85%; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 15px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; }
        .user { align-self: flex-end; background: #238636; color: white; }
        .ai { align-self: flex-start; background: #30363d; border: 1px solid #444c56; }

        .controls { background: var(--card); padding: 10px; border-top: 1px solid #30363d; }
        #micBtn { width: 100%; padding: 12px; border-radius: 25px; border: none; background: #f85149; color: white; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; }
        #micBtn.active { background: #238636; animation: pulse 1.5s infinite; }
        
        @keyframes pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(35, 134, 54, 0.7); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(35, 134, 54, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(35, 134, 54, 0); } }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="map-section">
    <div id="map" style="height: 100%; width: 100%;"></div>
    <div style="position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 10px; z-index: 10;">
        <input type="password" id="apiKey" placeholder="🔑 Gemini API Key" class="bg-black/50 text-white text-xs p-1 rounded border border-white/20">
    </div>
</div>

<div id="chat-section">
    <div id="chat-window">
        <div class="bubble ai">您好！我是您的 AI 旅遊管家。請點擊下方麥克風，告訴我您想去哪裡、有什麼特別需求？</div>
    </div>

    <div class="controls">
        <div id="interim-box" class="text-center text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2 min-h-[15px]"></div>
        <button id="micBtn">🎤 點擊開始語音規劃</button>
        <div class="flex justify-between mt-2 px-2">
            <span id="status" class="text-[10px] text-gray-600">系統就緒</span>
            <button onclick="window.speechSynthesis.cancel()" class="text-[10px] text-red-400">停止朗讀</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=AIzaSyDystbcXoiY4Gdk22iOK_DZe0BoCSaRyk4&callback=initMap"></script>

<script>
    let map, userMarker, routePath, markers = [];
    let conversationHistory = [];
    const apiKeyInput = document.getElementById('apiKey');
    apiKeyInput.value = localStorage.getItem('gemini_travel_key') || '';

    // --- 1. 地圖邏輯 ---
    function initMap() {
        map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
            center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
            styles: [{ "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{ "color": "#242f3e" }] }]
        });
        userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({
            map: map, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 6, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white' }
        });
        if (navigator.geolocation) {
            navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }));
        }
    }

    // --- 2. 語音辨識 (STT) 邏輯 ---
    const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
    recognition.lang = 'zh-TW';
    recognition.interimResults = true;
    let isListening = false;

    document.getElementById('micBtn').onclick = () => {
        if (!isListening) {
            window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
            recognition.start();
            isListening = true;
            micBtn.classList.add('active');
            micBtn.innerText = "🎧 正在聽您說話...";
        } else {
            recognition.stop();
        }
    };

    recognition.onresult = (event) => {
        let result = event.results[0][0].transcript;
        document.getElementById('interim-box').innerText = result;
        if (event.results[0].isFinal) {
            addBubble(result, 'user');
            processAI(result);
            stopMic();
        }
    };

    function stopMic() {
        isListening = false;
        micBtn.classList.remove('active');
        micBtn.innerText = "🎤 點擊開始語音規劃";
        document.getElementById('interim-box').innerText = "";
    }

    // --- 3. AI 邏輯：整合 Gemini ---
    async function processAI(userText) {
        const key = apiKeyInput.value.trim();
        if (!key) return alert("請輸入 API Key");
        localStorage.setItem('gemini_travel_key', key);

        // 核心 Prompt：要求 AI 聊天之餘，若是規劃行程，必須附帶 JSON
        const systemPrompt = "你是一個旅遊管家。請先親切地回答使用者的問題。如果涉及到規劃行程，請在回答內容的最後，附上一個嚴格格式的 JSON 區塊（用
json 包裹），包含 title, destination, summary, 以及 details 列表(包含 day, order, location, lat, lng, desc, time)。"; try { const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=${key}`; const body = { contents: [...conversationHistory, { role: "user", parts: [{ text: systemPrompt + "\n使用者說：" + userText }] }] }; const resp = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body), headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} }); const data = await resp.json(); const aiText = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text; // 顯示文字泡泡 const cleanDisplayContent = aiText.split("
json")[0]; // 只顯示對話部分
            addBubble(cleanDisplayContent, 'ai');
            speak(cleanDisplayContent);

            // 偵測 JSON 並存入 SQL
            if (aiText.includes("
json")) { const jsonPart = aiText.split("
json")[1].split("```")[0];
                saveToSQL(jsonPart, userText);
            }

            conversationHistory.push({ role: "user", parts: [{ text: userText }] });
            conversationHistory.push({ role: "model", parts: [{ text: aiText }] });
        } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
    }

    // --- 4. 資料庫連動與地圖更新 ---
    function saveToSQL(jsonStr, prefs) {
        $.ajax({
            type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/SaveAIPlan",
            data: JSON.stringify({ aiJson: jsonStr, originalPrefs: prefs }),
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            success: function(res) {
                if (res.d.success) {
                    loadPlanData(res.d.newPlanId);
                    Swal.fire({ toast: true, position: 'top', icon: 'success', title: '行程已存入 SQL 並繪製地圖', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 2000 });
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function loadPlanData(pid) {
        $.ajax({
            type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
            data: JSON.stringify({ planId: pid }),
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            success: function(res) {
                if (res.d.success) drawRouteOnMap(res.d.data);
            }
        });
    }

    function drawRouteOnMap(locations) {
        markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null));
        markers = [];
        if (routePath) routePath.setMap(null);
        const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();

        locations.forEach((loc, i) => {
            const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
            path.push(pos);
            const m = new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i+1).toString() });
            markers.push(m);
            bounds.extend(pos);
        });
        routePath = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 4 });
        map.fitBounds(bounds);
    }

    function addBubble(text, role) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = `bubble ${role}`;
        div.innerText = text;
        const win = document.getElementById('chat-window');
        win.appendChild(div);
        win.scrollTop = win.scrollHeight;
    }

    function speak(text) {
        const msg = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
        msg.lang = 'zh-TW'; msg.rate = 1.2;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(msg);
    }
</script>
</body>
</html>

<body>

<div class="container">
    <!-- 頂部地圖 -->
    <div id="map"></div>

    <!-- 主工作站 -->
    <div class="glass-panel">
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
            <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent">AI 智旅工作站</h1>
            <input type="password" id="apiKey" placeholder="🔑 Gemini Key" class="bg-black/50 text-xs p-2 rounded border border-gray-700 w-40">
        </div>

        <!-- 儀表板 -->
        <div class="dashboard">
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-label">規劃目的地</div>
                <div id="activeDest" class="stat-value">未設定</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-label">目前狀態</div>
                <div id="statusInfo" class="stat-value">等待輸入...</div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
                <div class="stat-label">需求字數</div>
                <div id="charCount" class="stat-value">0</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 編輯區 -->
        <div class="mb-6">
            <textarea id="userInput" placeholder="請直接輸入或使用語音說出您的旅遊願望...&#10;例如：我想去台南兩天一夜，要吃牛肉湯，不要走太多路。"></textarea>
        </div>

        <!-- 控制區 -->
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
            <button id="recordBtn" class="btn btn-record"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音輸入</button>
            <button id="aiBtn" class="btn btn-ai"><i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 智慧規劃行程</button>
            <button onclick="clearAll()" class="btn border border-gray-600 text-gray-400"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i> 清除</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Google Maps -->
<script src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=AIzaSyDystbcXoiY4Gdk22iOK_DZe0BoCSaRyk4&callback=initMap" async defer></script>

<script>
    let map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [];
    const userInput = document.getElementById('userInput');
    const recordBtn = document.getElementById('recordBtn');
    const aiBtn = document.getElementById('aiBtn');
    const apiKeyInput = document.getElementById('apiKey');

    apiKeyInput.value = localStorage.getItem('gemini_travel_key') || '';

    // 1. 地圖初始化
    function initMap() {
        map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
            center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 13,
            styles: [{ "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{ "color": "#242f3e" }] }]
        });
        userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({
            map: map, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 6, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white' }
        });
    }

    // 2. 語音辨識 (STT) - 移植自 voiceinput1.html
    const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
    recognition.lang = 'zh-TW';
    recognition.continuous = true;
    recognition.interimResults = true;

    let isRecording = false;
    recognition.onresult = (e) => {
        let text = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < e.results.length; i++) {
            let t = e.results[i][0].transcript;
            // 語音指令處理
            t = t.replace(/換行/g, "\n").replace(/句號/g, "。").replace(/逗號/g, "，");
            text += t;
        }
        userInput.value = text;
        document.getElementById('charCount').innerText = text.length;
    };

    recordBtn.onclick = () => {
        if (!isRecording) {
            recognition.start();
            recordBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-stop"></i> 停止錄音';
            recordBtn.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById('statusInfo').innerText = "聆聽中...";
        } else {
            recognition.stop();
            recordBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音輸入';
            recordBtn.classList.remove('active');
            document.getElementById('statusInfo').innerText = "錄音完成";
        }
        isRecording = !isRecording;
    };

    // 3. AI 智慧規劃連動
    async function runAI() {
        const key = apiKeyInput.value.trim();
        const text = userInput.value.trim();
        if (!key || !text) { Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入 Key 與旅遊偏好", "warning"); return; }
        
        localStorage.setItem('gemini_travel_key', key);
        aiBtn.disabled = true;
        document.getElementById('statusInfo').innerText = "AI 規劃中...";
        Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 規劃中', text: '正在計算最佳路線並寫入資料庫...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

        // A. 先呼叫 Gemini 取得 JSON
        try {
            const prompt = `你是一個導覽專家。請根據以下偏好規劃2天行程，目的地請從文字中判斷。請嚴格回傳 JSON (不要Markdown標籤)：{ "title": "...", "destination": "...", "summary": "...", "details": [ {"day":1, "order":1, "location":"...", "lat":0, "lng":0, "desc":"...", "time":"..."} ] } \n偏好：${text}`;
            const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent?key=${key}`;
            const resp = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] })
            });
            const data = await resp.json();
            const aiJson = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text.replace(/
json/g, "").replace(/
/g, "").trim();

            // B. 呼叫 VB 後端 SaveAIPlan
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/SaveAIPlan",
                data: JSON.stringify({ aiJson: aiJson, originalPrefs: text }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        document.getElementById('statusInfo').innerText = "規劃完成";
                        loadRoute(res.d.newPlanId);
                    }
                }
            });
        } catch (err) {
            Swal.fire("錯誤", "AI 通訊失敗", "error");
            aiBtn.disabled = false;
        }
    }

    aiBtn.onclick = runAI;

    // 4. 讀取並繪製地圖
    function loadRoute(pid) {
        $.ajax({
            type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
            data: JSON.stringify({ planId: pid }),
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            success: function(res) {
                if (res.d.success) drawMap(res.d.data);
            }
        });
    }

    function drawMap(locations) {
        markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null));
        markers = [];
        if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);

        const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
        locations.forEach((loc, i) => {
            const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
            path.push(pos);
            const m = new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i+1).toString() });
            markers.push(m);
            bounds.extend(pos);
        });
        routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 4 });
        map.fitBounds(bounds);
        document.getElementById('activeDest').innerText = locations[0].name.substring(0,6);
        aiBtn.disabled = false;
    }

    function clearAll() {
        userInput.value = "";
        document.getElementById('charCount').innerText = "0";
    }
</script>
</body>
</html>
### 為什麼這份代碼符合您的需求？ 1. 工作站佈局： - 上方是地圖，下方是大型編輯區。這比聊天泡泡更適合處理「複雜的旅遊規劃」。 - 使用了您喜歡的 `voiceinput1.html` 的按鈕脈衝動畫與深色卡片風格。 2. 語音聽寫與手動混合： - 您可以先用麥克風說一段話，AI 會將語音轉成文字填入 Textarea。 - 如果 AI 聽錯了，或是您想增加細節，可以直接在 Textarea 裡手動打字。 3. 雙層 AI 處理： - 點擊「智慧規劃」後，前端會先去問 Gemini (API)，拿到行程 JSON。 - 然後自動將 JSON 丟給 VB 後端存入資料庫。 - 存完後立刻連動地圖，畫出路線。 4. 系統穩定： - 保留了 API Key 本地存儲，下次進來不用重貼。 - 保留了 Google Maps 藍色即時定位，方便您在路上比對位置。 這就是結合了 「專業輸入工具」 與 「地圖展示系統」 的最終進化版！您可以直接佈署測試。

    偏好內容：${text}`;

    // --- 彈性調用邏輯 ---
    for (let i = 0; i < models.length; i++) {
        const modelName = models[i];

                finalAiJson = rawText.replace(/
json/g, "").replace(/
/g, "").trim();

                break; // 成功獲取資料，跳出迴圈

                console.warn(`${modelName} 失敗，準備切換下一個...`);

🤖 GEMINI
這個錯誤發生在 VB.NET 後端。 原因： `JavaScriptSerializer` 在解析 JSON 陣列時，會將其轉換為 `System.Collections.ArrayList`，而不是傳統的 `System.Array`。所以當程式執行 `CType(data("details"), Array)` 時，就會因為類型不匹配而崩潰。 請將您的 `TravelPlanner.aspx.vb` 中的 `SaveAIPlan` 函式修改為以下修正版（重點在於使用 `IEnumerable` 或直接對 `ArrayList` 進行迴圈）： ### 修正後的 VB.NET 後端 (`TravelPlanner.aspx.vb`) 請取代原有的 `SaveAIPlan` 函式：
vb
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function SaveAIPlan(ByVal aiJson As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Object
    Try
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        ' 清理 AI 可能帶有的 Markdown 標籤
        Dim cleanJson = aiJson.Replace("
json", "").Replace("
", "").Trim()
        
        ' 增加一個保險：確保 JSON 字串從 { 開始
        If Not cleanJson.StartsWith("{") Then
            cleanJson = cleanJson.Substring(cleanJson.indexOf("{"))
        End If

        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(cleanJson)

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                ' 1. 寫入 TravelTrips
                Dim sqlTrip As String = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p)"
                Dim cmdTrip As New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", data("title").ToString())
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", data("destination").ToString())
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", originalPrefs)
                Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

                ' 2. 寫入 TravelPlans
                Dim sqlPlan As String = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
                Dim cmdPlan As New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 語音生成方案")
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", data("summary").ToString())
                Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

                ' --- 關鍵修正處：處理 ArrayList 迴圈 ---
                ' 移除 CType(..., Array)，改用直接遍歷 Object
                Dim detailsObj As Object = data("details")
                
                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(detailsObj, IEnumerable)
                    Dim sqlDet As String = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) " & _
                                         "VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", item("day"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", item("order"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", item("location").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", item("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", item("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next

                trans.Commit()
                Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = planId}
            Catch ex As Exception
                trans.Rollback()
                Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "SQL 執行錯誤: " & ex.Message}
            End Try
        End Using
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "JSON 解析或轉換失敗: " & ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function
### 修正重點： 1. 類型轉換修正：將 `CType(data("details"), Array)` 改為 `CType(detailsObj, IEnumerable)`。在 VB.NET 中，`ArrayList` 實作了 `IEnumerable` 介面，這樣 `For Each` 迴圈就能正確讀取裡面的每一個地點物件（Dictionary）。 2. 保險機制：在存入 SQL 前，多加了 `cleanJson.StartsWith("{")` 的判斷，防止 AI 回傳的字串開頭有雜質。 3. 續行符號：修正了 VB.NET 長字串的續行符號 `_`，確保編譯正確。 請將此程式碼替換到您的 `.aspx.vb` 中。 現在前端 AI 應該能成功拿到 JSON，而後端也能順利拆解並存入 SQL 了！存檔成功後，地圖就會自動畫出墾丁的行程了。

vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class ItineraryResult
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    ' 讀取完整行程報告
    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetFullReport(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            Dim details As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 一次撈取主表與方案資訊
                Dim sqlMain As String = "SELECT t.Title, t.Destination, p.PlanSummary FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                                       "JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID WHERE p.PlanID = @pid"
                Dim cmdMain As New SqlCommand(sqlMain, conn)
                cmdMain.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                conn.Open()
                Dim drMain = cmdMain.ExecuteReader()
                If drMain.Read() Then
                    result.Add("title", drMain("Title").ToString())
                    result.Add("destination", drMain("Destination").ToString())
                    result.Add("summary", drMain("PlanSummary").ToString())
                End If
                drMain.Close()

                ' 撈取每日細節
                Dim sqlDetails As String = "SELECT * FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDetails, conn)
                cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Dim drDet = cmdDet.ExecuteReader()
                While drDet.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("day", drDet("DayNum"))
                    row.Add("location", drDet("LocationName").ToString())
                    row.Add("time", drDet("ArriveTime").ToString())
                    row.Add("desc", drDet("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                    row.Add("lat", drDet("Lat"))
                    row.Add("lng", drDet("Lng"))
                    details.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using

            result.Add("details", details)
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

html
<%@ Page Language="VB" AutoEventWireup="false" CodeFile="ItineraryResult.aspx.vb" Inherits="ItineraryResult" %>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>行程規劃報告</title>
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        body { background-color: #0d1117; color: #c9d1d9; font-family: sans-serif; }
        .timeline-line { position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: #30363d; z-index: 0; }
        .timeline-dot { position: absolute; left: 13px; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #58a6ff; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #0d1117; z-index: 1; }
        .day-header { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1f6feb 0%, transparent 100%); }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="max-w-2xl mx-auto p-6">
        <!-- 頂部操作 -->
        <div class="flex justify-between mb-8">
            <button onclick="history.back()" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-white"><i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> 返回編輯</button>
            <button onclick="window.print()" class="bg-gray-800 px-3 py-1 rounded text-sm"><i class="fas fa-print"></i> 列印行程</button>
        </div>

        <!-- 行程標題與簡介 -->
        <div id="header-area" class="mb-10 text-center">
            <h1 id="trip-title" class="text-3xl font-bold text-white mb-2">正在載入行程...</h1>
            <p id="trip-summary" class="text-gray-400 italic px-4"></p>
        </div>

        <!-- 時間軸清單 -->
        <div id="timeline-container" class="relative">
            <!-- 由 JS 動態產生 -->
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        $(document).ready(function() {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const planId = urlParams.get('id');
            if(planId) loadFullReport(planId);
        });

        function loadFullReport(pid) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "ItineraryResult.aspx/GetFullReport",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    if(res.d.success) renderReport(res.d.data);
                }
            });
        }

        function renderReport(data) {
            $("#trip-title").text(data.title);
            $("#trip-summary").text(data.summary);

            let html = "";
            let currentDay = 0;

            data.details.forEach((item) => {
                // 檢查是否為新的一天
                if (item.day !== currentDay) {
                    currentDay = item.day;
                    html += `
                        <div class="day-header p-2 mt-8 mb-4 rounded font-bold text-white">
                            <i class="fas fa-calendar-day mr-2"></i> DAY ${currentDay}
                        </div>`;
                }

                html += `
                    <div class="relative pl-12 pb-8">
                        <div class="timeline-line"></div>
                        <div class="timeline-dot mt-1"></div>
                        <div class="bg-gray-900/50 border border-gray-800 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg">
                            <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                                <h3 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-lg">${item.location}</h3>
                                <span class="text-xs bg-blue-900/30 text-blue-300 px-2 py-1 rounded font-mono">${item.time}</span>
                            </div>
                            <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">${item.desc}</p>
                            <div class="mt-3 text-[10px] text-gray-600">
                                <i class="fas fa-map-marker-alt"></i> ${item.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${item.lng.toFixed(4)}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
            });
            $("#timeline-container").html(html);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

javascript
async function runAI() {
    const keyInput = document.getElementById('apiKey');
    const key = keyInput.value.trim();
    const text = userInput.value.trim();
    
    // 1. 基本檢查
    if (!key) { 
        Swal.fire("提示", "請在左上角輸入您的 Gemini API Key", "warning"); 
        return; 
    }
    if (!text) { 
        Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入您的旅遊願望 (例如：去花蓮看海吃麻糬)", "info"); 
        return; 
    }
    
    // 2. 儲存 Key 到本地儲存空間
    localStorage.setItem('gemini_travel_key', key);
    aiBtn.disabled = true;
    
    // 3. 設定備援模型清單 (依照您 2026 實測成功的清單)
    const models = ["gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash-lite", "gemini-1.5-pro"];
    let finalAiJson = "";
    let lastErrorMsg = "";

    // 4. 啟動 Loading 動畫
    Swal.fire({ 
        title: 'AI 智慧規劃中', 
        html: '<div id="ai-step" class="text-sm">正在初始化路徑計算通道...</div>', 
        background: '#111827',
        color: '#fff',
        allowOutsideClick: false, 
        didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() 
    });

    // 5. 組合 Prompt (要求 AI 嚴格遵守 JSON 格式)
    const prompt = `你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請根據以下需求規劃2天行程，目的地請從需求中判斷。
    請嚴格回傳「純 JSON 格式」，不要有任何 Markdown 標籤或是前言後語，格式如下：
    { 
        "title": "行程標題", 
        "destination": "目的地城市", 
        "summary": "行程亮點簡介", 
        "details": [ 
            {"day":1, "order":1, "location":"地點名", "lat":緯度數字, "lng":經度數字, "desc":"景點描述", "time":"建議抵達時間"} 
        ] 
    }
    使用者需求內容：${text}`;

    // 6. 輪詢各個模型通道
    for (let i = 0; i < models.length; i++) {
        const modelName = models[i];
        $("#ai-step").html(`正在嘗試模型通道: <b class="text-blue-400">${modelName}</b>...`);

        try {
            const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${modelName}:generateContent?key=${key}`;
            const resp = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] })
            });

            const data = await resp.json();

            if (resp.ok && data.candidates && data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text) {
                let rawText = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
                
                // --- 關鍵優化：自動擷取純 JSON 內容 ---
                const startIdx = rawText.indexOf("{");
                const endIdx = rawText.lastIndexOf("}");
                if(startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1) {
                    finalAiJson = rawText.substring(startIdx, endIdx + 1);
                } else {
                    throw new Error("AI 回傳內容不包含有效的 JSON 結構");
                }
                
                document.getElementById('statusInfo').innerText = "AI 產出成功";
                console.log("AI JSON Output:", finalAiJson);
                break; // 成功即跳出迴圈
            } else {
                let errDetail = data.error ? data.error.message : "回傳格式不正確";
                lastErrorMsg += `[${modelName}]: ${errDetail}<br>`;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            lastErrorMsg += `[${modelName}]: 連線異常<br>`;
        }
    }

    // 7. 處理連線全部失敗
    if (!finalAiJson) {
        Swal.fire({
            title: "所有 AI 通道均無回應",
            html: `<div class="text-left text-xs bg-gray-900 p-2 rounded">${lastErrorMsg}</div>`,
            icon: "error"
        });
        aiBtn.disabled = false;
        return;
    }

    // 8. 呼叫 VB.NET 後端 SaveAIPlan
    $("#ai-step").html("AI 規劃完成，正在寫入 SQL Server...");
    $.ajax({
        type: "POST", 
        url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/SaveAIPlan",
        data: JSON.stringify({ aiJson: finalAiJson, originalPrefs: text }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        dataType: "json",
        success: function(res) {
            if (res.d.success) {
                const newId = res.d.newPlanId;
                
                // A. 更新當前頁面地圖
                loadRoute(newId); 
                document.getElementById('statusInfo').innerText = "規劃完成並存檔";

                // B. 彈窗詢問是否查看明細
                Swal.fire({
                    title: '行程規劃成功！',
                    text: '已存入資料庫，要查看完整行程報告嗎？',
                    icon: 'success',
                    showCancelButton: true,
                    confirmButtonColor: '#3085d6',
                    cancelButtonColor: '#aaa',
                    confirmButtonText: '查看明細',
                    cancelButtonText: '留在地圖',
                    background: '#111827',
                    color: '#fff'
                }).then((result) => {
                    if (result.isConfirmed) {
                        // 跳轉至明細頁
                        window.location.href = `ItineraryResult.aspx?id=${newId}`;
                    }
                });
            } else {
                Swal.fire("後端存檔失敗", res.d.msg, "error");
            }
            aiBtn.disabled = false;
        },
        error: function(xhr) {
            Swal.fire("系統連線錯誤", "無法觸發後端 VB 存檔，請檢查 SaveAIPlan 函式是否存在。", "error");
            aiBtn.disabled = false;
        }
    });
}

    const models = ["gemini-1.5-flash", "gemini-1.5-flash-8b", "gemini-1.5-pro-latest"];
    let finalAiJson = "";
    let lastErrorMsg = "";

    Swal.fire({ 
        title: 'AI 規劃師連線中', 
        html: '<div id="ai-step" class="text-sm">正在尋找可用通道...</div>', 
        background: '#111827', color: '#fff',
        allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() 
    });

    const prompt = `你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請根據以下需求規劃2天行程。目的地請從需求中判斷。

        try {
            // 嘗試使用 v1 正式版端點 (通常比 v1beta 更穩定)
            const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/${modelName}:generateContent?key=${key}`;
            const resp = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] })
            });

            const data = await resp.json();

            if (resp.ok && data.candidates && data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text) {
                let rawText = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;

                lastErrorMsg += `[${modelName}]: ${errDetail}<br>`;
            }

            icon: "error"
        });
        aiBtn.disabled = false;
        return;

            }
            aiBtn.disabled = false;

vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class ItineraryResult
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetFullReport(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            Dim details As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 1. 抓取主資訊
                Dim sqlMain As String = "SELECT t.Title, t.Destination, p.PlanSummary FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                                       "INNER JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID WHERE p.PlanID = @pid"
                Dim cmdMain As New SqlCommand(sqlMain, conn)
                cmdMain.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                conn.Open()
                Using drMain = cmdMain.ExecuteReader()
                    If drMain.Read() Then
                        result.Add("title", drMain("Title").ToString())
                        result.Add("destination", drMain("Destination").ToString())
                        result.Add("summary", drMain("PlanSummary").ToString())
                    Else
                        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "找不到此行程編號: " & planId}
                    End If
                End Using

                ' 2. 抓取地點清單
                Dim sqlDetails As String = "SELECT * FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDetails, conn)
                cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Using drDet = cmdDet.ExecuteReader()
                    While drDet.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("day", drDet("DayNum"))
                        row.Add("location", drDet("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", drDet("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        row.Add("desc", drDet("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(drDet("Lat")))
                        row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(drDet("Lng")))
                        details.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            result.Add("details", details)
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 回傳具體 SQL 報錯訊息
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "資料讀取失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class
--- ### 3. 修正 `ItineraryResult.aspx` (明細頁前端) 強化了「載入中」的 UI，並加入 API 出錯時的處理。

                        Swal.fire("存檔失敗", res.d.msg, "error");
                    }
                    resetBtn();
                },
                error: function(xhr) {
                    console.error(xhr.responseText);

                    resetBtn();
                }
            });
        }

        function resetBtn() {
            $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", false).html('<i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 智慧規劃行程');
            $("#statusInfo").text("狀態：準備就緒");
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: API_URL + "/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(r) { if(r.d.success) drawMap(r.d.data); }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = [];
            if(routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i+1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 4 });
            map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }
    </script>
</body>

這是一次重大的「功能回歸與除錯」更新。我已經找回了消失的語音輸入功能，並修復了導致 500 Error 的後端問題。 ### 1. 解決 500 Error (後端 VB.NET 修正) 500 錯誤通常是 SQL 查詢找不到資料或型態轉換失敗。我優化了 `ItineraryResult.aspx.vb`，改用更安全的 `LEFT JOIN` 並加強錯誤捕捉。 #### ItineraryResult.aspx.vb 完整碼：
vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class ItineraryResult
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetFullReport(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            Dim details As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 1. 抓取主資訊 (改用 LEFT JOIN 避免其中一張表沒資料導致整體報錯)
                Dim sqlMain As String = "SELECT t.Title, t.Destination, p.PlanSummary FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                                       "LEFT JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID WHERE p.PlanID = @pid"
                Dim cmdMain As New SqlCommand(sqlMain, conn)
                cmdMain.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                conn.Open()
                Using drMain = cmdMain.ExecuteReader()
                    If drMain.Read() Then
                        result.Add("title", If(IsDBNull(drMain("Title")), "未命名行程", drMain("Title").ToString()))
                        result.Add("destination", If(IsDBNull(drMain("Destination")), "", drMain("Destination").ToString()))
                        result.Add("summary", If(IsDBNull(drMain("PlanSummary")), "", drMain("PlanSummary").ToString()))
                    Else
                        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "找不到行程 ID: " & planId}
                    End If
                End Using

                ' 2. 每日細節
                Dim sqlDetails As String = "SELECT * FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDetails, conn)
                cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Using drDet = cmdDet.ExecuteReader()
                    While drDet.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("day", drDet("DayNum"))
                        row.Add("location", drDet("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", drDet("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        row.Add("desc", drDet("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        ' 安全轉換數字
                        row.Add("lat", Val(drDet("Lat").ToString()))
                        row.Add("lng", Val(drDet("Lng").ToString()))
                        details.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            result.Add("details", details)
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "後端報錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

            $("#userInput").val(text);
        };

        function toggleRecord() {
            if (!isRecording) {
                recognition.start();
                $("#recordBtn").addClass("active").html('<i class="fas fa-stop"></i> 停止錄音');
                $("#statusInfo").text("正在聆聽您的旅遊需求...");
            } else {
                recognition.stop();
                $("#recordBtn").removeClass("active").html('<i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音輸入');
                $("#statusInfo").text("錄音已結束");
            }
            isRecording = !isRecording;
        }

        // 3. AI 規劃核心
        async function runAI() {
            const key = $("#apiKey").val().trim();
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            if (!key || !text) { Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入 Key 與需求", "warning"); return; }
            
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_travel_key', key);
            $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", true).text("AI 思考中...");
            
            const models = ["gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.5-flash-lite", "gemini-pro"];
            let finalJson = "";

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 行程計算中', html: '正在生成路徑並寫入 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            const prompt = `你是一位專業導覽。請規劃${text}的2天行程。請嚴格回傳純 JSON：{ "title": "...", "destination": "...", "summary": "...", "details": [ {"day":1, "order":1, "location":"...", "lat":0.0, "lng":0.0, "desc":"...", "time":"..."} ] }`;

            for (let m of models) {
                try {
                    const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${m}:generateContent?key=${key}`;
                    const resp = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] }), headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} });
                    const data = await resp.json();
                    if (resp.ok) {
                        let raw = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
                        finalJson = raw.substring(raw.indexOf("{"), raw.lastIndexOf("}") + 1);
                        break;
                    }
                } catch (e) { console.warn(m + " 失敗"); }
            }

            if (!finalJson) { Swal.fire("錯誤", "模型通道全數阻塞", "error"); resetBtn(); return; }

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/SaveAIPlan",
                data: JSON.stringify({ aiJson: finalJson, originalPrefs: text }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        loadRoute(res.d.newPlanId);
                        Swal.fire({
                            title: '規劃成功！', text: '是否另開分頁查看明細報告？', icon: 'success',
                            showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: '另開明細', cancelButtonText: '留在原地'
                        }).then((r) => { if (r.isConfirmed) window.open(`ItineraryResult.aspx?id=${res.d.newPlanId}`, '_blank'); });
                    } else { Swal.fire("存檔失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                    resetBtn();
                }
            });
        }

        function resetBtn() { $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", false).html('<i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 智慧規劃'); }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(r) { if(r.d.success) drawMap(r.d.data); }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = [];
            if(routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i+1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 4 });
            map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class ItineraryResult
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetFullReport(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            Dim details As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()
                ' 1. 抓取主資訊 - 改用更強健的 SQL
                Dim sqlMain As String = "SELECT TOP 1 t.Title, t.Destination, p.PlanSummary FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                                       "INNER JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID WHERE p.PlanID = @pid"
                Dim cmdMain As New SqlCommand(sqlMain, conn)
                cmdMain.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Using drMain = cmdMain.ExecuteReader()
                    If drMain.Read() Then
                        result.Add("title", drMain("Title").ToString())
                        result.Add("destination", drMain("Destination").ToString())
                        result.Add("summary", drMain("PlanSummary").ToString())
                    Else
                        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "找不到行程資料，請確認 ID 正確。"}
                    End If
                End Using

                ' 2. 抓取細節
                Dim sqlDet As String = "SELECT DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, ArriveTime, ActivityDesc, Lat, Lng FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn)
                cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Using drDet = cmdDet.ExecuteReader()
                    While drDet.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("day", drDet("DayNum"))
                        row.Add("location", drDet("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", drDet("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        row.Add("desc", drDet("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(drDet("Lat")))
                        row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(drDet("Lng")))
                        details.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            result.Add("details", details)
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 關鍵：回傳具體錯誤訊息，這樣前端才知道 500 是為什麼
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "後端 SQL 報錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

' 在 TravelPlanner.aspx.vb 內增加這個 WebMethod
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
    Try
        Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 10 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                               "JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID ORDER BY t.CreatedAt DESC"
            Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
            conn.Open()
            Dim dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
            While dr.Read()
                Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                row.Add("id", dr("PlanID"))
                row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString())
                row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd HH:mm"))
                list.Add(row)
            End While
        End Using
        Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function

vb
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
    Try
        Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            ' 修正 SQL 語法：明確指定 CreatedAt 是 t 的欄位，並加上 TOP 20
            Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 20 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                               "INNER JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID " & _
                               "ORDER BY t.CreatedAt DESC"
            Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
            conn.Open()
            Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("id", dr("PlanID"))
                    row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString())
                    ' 安全處理日期轉換
                    If Not IsDBNull(dr("CreatedAt")) Then
                        row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd HH:mm"))
                    Else
                        row.Add("date", "未知時間")
                    End If
                    list.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
        End Using
        Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
    Catch ex As Exception
        ' 萬一出錯，回傳具體的 SQL 報錯，不要只噴 500
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "SQL讀取失敗: " & ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function

    <script>
        var map, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null;

        $(document).ready(function() {
            // 延遲初始化地圖，確保 Google 資源載入
            setTimeout(initMap, 500);
            $("#apiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_travel_key') || '');
            loadHistory();
        });

        function initMap() {
            if (typeof google === 'undefined') return setTimeout(initMap, 500);
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 13,
                styles: [{ "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{ "color": "#242f3e" }] }]
            });
            // 讀取網址預設 ID
            const pid = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('id');
            if(pid) loadRoute(pid);
        }

        function loadHistory() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory",
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(r) {
                    if(r.d.success) {
                        let h = '<option value="">▼ 歷史行程</option>';
                        r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} ${p.title}</option>`);
                        $("#historyList").html(h);
                    } else { console.error(r.d.msg); }
                }
            });
        }

            if(!pid) return;
            currentPlanId = pid;
            $("#statusInfo").text("載入中...");
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(r) {
                    if(r.d.success) {
                        drawMap(r.d.data);
                        $("#statusInfo").text("ID " + pid + " 已同步");
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = [];
            if(routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i+1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 4 });
            map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        // --- 語音輸入 ---
        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        let isRecording = false;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            $("#userInput").val(t);
        };
        function toggleRecord() {
            if (!isRecording) { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass("active"); }
            else { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass("active"); }
            isRecording = !isRecording;
        }

        function viewReport() {
            if(!currentPlanId) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先規劃行程", "info");
            window.open(`ItineraryResult.aspx?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank');
        }

這兩個錯誤訊息（500 錯誤與按鈕無法點擊）說明了系統正處於「JavaScript 報錯導致後續邏輯中斷」的狀態。 問題診斷： 1. 500 錯誤：這發生在明細頁（`ItineraryResult.aspx`）。通常是因為 SQL 語句中的 `INNER JOIN` 找不到對應的 `TripID`（例如您手動刪除過資料導致編號對不起來），或是 `Convert.ToDouble` 遇到空值。 2. 按鈕無法執行：因為地圖或歷史紀錄載入時發生了 JS 錯誤（500 錯誤），導致瀏覽器停止執行後面的腳本，所以按鈕的 `onclick` 事件失效了。 為了徹底解決，我重新整理了「全功能穩定版」。請務必依照以下步驟覆蓋代碼： ### 第一步：修正後端 `ItineraryResult.aspx.vb` (解決 500 錯誤) 這段代碼加強了資料容錯，即使資料庫關聯稍微不齊全也不會當機。
vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class ItineraryResult
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetFullReport(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            Dim details As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()
                ' 使用 LEFT JOIN 確保即便 Trip 被刪除，Plan 還在就能讀取
                Dim sqlMain As String = "SELECT TOP 1 p.PlanSummary, t.Title, t.Destination FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                                       "LEFT JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID WHERE p.PlanID = @pid"
                Dim cmdMain As New SqlCommand(sqlMain, conn)
                cmdMain.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Using drMain = cmdMain.ExecuteReader()
                    If drMain.Read() Then
                        result.Add("title", If(IsDBNull(drMain("Title")), "未命名行程", drMain("Title").ToString()))
                        result.Add("summary", If(IsDBNull(drMain("PlanSummary")), "", drMain("PlanSummary").ToString()))
                    Else
                        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "找不到行程 ID: " & planId}
                    End If
                End Using

                Dim sqlDet As String = "SELECT * FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn)
                cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Using drDet = cmdDet.ExecuteReader()
                    While drDet.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("day", drDet("DayNum"))
                        row.Add("location", drDet("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", drDet("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        row.Add("desc", drDet("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        ' 使用 Val 處理數字轉換，避免 500 錯誤
                        row.Add("lat", Val(drDet("Lat").ToString()))
                        row.Add("lng", Val(drDet("Lng").ToString()))
                        details.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            result.Add("details", details)
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "系統錯誤: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

    <script>
        var map, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null;

        $(document).ready(function() {

        function initMap() {

                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 13,
                styles: [{ "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{ "color": "#242f3e" }] }]
            });

                        $("#historyList").html(h);

                }
            });

            currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(r) { if(r.d.success) drawMap(r.d.data); }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = [];
            if(routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i+1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 4 });
            map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        // --- 智慧規劃核心 ---
        async function runAI() {
            const key = $("#apiKey").val().trim();
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            if(!key || !text) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入 Key 與需求", "warning");

            localStorage.setItem('gemini_travel_key', key);
            $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", true).text("規劃中...");
            
            // 模型備援
            const models = ["gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.5-flash-lite", "gemini-pro"];
            let finalJson = "";

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 規劃中', html: '正在連線模型並生成座標...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            const prompt = `你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請根據以下需求規劃2天行程，目的地請從需求中判斷。
            請嚴格回傳「純 JSON 格式」，不要 Markdown 標籤，格式如下：
            { "title": "行程標題", "destination": "城市", "summary": "簡介", "details": [ {"day":1, "order":1, "location":"地點", "lat":25.0, "lng":121.0, "desc":"描述", "time":"09:00"} ] }
            需求：${text}`;

            for (let m of models) {
                try {
                    const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${m}:generateContent?key=${key}`;
                    const resp = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] }), headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} });
                    const data = await resp.json();
                    if(resp.ok && data.candidates) {
                        let raw = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
                        finalJson = raw.substring(raw.indexOf("{"), raw.lastIndexOf("}") + 1);
                        break;
                    }
                } catch(e) { console.error(m + " 失敗"); }
            }

            if(!finalJson) { Swal.fire("錯誤", "模型通道阻塞", "error"); resetBtn(); return; }

            // 存入 SQL

                        Swal.fire({ title: '成功！', text: '行程已繪製，是否查看明細？', icon: 'success', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: '另開明細' })
                            .then(r => { if(r.isConfirmed) window.open(`ItineraryResult.aspx?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); });
                    }
                    resetBtn();
                }
            });
        }

        function resetBtn() { $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", false).html('<i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 智慧規劃'); }

        // --- 語音輸入 ---
        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        let isRecording = false;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for(let i=e.resultIndex; i<e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            $("#userInput").val(t);
        };
        function toggleRecord() {
            if(!isRecording) { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass("active"); }
            else { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass("active"); }

INNER JOIN 找不到資料：導致讀取器（Reader）沒有資料可讀。 以下是針對 HTML 前端 + VB 後端 重新封裝的 「終極穩定版」。 --- ### 1. 後端：`ItineraryResult.aspx.vb` (解決 500 報錯) 請將這段程式碼完整覆蓋您的 `.vb` 檔案。我加入了大量的 `IsDBNull` 判斷與 `Try...Catch`。

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

' 關鍵：必須有 ScriptService 才能讓 HTML 的 AJAX 呼叫
<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()> _
Public Class ItineraryResult
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    <WebMethod()> _
    Public Shared Function GetFullReport(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            Dim details As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()

                ' 1. 抓取行程主資訊 (使用 LEFT JOIN 避免其中一張表沒資料導致崩潰)
                Dim sqlMain As String = "SELECT TOP 1 p.PlanSummary, t.Title, t.Destination FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                                       "LEFT JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID WHERE p.PlanID = @pid"
                Dim cmdMain As New SqlCommand(sqlMain, conn)
                cmdMain.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Using drMain = cmdMain.ExecuteReader()
                    If drMain.Read() Then
                        result.Add("title", If(IsDBNull(drMain("Title")), "未命名行程", drMain("Title").ToString()))
                        result.Add("summary", If(IsDBNull(drMain("PlanSummary")), "無簡介", drMain("PlanSummary").ToString()))
                    Else
                        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "資料庫找不到此 ID: " & planId}
                    End If
                End Using

                ' 2. 抓取行程細節
                Dim sqlDetails As String = "SELECT DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, ArriveTime, ActivityDesc, Lat, Lng FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDetails, conn)
                cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                
                Using drDet = cmdDet.ExecuteReader()
                    While drDet.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("day", drDet("DayNum"))
                        row.Add("location", If(IsDBNull(drDet("LocationName")), "未知地點", drDet("LocationName").ToString()))
                        row.Add("time", If(IsDBNull(drDet("ArriveTime")), "--:--", drDet("ArriveTime").ToString()))
                        row.Add("desc", If(IsDBNull(drDet("ActivityDesc")), "", drDet("ActivityDesc").ToString()))
                        
                        ' 數值轉換安全處理
                        Dim latVal As Double = 0
                        Dim lngVal As Double = 0
                        If Not IsDBNull(drDet("Lat")) Then Double.TryParse(drDet("Lat").ToString(), latVal)
                        If Not IsDBNull(drDet("Lng")) Then Double.TryParse(drDet("Lng").ToString(), lngVal)
                        
                        row.Add("lat", latVal)
                        row.Add("lng", lngVal)
                        details.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            result.Add("details", details)
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 回傳具體錯誤訊息，方便除錯
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "後端 VB 報錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

        $(document).ready(function() {

                        $("#loading").html(`<div class="text-red-500">❌ 錯誤: ${r.msg}</div>`);

            data.details.forEach(item => {
                if (item.day !== currentDay) {

                        <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xl">

                                   <i class="fas fa-location-arrow mr-1"></i>Google 導航
                                </a>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
            });
            $("#timeline-box").html(html);
        }
    </script>
</body>

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 規劃中', html: '正在計算最優路徑與座標...', background: '#111827', color: '#fff', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            const prompt = `你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請規劃${text}的2天行程。目的地請從文字判斷。
            請嚴格回傳純 JSON 格式 (不准有 Markdown 標籤)：
            { "title": "行程標題", "destination": "城市", "summary": "亮點簡介", "details": [ {"day":1, "order":1, "location":"地點名", "lat":25.0, "lng":121.0, "desc":"描述", "time":"09:00"} ] }`;

            for (let m of models) {
                try {
                    $("#activeModel").text(m);
                    const url = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/${m}:generateContent?key=${key}`;
                    const resp = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: prompt }] }] }), headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} });
                    const data = await resp.json();
                    if (resp.ok) {
                        let raw = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
                        finalAiJson = raw.substring(raw.indexOf("{"), raw.lastIndexOf("}") + 1);
                        break;
                    }
                } catch (e) { console.warn(m + " failed"); }
            }

            if (!finalAiJson) { Swal.fire("錯誤", "AI 通道全數阻塞", "error"); resetBtn(); return; }

            // 存入 SQL
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/SaveAIPlan",
                data: JSON.stringify({ aiJson: finalAiJson, originalPrefs: text }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        currentPlanId = res.d.newPlanId;
                        loadRoute(currentPlanId); loadHistory();
                        Swal.fire({
                            title: '規劃成功！', text: '行程已寫入 SQL 並同步地圖。', icon: 'success',
                            showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: '另開明細', cancelButtonText: '留在原地'
                        }).then((r) => { if (r.isConfirmed) window.open(`ItineraryResult.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); });
                    }
                    resetBtn();
                }
            });
        }

        function resetBtn() { $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", false).html('<i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 開始智慧規劃'); $("#statusInfo").text("狀態：就緒"); }

        function loadHistory() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory",
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(r) {
                    if(r.d.success) {
                        let h = '<option value="">▼ 歷史紀錄</option>';
                        r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} ${p.title}</option>`);
                        $("#historyList").html(h);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if(!pid) return;
            currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(r) { if(r.d.success) drawMap(r.d.data); }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = [];
            if(routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i+1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5, strokeOpacity: 0.8 });
            map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function viewReport() { if(currentPlanId) window.open(`ItineraryResult.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); else Swal.fire("提示", "請先規劃行程", "info"); }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        function initMap() {

        // 2. 語音輸入：智慧口令 (清除、逗號、句號)
        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true; recognition.interimResults = false;
        let isRecording = false;

        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let transcript = '';
            for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; ++i) {
                if (e.results[i].isFinal) transcript = e.results[i][0].transcript;
            }

            if(transcript) {
                // 【新增】語音指令判斷
                if (transcript.includes("清除內容") || transcript.includes("清除")) {
                    $("#userInput").val("");
                    $("#statusInfo").text("內容已清空");
                } else {
                    // 標點符號替換
                    transcript = transcript.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。");
                    
                    let current = $("#userInput").val();
                    $("#userInput").val(current + transcript);
                }
                $("#charCount").text($("#userInput").val().length);
            }
        };

        function toggleRecord() {
            if (!isRecording) {

            isRecording = !isRecording;

                    const data = await resp.json();
                    if (resp.ok) {
                        let raw = data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
                        finalAiJson = raw.substring(raw.indexOf("{"), raw.lastIndexOf("}") + 1);
                        break;
                    }
                } catch (e) { console.warn(m + " 失敗"); }
            }

            if (!finalAiJson) { Swal.fire("錯誤", "所有模型通道暫時關閉", "error"); resetBtn(); return; }

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/SaveAIPlan",
                data: JSON.stringify({ aiJson: finalAiJson, originalPrefs: text }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {

                        }).then((r) => { if (r.isConfirmed) window.open(`ItineraryResult.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); });
                    }
                    resetBtn();
                }
            });
        }

        function resetBtn() { $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", false).html('<i class="fas fa-paper-plane"></i> 執行 AI 規劃'); $("#statusInfo").text("Ready"); }

        function loadHistory() {

                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory",

                success: function(r) {

                        $("#historyList").html(h);

        function loadRoute(pid) {

                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(r) { if(r.d.success) drawMap(r.d.data); }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = [];
            if(routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i+1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);

            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5, strokeOpacity: 0.8 });

' 1. 修改歷史清單抓取：限制最近 15 筆
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
    Try
        Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 15 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p " & _
                               "INNER JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID ORDER BY t.CreatedAt DESC"
            Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
            conn.Open()
            Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                While dr.Read()
                    Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                    row.Add("id", dr("PlanID"))
                    row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString())
                    row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd"))
                    list.Add(row)
                End While
            End Using
        End Using
        Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function

' 2. 新增刪除功能
<WebMethod()> _
Public Shared Function DeletePlan(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
    Try
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            ' 注意：刪除順序必須從細節表開始
            Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid; " & _
                               "DELETE FROM TravelPlans WHERE PlanID = @pid;"
            Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
            cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
        End Using
        Return New With {.success = True}
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function

    <style>
        :root { --bg: #0b0e14; --card: #1c2128; --primary: #00f2fe; }
