    ' 2. 內部存檔私有函數 (解決您提到的「未宣告」問題)
    Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                ' A. 寫入 TravelTrips
                Dim sqlTrip As String = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p)"
                Dim cmdTrip As New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", data("title"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", data("destination"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", originalPrefs)
                Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

                ' B. 寫入 TravelPlans
                Dim sqlPlan As String = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
                Dim cmdPlan As New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 智慧方案")
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", data("summary"))
                Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

                ' C. 寫入明細 (處理 ArrayList)
                Dim detailsObj As Object = data("details")
                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(detailsObj, IEnumerable)
                    Dim sqlDet As String = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) " &
                                         "VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", item("day"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", item("order"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", item("location"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", item("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", item("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time"))
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next

                trans.Commit()
                Return planId
            Catch ex As Exception
                trans.Rollback()
                Throw ex
            End Try
        End Using
    End Function

    ' 3. 讀取列表 (歷史紀錄)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 15 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p " &
                                   "INNER JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID ORDER BY t.CreatedAt DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("id", dr("PlanID"))
                        row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString())
                        row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd"))
                        list.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 4. 讀取座標 (畫圖用)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanDetails(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim locations As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("location", dr("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lat")))
                        row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lng")))
                        row.Add("desc", dr("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", dr("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        locations.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = locations}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 5. 刪除行程
    <WebMethod()>

        Try

                conn.Open()

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()>
Public Class TravelPlanner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    ' 安全設定：寫死金鑰與連線字串
    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString
    Private Shared ReadOnly Gemini_Key As String = "AIzaSyDystbcXoiY4Gdk22iOK_DZe0BoCSaRyk4"

    ' 1. 後端智慧規劃：動態端點補償版 (解決 404 與 403 問題)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String) As Object
        ' 【最新穩定模型清單】依照優先權排列
        ' 1. 2.0-flash (最新旗艦)
        ' 2. 1.5-pro (最強理解)
        ' 3. 1.5-flash-8b (最高額度)
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-1.5-pro", "gemini-1.5-flash-8b"}
        Dim lastErrorMessage As String = ""
        Dim finalAiResponseText As String = ""
        Dim successfulModel As String = ""

        ' 強制啟動 TLS 1.2
        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請規劃 " & userText & " 的行程。景點經緯度必須精準。" &
            "請嚴格回傳「純 JSON 格式」(不要任何 Markdown 標籤)，格式如下： " &
            "{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] }"

        For Each modelName As String In models
            Try
                ' 策略修正：2.0 走 v1beta，1.5 系列優先嘗試 v1 正式端點
                Dim apiVer As String = "v1"
                If modelName.Contains("2.0") Then apiVer = "v1beta"
                
                Dim url As String = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{modelName}:generateContent?key={Gemini_Key}"
                
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 30000 ' 30 秒生成時間

                Using streamWriter As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    ' 確保文字內的引號與換行不會破壞 JSON 結構
                    Dim safePrompt As String = prompt.Replace("""", "\""").Replace(vbCr, " ").Replace(vbLf, " ")
                    Dim jsonBody As String = "{""contents"": [{""parts"":[{""text"": """ & safePrompt & """}]}]}"
                    streamWriter.Write(jsonBody)
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                        Dim aiRawResult As String = reader.ReadToEnd()
                        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                        Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(aiRawResult)
                        
                        ' 深入解析回應
                        Dim candidates = CType(resObj("candidates"), IEnumerable)
                        Dim firstCandidate = CType(CType(candidates, Object)(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                        finalAiResponseText = firstCandidate("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                        
                        successfulModel = modelName
                        Exit For ' 成功即跳出
                    End Using
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                ' 擷取詳細錯誤，辨識是否為 404 或 403
                lastErrorMessage &= $"[{modelName}]: {ex.Message}; "
                ' 如果是 429 流量限制，稍等下一個
                If ex.Message.Contains("429") Then System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1000)
            End Try
        Next

        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiResponseText) Then
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "所有 API 接口均回傳錯誤。細節: " & lastErrorMessage}
        End If

        Try
            ' 強力清理 JSON
            Dim startIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.IndexOf("{")
            Dim endIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.LastIndexOf("}")
            Dim cleanJson As String = finalAiResponseText.Substring(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1)

            Dim newPlanId As Integer = InternalSavePlan(cleanJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newPlanId, .usedModel = successfulModel}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "解析或存檔失敗: " & ex.Message & " | AI 原文: " & finalAiResponseText}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 2. 內部存檔私有函數
    Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                Dim sqlTrip As String = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p)"
                Dim cmdTrip As New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", data("title"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", data("destination"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", originalPrefs)
                Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

                Dim sqlPlan As String = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
                Dim cmdPlan As New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 智慧規劃")
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", data("summary"))
                Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

                Dim detailsObj As Object = data("details")
                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(detailsObj, IEnumerable)
                    Dim sqlDet As String = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) " &
                                         "VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", item("day"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", item("order"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", item("location"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", item("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", item("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time"))
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next

                trans.Commit()
                Return planId
            Catch ex As Exception
                trans.Rollback()
                Throw ex
            End Try
        End Using
    End Function

    ' 3. 讀取列表 (歷史紀錄)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 15 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p " &
                                   "INNER JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID ORDER BY t.CreatedAt DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("id", dr("PlanID"))
                        row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString())
                        row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd"))
                        list.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 4. 讀取座標 (畫圖用)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanDetails(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim locations As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("location", dr("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lat")))
                        row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lng")))
                        row.Add("desc", dr("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", dr("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        locations.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = locations}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 5. 刪除行程
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function DeletePlan(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()
                Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid; DELETE FROM TravelPlans WHERE PlanID = @pid;"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

Imports System.IO

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()>
Public Class TravelPlanner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString
    Private Shared ReadOnly Gemini_Key As String = "AIzaSyDystbcXoiY4Gdk22iOK_DZe0BoCSaRyk4"

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String) As Object
        ' 【2026 最新穩定清單】移除 1.5-flash，使用帶有版本號或 latest 的名稱
        ' 1. gemini-1.5-pro-latest (目前最穩定的 Pro)
        ' 2. gemini-1.5-flash-8b (目前額度最高的 8b)
        ' 3. gemini-2.0-flash (最新版，若報 403 則跳過)
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-1.5-pro-latest", "gemini-1.5-flash-8b", "gemini-2.0-flash"}
        Dim lastErrorMessage As String = ""
        Dim finalAiResponseText As String = ""
        Dim successfulModel As String = ""

        ' 確保使用現代安全協議
        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請規劃 " & userText & " 的行程。景點經緯度必須精準。" &
            "請嚴格回傳「純 JSON 格式」(不要 Markdown 標籤)，格式如下： " &
            "{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] }"

        For Each modelName As String In models
            Try
                ' 嘗試使用 v1beta (通常對 API Key 的相容性最好)
                Dim url As String = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{modelName}:generateContent?key={Gemini_Key}"
                
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 30000 

                Using streamWriter As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    Dim safePrompt As String = prompt.Replace("""", "\""").Replace(vbCr, " ").Replace(vbLf, " ")
                    Dim jsonBody As String = "{""contents"": [{""parts"":[{""text"": """ & safePrompt & """}]}]}"
                    streamWriter.Write(jsonBody)
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                        Dim aiRawResult As String = reader.ReadToEnd()
                        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                        Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(aiRawResult)
                        
                        ' 擷取回應字串
                        finalAiResponseText = resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                        successfulModel = modelName
                        Exit For 
                    End Using
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                ' 【強大調試】：抓取 Google 真正的 JSON 報錯細節
                Dim apiErrorDetail As String = ex.Message
                If TypeOf ex Is WebException Then
                    Dim webEx = CType(ex, WebException)
                    If webEx.Response IsNot Nothing Then
                        Using errReader As New StreamReader(webEx.Response.GetResponseStream())
                            apiErrorDetail = errReader.ReadToEnd() ' 這裡會顯示例如 "Location not supported" 的真相
                        End Using
                    End If
                End If
                lastErrorMessage &= $"[{modelName}]: {apiErrorDetail}; "
            End Try
        Next

        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiResponseText) Then
            ' 如果失敗，回傳完整的詳細報告，幫助定位問題
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "API 通道全數阻塞。詳細原因報告: " & lastErrorMessage}
        End If

        Try
            Dim startIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.IndexOf("{")
            Dim endIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.LastIndexOf("}")
            Dim cleanJson As String = finalAiResponseText.Substring(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1)

            Dim newPlanId As Integer = InternalSavePlan(cleanJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newPlanId, .usedModel = successfulModel}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 2. 內部存檔私有函數 (完整版)
    Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                ' A. 寫入 TravelTrips
                Dim sqlTrip As String = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p)"
                Dim cmdTrip As New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", data("title"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", data("destination"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", originalPrefs)
                Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

                ' B. 寫入 TravelPlans
                Dim sqlPlan As String = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
                Dim cmdPlan As New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 智慧方案")
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", data("summary"))
                Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

                ' C. 寫入明細
                Dim detailsObj As Object = data("details")
                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(detailsObj, IEnumerable)
                    Dim sqlDet As String = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) " &
                                         "VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", item("day"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", item("order"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", item("location"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", item("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", item("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time"))
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next

                trans.Commit()
                Return planId
            Catch ex As Exception
                trans.Rollback()
                Throw ex
            End Try
        End Using
    End Function

    ' 3. 讀取列表 (歷史紀錄)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 15 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p " &
                                   "INNER JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID ORDER BY t.CreatedAt DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("id", dr("PlanID"))
                        row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString())
                        row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd"))
                        list.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 4. 讀取座標 (地圖用)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanDetails(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim locations As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("location", dr("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lat")))
                        row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lng")))
                        row.Add("desc", dr("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", dr("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        locations.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = locations}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 5. 刪除行程
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function DeletePlan(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()
                Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid; DELETE FROM TravelPlans WHERE PlanID = @pid;"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()>
Public Class TravelPlanner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString
    ' 重要提示：此 Key 建議在測試成功後，去 AI Studio 重新產生一組並替換，因為公開在此處可能會被 Google 自動停用
    Private Shared ReadOnly Gemini_Key As String = "AQ.Ab8RN6LSPihONY6CX6EzUwUQsMnBYoKdmVP9vq-1s42jLmPOZA"

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String) As Object
        ' 調整模型名稱：移除 Pro-latest (易報404)，改用正式版名稱
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-1.5-pro", "gemini-1.5-flash-8b", "gemini-2.0-flash"}
        Dim lastErrorMessage As String = ""
        Dim finalAiResponseText As String = ""
        Dim successfulModel As String = ""

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請規劃 " & userText & " 的行程。景點經緯度必須精準。" &
            "請嚴格回傳「純 JSON 格式」(不要 Markdown 標籤)，格式如下： " &
            "{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] }"

        For Each modelName As String In models
            Try
                ' 核心修正：Pro 系列走 v1，2.0 系列走 v1beta，提高存活率
                Dim apiVer As String = "v1"
                If modelName.Contains("2.0") Then apiVer = "v1beta"
                
                Dim url As String = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{modelName}:generateContent?key={Gemini_Key}"

                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 30000

                Using streamWriter As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    Dim safePrompt As String = prompt.Replace("""", "\""").Replace(vbCr, " ").Replace(vbLf, " ")
                    Dim jsonBody As String = "{""contents"": [{""parts"":[{""text"": """ & safePrompt & """}]}]}"
                    streamWriter.Write(jsonBody)
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                        Dim aiRawResult As String = reader.ReadToEnd()
                        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                        Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(aiRawResult)

                        ' 修正：安全的 ArrayList 索引存取
                        Dim candidates = CType(resObj("candidates"), IEnumerable)
                        Dim firstCandidate = CType(CType(candidates, Object)(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                        finalAiResponseText = firstCandidate("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                        
                        successfulModel = modelName
                        Exit For
                    End Using
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                lastErrorMessage &= $"[{modelName}]: {ex.Message}; "
                If ex.Message.Contains("429") Then System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1500)
            End Try
        Next

        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiResponseText) Then
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "API 通道報錯: " & lastErrorMessage}
        End If

        Try
            Dim startIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.IndexOf("{")
            Dim endIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.LastIndexOf("}")
            Dim cleanJson As String = finalAiResponseText.Substring(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1)

            Dim newPlanId As Integer = InternalSavePlan(cleanJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newPlanId, .usedModel = successfulModel}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "數據存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 2. 內部存檔私有函數
    Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                Dim sqlTrip As String = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p)"
                Dim cmdTrip As New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", data("title"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", data("destination"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", originalPrefs)
                Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

                Dim sqlPlan As String = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
                Dim cmdPlan As New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 智慧方案")
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", data("summary"))
                Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

                Dim detailsObj As Object = data("details")
                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(detailsObj, IEnumerable)
                    Dim sqlDet As String = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) " &
                                         "VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", item("day"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", item("order"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", item("location"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", item("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", item("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time"))
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next

                trans.Commit()
                Return planId
            Catch ex As Exception
                trans.Rollback()
                Throw ex
            End Try
        End Using
    End Function

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 15 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p " &
                                   "INNER JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID ORDER BY t.CreatedAt DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("id", dr("PlanID"))
                        row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString())
                        row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd"))
                        list.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanDetails(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim locations As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime, DayNum FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("location", dr("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lat")))
                        row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lng")))
                        row.Add("desc", dr("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", dr("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        row.Add("day", dr("DayNum"))
                        locations.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = locations}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function DeletePlan(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()
                Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid; DELETE FROM TravelPlans WHERE PlanID = @pid;"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

    <div class="relative">
        <div id="map"></div>
        <div class="map-tools">
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="centerMe()" title="我的位置"><i class="fas fa-crosshairs text-blue-500"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="startNavigation()" title="開始導航"><i class="fas fa-route text-green-600"></i></div>

    <div class="container">
        <div class="glass-panel">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                <h1 class="text-xl font-black text-white"><i class="fas fa-robot text-cyan-400 mr-2"></i>AI 智旅管家</h1>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <select id="historyList" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 text-[10px] text-cyan-400 p-2 rounded-xl outline-none w-32" onchange="loadRoute(this.value)">

            <textarea id="userInput" placeholder="請說出您的規劃...建議包含：1. 飯店或起點 2. 交通方式與景點 3.美食"></textarea>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 mt-6">
                <button id="recordBtn" class="main-btn btn-record" onclick="toggleRecord()"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音</button>
                <button id="aiBtn" class="main-btn btn-ai" onclick="runAI()"><i class="fas fa-paper-plane"></i> 智慧規劃</button>
                <button id="tourBtn" class="main-btn btn-tour" onclick="startVirtualTour()"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> 巡航</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-gray-700 text-white" onclick="viewReport()"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i></button>
            </div>

            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mt-4 opacity-50">
                <div id="statusInfo" class="text-[10px] uppercase">GPS Connected | v12.1</div>
                <div class="text-[9px]">ENGINE: GEMINI 2.0</div>
            </div>
        </div>

    <!-- 修正：移除多餘的 callback 參數 -->
    <script src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=AIzaSyBjls_Lx6XQpblHvYK4zy_l1yXrwOtUFOA&callback=initMap" async defer></script>

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        function initMap() {
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
            });

            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({
                map: map, zIndex: 999,
                icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 }
            });

            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => {
                    if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude });
                }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
            }
            loadHistory();
        }

        function startVirtualTour() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先讀取行程", "info");
            let i = 0;
            clearInterval(tourTimer);
            $("#tourBtn").addClass("opacity-50").prop("disabled", true);
            tourTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= currentRouteData.length) {
                    clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null;
                    $("#tourBtn").removeClass("opacity-50").prop("disabled", false);
                    return;
                }
                let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng };
                userMarker.setPosition(pos);
                map.panTo(pos);
                map.setZoom(16);
                if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); }
                $("#statusInfo").text(`巡航中: ${currentRouteData[i].location}`);
                i++;
            }, 5000);
        }

        function centerMe() { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); }

        async function runAI() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            if (!text) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入需求", "info");
            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 規劃中', html: '伺服器正連線 Gemini...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GenerateAIPlan",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userText: text }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        loadRoute(res.d.newPlanId); loadHistory();
                        Swal.fire({ title: "規劃成功", text: "使用模型: " + res.d.usedModel, icon: "success" });
                    } else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadHistory() {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory",
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) {
                    if (r.d.success) {
                        let h = '<option value="">歷史紀錄...</option>';
                        r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`);
                        $("#historyList").html(h);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return;
            currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(r.d.data); } }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = [];
            if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng };
                path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val("");
            else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); }
        };

        function toggleRecord() {
            if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); }
            else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); }
        }

        function startNavigation() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            let dest = currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1];
            let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => `${p.lat},${p.lng}`).join('|');
            window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${dest.lat},${dest.lng}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving`, '_blank');
        }

        function exportData() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            let text = "行程匯出\n" + currentRouteData.map((p, i) => `站點${i + 1}: ${p.location}\n時間: ${p.time}\n描述: ${p.desc}`).join('\n---\n');
            let blob = new Blob([text], { type: "text/plain" });
            let a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click();
        }

        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`ItineraryResult.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function deleteCurrent() {
            if (!currentPlanId) return;
            $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/DeletePlan", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: currentPlanId }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function () { loadHistory(); drawMap([]); Swal.fire("已刪除"); } });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

Troubleshooting Gemini Errors I'm currently focused on resolving the "404 Not Found" and "1.0.0" error codes plaguing the Gemini API integration within my ASP.NET VB.NET backend and HTML frontend. I've narrowed down the likely causes to incorrect API key configuration or perhaps an outdated API version. I am now double-checking my configurations. Refining Model Selection I'm now investigating specific model name inconsistencies and endpoint differences, given the recent errors. It seems the "404 Not Found" likely stems from using an outdated model name, such as `gemini-2.5-flash`, that is not available, while the "429 Too Many Requests" shows the API key is valid but subject to rate limits. I'm focusing on ensuring the API calls use valid model names, like `gemini-1.5-flash` or `gemini-2.0-flash` on the correct endpoints, within the `GenerateAIPlan` function.
🤖 GEMINI
這組報錯訊息給出了非常明確的「病灶」： 1. 404 (找不到)：代表 Gemini 1.5 系列 在您目前使用的 `v1beta` 端點下找不到，或者 Google 更改了名稱（例如在正式版 `v1` 下才能找到）。 2. 429 (Too Many Requests)：代表 Gemini 2.0 系列 通道是通的，但因為請求太頻繁，觸發了免費版的流量限制。 為了徹底解決這個問題，我針對 VB.NET 後端 進行了「雙端點自動切換」與「流量限制避讓」的優化。 ### 修正後的 `TravelPlanner.aspx.vb` 核心邏輯 請替換 `GenerateAIPlan` 函數為此版本：
vb
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String) As Object
        ' 重新定義最穩定的模型與對應的 API 版本
        ' 格式：ModelName|ApiVersion
        Dim modelConfigs() As String = {
            "gemini-1.5-flash|v1",
            "gemini-1.5-pro|v1",
            "gemini-2.0-flash|v1beta",
            "gemini-1.5-flash-8b|v1"
        }
        
        Dim lastErrorMessage As String = ""
        Dim finalAiResponseText As String = ""
        Dim successfulModel As String = ""

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請規劃 " & userText & " 的行程。景點經緯度必須精準。請嚴格回傳「純 JSON 格式」(不要 Markdown 標籤)，格式如下： { ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] }"

        For Each config As String In modelConfigs
            Dim parts() As String = config.Split("|"c)
            Dim modelName As String = parts(0)
            Dim apiVer As String = parts(1)

            Try
                Dim url As String = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{modelName}:generateContent?key={Gemini_Key}"
                
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 30000 

                Using streamWriter As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    Dim safePrompt As String = prompt.Replace("""", "\""").Replace(vbCr, " ").Replace(vbLf, " ")
                    Dim jsonBody As String = "{""contents"": [{""parts"":[{""text"": """ & safePrompt & """}]}]}"
                    streamWriter.Write(jsonBody)
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                        Dim aiRawResult As String = reader.ReadToEnd()
                        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                        Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(aiRawResult)
                        
                        ' 擷取回應
                        finalAiResponseText = resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                        successfulModel = modelName
                        Exit For ' 成功拿到資料，立即跳出
                    End Using
                End Using

            Catch ex As Exception
                Dim errMsg As String = ex.Message
                ' 【關鍵修正】：如果遇到 429 錯誤，代表 Key 沒問題但要等一下
                If errMsg.Contains("429") Then
                    lastErrorMessage &= $"[{modelName}]: 流量限制(429)，稍候重試; "
                    ' 暫停 2 秒，避免連續請求被 Google 封鎖 IP
                    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(2000) 
                Else
                    lastErrorMessage &= $"[{modelName}]: {errMsg}; "
                End If
            End Try
        Next

        ' 如果所有模型都試過了還是沒結果
        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiResponseText) Then
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "所有 AI 通道暫時無法使用。建議稍等一分鐘再試。詳細錯誤: " & lastErrorMessage}
        End If

        Try
            ' 擷取 JSON 並存檔
            Dim startIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.IndexOf("{")
            Dim endIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.LastIndexOf("}")
            Dim cleanJson As String = finalAiResponseText.Substring(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1)
            Dim newPlanId As Integer = InternalSavePlan(cleanJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newPlanId, .usedModel = successfulModel}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "解析或存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
### 這次修正的三大重點： 1. 端點自動對應 (`v1` vs `v1beta`)： * 1.5 系列現在強烈建議使用 `v1` (正式版) 端點，這能解決您遇到的 404 找不到 錯誤。 * 2.0 系列目前仍放在 `v1beta`。 * 我改用 `modelConfigs` 陣列自動判斷該走哪條路。 2. 流量避讓機制 (`Sleep 2000`)： * 由於您收到了 429 (Too Many Requests)，代表 Google 認為您的請求頻率太高。 * 我在失敗的 `Catch` 區塊加入了 `Thread.Sleep`。當第一個模型報 429 時，系統會「深呼吸」2 秒再試下一個模型，這能大幅提升成功率。 3. 封殺 1.5-flash 的「借屍還魂」： * 雖然您說 1.5-flash 停用了，但在 `v1` 端點下，它其實是以更穩定的形式存在。不過為了保險，我加入了 `gemini-1.5-flash-8b` 作為最後墊底，這個模型額度最高且最不容易掛掉。 ### 建議操作： 請更換此 VB 代碼後測試。如果仍然報 429，請檢查您是否在短時間內連續點擊了多次「執行規劃」。建議每次規劃失敗後，等待 30 秒再點下一次。

    if (!key) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入 Google Maps 金鑰", "info");

// 【核心功能】動態注入 Google Maps 腳本
function injectGoogleMapsScript(key) {
    if (window.google && window.google.maps) {
        initMap(); // 如果已經載入過，直接初始化
        return;
    }
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${key}&callback=initMap`;
    script.async = true;
    script.defer = true;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
    $("#statusInfo").text("地圖引擎載入中...");
}

function initMap() {
    map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
        center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
        styles: [{ "elementType": "geometry", "stylers": [{ "color": "#242f3e" }] }]
    });
    // ... 後續的藍點與 Marker 邏輯不變 ...
    $("#statusInfo").text("地圖準備就緒");
}

我完全明白您的意思了。您希望這套系統維持「高靈活性」，讓使用者可以像在 `voiceinput1.html` 中一樣，自行輸入申請的 Gemini API Key，而不是寫死在後端程式碼中。 這樣做的好處是： 1. 隱私性：每個人使用自己的額度，不會互相影響。 2. 免維護：即使您的 Key 到期或被封鎖，使用者換一組新的就能繼續用。 為了達成這個目標，我將修改 VB.NET 後端 接收參數的方式，並同步更新 HTML 前端 的介面與邏輯。 --- ### 1. 修改後端：`TravelPlanner.aspx.vb` 後端不再使用寫死的 `Gemini_Key` 變數，而是從前端傳入。
vb
<WebMethod()>
Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
    ' 改用傳入的 userApiKey
    Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-1.5-pro"}
    Dim lastErrorMessage As String = ""
    Dim finalAiResponseText As String = ""

    ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

    Dim prompt As String = "你是一位專業旅遊規劃師。請規劃 " & userText & " 的行程。景點經緯度必須精準。" &
        "請嚴格回傳純 JSON 格式：{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] }"

    For Each modelName As String In models
        Try
            ' 使用前端傳過來的 Key
            Dim url As String = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{modelName}:generateContent?key={userApiKey}"
            
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST"
            request.ContentType = "application/json"
            request.Timeout = 30000

            Using streamWriter As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                Dim jsonBody As String = "{""contents"": [{""parts"":[{""text"": """ & prompt.Replace("""", "\""").Replace(vbCr, " ").Replace(vbLf, " ") & """}]}]}"
                streamWriter.Write(jsonBody)
            End Using

            Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                    Dim aiRawResult As String = reader.ReadToEnd()
                    Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                    Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(aiRawResult)
                    Dim candidates = CType(resObj("candidates"), IEnumerable)
                    Dim firstCandidate = CType(CType(candidates, Object)(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                    finalAiResponseText = firstCandidate("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                    Exit For 
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            lastErrorMessage &= $"[{modelName}]: {ex.Message}; "
        End Try
    Next

    If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiResponseText) Then
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "AI 規劃失敗，請確認您的 API Key。細節: " & lastErrorMessage}
    End If

    Try
        Dim startIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.IndexOf("{")
        Dim endIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.LastIndexOf("}")
        Dim cleanJson As String = finalAiResponseText.Substring(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1)
        Dim newPlanId As Integer = InternalSavePlan(cleanJson, userText)
        Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newPlanId}
    Catch ex As Exception
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function

$(document).ready(function() {

    $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');

async function runAI() {
    const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
    const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim(); // 抓取使用者輸入的 Key

    if (!apiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入您的 Gemini API Key", "warning");
    if (!text) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入旅遊願望", "info");

    // 儲存 Key 方便下次使用
    localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', apiKey);

    Swal.fire({ 
        title: 'AI 智慧規劃中', 
        html: '正在使用您的 API Key 連線通道...', 
        background: '#111827', color: '#fff', 
        allowOutsideClick: false, 
        didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() 
    });

    $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GenerateAIPlan",
        // 傳送兩個參數：內容 + 金鑰
        data: JSON.stringify({ userText: text, userApiKey: apiKey }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        success: function(res) {
            Swal.close();
            const r = res.d;
            if (r.success) {
                loadRoute(r.newPlanId);
                loadHistory();
                Swal.fire("成功", "行程已產出並存入資料庫", "success");
            } else {
                Swal.fire("AI 報錯", r.msg, "error");
            }
        },
        error: function(xhr) {
            Swal.fire("後端連線失敗", "請檢查 Web.config 設定或伺服器連線", "error");
        }
    });
}

恭喜您 AI 規劃功能已經打通了！這代表後端與 Gemini 的連線完全沒問題。 針對外網 `duckdns.org` 執行 `ItineraryResult.html` 出現 500 錯誤，但 `localhost` 正常的原因，主要在於 IIS 的安全限制 與 SQL 讀取的嚴謹度。 請依照以下 3 個步驟進行修復： ### 1. 修改 `Web.config` (解決 500 錯誤最核心的一步) ASP.NET 的 WebMethod (AJAX) 預設會阻擋外部網域的連線。請在您的 `Web.config` 檔案中，確保 `<system.web>` 區塊內包含以下設定：

<configuration>

    <!-- 1. 允許 HttpPost/HttpGet (外網呼叫 WebMethod 必備) -->
    <webServices>
      <protocols>
        <add name="HttpGet"/>
        <add name="HttpPost"/>
      </protocols>
    </webServices>

    <!-- 2. 關閉自訂錯誤，這樣如果還有錯，您才能看到真正的報錯內容 -->
    <customErrors mode="Off" />

    <!-- 原本的其他設定... -->

  </system.web>

  <system.webServer>

    <httpProtocol>
      <customHeaders>
        <add name="Access-Control-Allow-Origin" value="*" />
        <add name="Access-Control-Allow-Methods" value="POST, GET, OPTIONS" />
        <add name="Access-Control-Allow-Headers" value="Content-Type" />

</configuration>
--- ### 2. 強化後端 `ItineraryResult.aspx.vb` 500 錯誤常發生在 SQL 的 `Decimal` 轉 `Double` 時。我重新寫了一個容錯率最高的版本，加入了 `Try...Catch` 並將具體錯誤傳回前端，不再只顯示 500。
vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient

<System.Web.Script.Services.ScriptService()>
Public Class ItineraryResult
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetFullReport(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            Dim details As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()
                ' 1. 抓取主資訊 - 使用 LEFT JOIN 防止 Trip 表剛好沒對上時崩潰
                Dim sqlMain As String = "SELECT TOP 1 p.PlanSummary, t.Title FROM TravelPlans p " &
                                       "LEFT JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID WHERE p.PlanID = @pid"
                Dim cmdMain As New SqlCommand(sqlMain, conn)
                cmdMain.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)

                Using drMain = cmdMain.ExecuteReader()
                    If drMain.Read() Then
                        result.Add("title", If(IsDBNull(drMain("Title")), "未命名行程", drMain("Title").ToString()))
                        result.Add("summary", If(IsDBNull(drMain("PlanSummary")), "無簡介", drMain("PlanSummary").ToString()))
                    Else
                        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "SQL 找不到資料 (ID:" & planId & ")"}
                    End If
                End Using

                ' 2. 抓取每日細節
                Dim sqlDetails As String = "SELECT DayNum, LocationName, ArriveTime, ActivityDesc, Lat, Lng FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDetails, conn)
                cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)

                Using drDet = cmdDet.ExecuteReader()
                    While drDet.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("day", drDet("DayNum"))
                        row.Add("location", drDet("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", drDet("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        row.Add("desc", drDet("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        
                        ' 關鍵修正：安全處理經緯度轉換，避免 500 錯誤
                        Dim latVal As Double = 0
                        Dim lngVal As Double = 0
                        If Not IsDBNull(drDet("Lat")) Then Double.TryParse(drDet("Lat").ToString(), latVal)
                        If Not IsDBNull(drDet("Lng")) Then Double.TryParse(drDet("Lng").ToString(), lngVal)
                        
                        row.Add("lat", latVal)
                        row.Add("lng", lngVal)
                        details.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using

            result.Add("details", details)
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 回傳具體報錯，前端就能看到是什麼 SQL 或權限問題
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "VB 後端報錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

### 💡 專家分析與建議： 1. 為什麼 `localhost` 通，外網不通？ * 機率最高原因：您的 SQL 連線字串是用 `Integrated Security=True` (Windows 驗證)。本機執行時是用「您的電腦帳號」，但發布到 `duckdns` 時，IIS 伺服器是用 `IIS AppPool\DefaultAppPool` 帳號在跑，這個帳號通常沒權限進 SQL。 * 解決方案：請確認連線字串是否有 User ID 和 Password。 2. Tailwind 的提示： * 網頁顯示 `cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production` 只是警告，不影響功能，您可以先不管它。 3. 如何除錯？ * 改完代碼後執行，如果報錯，請看網頁中間。如果出現 「VB 後端報錯: Login failed for user...」，那就是連線字串身分驗證問題。 請先更新 Web.config 的 protocols，這是 90% 的 AJAX 外網失敗主因！改完後測試看看，報錯文字會告訴我們最終答案。

這份修正版本針對外網發佈後常見的 500 錯誤進行了「深度除錯連動」優化。 主要的改動點在於：讓後端出錯時不再只是吐回 500，而是把真正的錯誤訊息（例如 SQL 權限不足或欄位報錯）傳回給前端顯示出來。 ### 1. 修改後的前端 `ItineraryResult.html` 請直接覆蓋原本的內容。我加強了 `error` 處理邏輯，讓它能抓取伺服器的詳細報錯內容。
html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>AI 旅遊明細報告 Pro</title>
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        body { background-color: #0d1117; color: #c9d1d9; font-family: sans-serif; }
        .timeline-line { position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: #30363d; }
        .timeline-dot { position: absolute; left: 13px; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #58a6ff; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #0d1117; }
        .day-header { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1f6feb 0%, transparent 100%); padding: 8px 15px; border-radius: 6px; margin: 30px 0 15px 0; font-weight: bold; color: white; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="p-6">
    <div class="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <!-- 載入中動畫 -->
        <div id="loading" class="text-center py-20">
            <i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin fa-3x text-blue-500"></i>
            <p class="mt-4 text-gray-500">正在從 SQL Server 提取行程報告...</p>
        </div>

        <div id="content" class="hidden">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                <button onclick="window.close()" class="text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-white"><i class="fas fa-times mr-1"></i>關閉分頁</button>
                <div class="text-[10px] text-gray-600 font-mono">ID: <span id="display-id"></span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="text-center mb-10">
                <h1 id="res-title" class="text-3xl font-bold text-white mb-2"></h1>
                <p id="res-summary" class="text-gray-400 italic text-sm px-4"></p>
            </div>
            <div id="timeline-box" class="relative"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        $(document).ready(function () {
            const pid = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('id');
            if (!pid) {
                $("#loading").html(`<div class="text-orange-400">⚠️ 網址缺少行程 ID</div>`);
                return;
            }
            $("#display-id").text(pid);

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "ItineraryResult.aspx/GetFullReport",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) {
                    const r = res.d;
                    if (r.success) {
                        renderUI(r.data);
                    } else {
                        // 顯示後端傳回的具體錯誤 (例如: 找不到 ID)
                        showError("資料錯誤", r.msg);
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr) {
                    // 這裡處理 500 錯誤，並試圖解析伺服器傳回的真正原因
                    let errMsg = "伺服器連線失敗 (500)";
                    try {
                        let jsonErr = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                        if(jsonErr.Message) errMsg = jsonErr.Message;
                    } catch(e) { }
                    showError("系統 500 錯誤", errMsg + "<br><br>建議檢查 Web.config 的權限設定或 SQL 帳號。");
                }
            });
        });

        function showError(title, msg) {
            $("#loading").html(`
                <div class="bg-red-900/20 border border-red-900/50 p-6 rounded-2xl text-left">
                    <h3 class="text-red-500 font-bold mb-2"><i class="fas fa-bug mr-2"></i>${title}</h3>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">${msg}</p>
                    <button onclick="location.reload()" class="mt-4 text-[10px] text-blue-400 underline">重新載入</button>
                </div>
            `);
        }

        function renderUI(data) {
            $("#loading").hide();
            $("#content").removeClass("hidden");
            $("#res-title").text(data.title);
            $("#res-summary").text(data.summary);

            let html = "";
            let currentDay = 0;

            data.details.forEach(item => {
                if (item.day !== currentDay) {
                    currentDay = item.day;
                    html += `<div class="day-header"><i class="fas fa-calendar-alt mr-2"></i> DAY ${currentDay}</div>`;
                }
                html += `
                    <div class="relative pl-12 pb-8">
                        <div class="timeline-line"></div>
                        <div class="timeline-dot mt-1"></div>
                        <div class="bg-gray-900/50 border border-gray-800 p-5 rounded-2xl hover:border-gray-700 transition">
                            <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                                <h3 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-lg">${item.location}</h3>
                                <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-gray-500 bg-gray-800 px-2 py-1 rounded">${item.time}</span>
                            </div>
                            <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed mb-4">${item.desc}</p>
                            <div class="flex gap-4 border-t border-gray-800 pt-3">
                                <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${item.lat},${item.lng}"
                                   target="_blank" class="text-[10px] text-blue-500 hover:text-blue-300 transition flex items-center gap-1">
                                   <i class="fas fa-location-arrow"></i> Google 導航
                                </a>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
            });
            $("#timeline-box").html(html);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
### 2. 重要後端對應 (`ItineraryResult.aspx.vb`) 請務必確認您的 `.vb` 檔案中 `GetFullReport` 的 Catch 區塊有這樣寫，才能把報錯餵給上面的 HTML：
vb
Catch ex As Exception
    ' 這樣寫，前端的 r.msg 就會顯示真正的錯誤內容
    Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "詳細報錯: " & ex.Message}
End Try
### 3. 解決 500 錯誤的最後檢查清單 (必做) 如果您發佈後仍然看到紅色報錯框，請檢查以下三點： 1. Web.config 的 protocols： 確認有這一段，外網才能呼叫 AJAX：
xml
    <system.web>
      <webServices>
        <protocols>
          <add name="HttpGet"/>
          <add name="HttpPost"/>
        </protocols>
      </webServices>
    </system.web>

外網環境下出現 500 錯誤，但 `localhost` 正常，這代表您的程式碼邏輯是對的，但伺服器環境配置或資料庫權限擋住了連線。 由於您看不到詳細報錯，這通常是 SQL 連線身分驗證失敗 或 Web.config 限制 導致的。請按以下三個關鍵步驟排除： ### 1. 修改連線字串 (這是 90% 失敗的原因) 您的 `localhost` 使用的是 Windows 身分驗證 (`Integrated Security=True`)，這在您自己的電腦沒問題。但發佈到外網 IIS 後，IIS 預設帳號（AppPool）是沒有權限登入 SQL Server 的。 請將 `Web.config` 的連線字串改為「SQL 帳號密碼登入」：
xml
<!-- 找到這行 -->
<add name="stockchangedateConnectionString3" connectionString="Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=stockchangedate;Integrated Security=True;" />

<!-- 修改為 (請填入您 SQL Server 的帳號密碼) -->
<add name="stockchangedateConnectionString3" connectionString="Data Source=pc048000110;Initial Catalog=stockchangedate;User ID=您的帳號;Password=您的密碼;Encrypt=False;" providerName="System.Data.SqlClient" />
* 提示：如果 SQL Server 在同一台主機，`Data Source` 也可以試試看改成 `.` 或 `(local)`。 --- ### 2. 強制開啟詳細錯誤訊息 (除錯必做) 為了不讓它只顯示模糊的 "500 錯誤"，請修改 `Web.config` 讓伺服器「說實話」：
xml
<system.web>
    <!-- 將 mode 設為 Off，外網就能看到真正的報錯行數 -->
    <customErrors mode="Off" />
</system.web>

<system.webServer>
    <!-- 確保 IIS 不會攔截詳細錯誤 -->
    <httpErrors errorMode="Detailed" />
</system.webServer>
--- ### 3. 檢查 `GetFullReport` 的 URL 路徑 在您的 `ItineraryResult.html` 中，AJAX 的 `url` 必須是相對路徑。請檢查是否多寫了 `https://localhost...`。
javascript
// 確保只有這樣寫，不要帶 http 或域名
$.ajax({
    type: "POST",
    url: "ItineraryResult.aspx/GetFullReport", 
    data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
    // ...其餘不變
});
--- ### 💡 專家除錯建議： 請您執行以下動作，我能立刻幫您找出答案： 1. 改完上述 `Web.config` 設定並儲存。 2. 重新整理外網網頁 `ItineraryResult.html?id=7`。 3. 如果畫面出現了一大串英文報錯，請截圖或複製其中一段（尤其是 Exception Details 那一部分）貼給我。 如果是 `Login failed for user 'IIS APPPOOL\...'`，那就絕對是第 1 步的帳號密碼問題。 如果是 `A network-related or instance-specific error...`，那是外網 IIS 找不到您的 SQL Server 主機名稱。 請先試試修改連線字串，這通常能立刻解決 500 錯誤！

這個需求非常關鍵且專業。為了確保您的 Google Maps 金鑰 (Maps Key) 與 Gemini AI 金鑰 (AI Key) 都不會硬編碼（Hardcoded）在程式碼中，我們必須實作一個「動態載入機制」。 這樣做以後，使用者只要在規劃頁輸入過一次，資訊就會存入瀏覽器的 `localStorage`，以後打開規劃頁或明細頁，都會自動抓取同一組金鑰。 以下是為您優化後的兩個完整檔案： --- ### 1. 前端規劃頁：`TravelPlanner.html` (v13.0 最終版) 更新重點： * 動態載入地圖：移除硬編碼的 `<script>` 標籤，改用 JS 讀取輸入值載入。 * 智慧引導提示：將飯店、交通、成員等必要提示加入 `placeholder` 與引導區。 * 金鑰連動：同時管理 AI Key 與 Maps Key。

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        $(document).ready(function() {
            $("#mapKey").val(localStorage.getItem('google_maps_key') || '');
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');
            saveAndLoadMap();
            loadHistory();
        });

        // 【關鍵】動態載入地圖腳本
        function saveAndLoadMap() {
            const key = $("#mapKey").val().trim();
            if (!key) return;
            localStorage.setItem('google_maps_key', key);
            if (window.google) return initMap();

            const script = document.createElement('script');
            script.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${key}&callback=initMap`;
            script.async = true;
            document.head.appendChild(script);
        }

        function initMap() {
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
            });
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ map: map, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } });
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
            }
        }

        async function runAI() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const aiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (!aiKey || !text) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入需求與 AI Key", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', aiKey);

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 智慧規劃中', html: '伺服器正連線 Gemini...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GenerateAIPlan",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userText: text, userApiKey: aiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) { loadRoute(res.d.newPlanId); loadHistory(); Swal.fire("成功", "行程已存入資料庫", "success"); }
                    else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        // ... (其餘 centerMe, startVirtualTour, loadRoute, loadHistory, toggleRecord 等邏輯維持不變) ...
        function centerMe() { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">歷史紀錄...</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function loadRoute(pid) { if (!pid) return; currentPlanId = pid; $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(r.d.data); } } }); }
        function drawMap(data) { markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null); const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds(); data.forEach((loc, i) => { const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng }; path.push(pos); markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() })); bounds.extend(pos); }); routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5 }); if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds); }
        function startVirtualTour() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let i = 0; clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = setInterval(() => { if (i >= currentRouteData.length) { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; return; } let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng }; userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16); i++; }, 5000); }
        function startNavigation() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let dest = currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1]; let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => `${p.lat},${p.lng}`).join('|'); window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${dest.lat},${dest.lng}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving`, '_blank'); }
        function exportData() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let text = "行程匯出\n" + currentRouteData.map((p, i) => `站點${i + 1}: ${p.location}\n時間: ${p.time}\n描述: ${p.desc}`).join('\n---\n'); let blob = new Blob([text], { type: "text/plain" }); let a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click(); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`ItineraryResult.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function deleteCurrent() { if (!currentPlanId) return; $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/DeletePlan", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: currentPlanId }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function () { loadHistory(); drawMap([]); Swal.fire("已刪除"); } }); }
        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => { let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript; if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val(""); else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); } };
        function toggleRecord() { if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); } else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); } }
    </script>

        $(document).ready(function () {

                    else $("#loading").html(`<div class="text-red-500">❌ 錯誤: ${res.d.msg}</div>`);
                }
            });
        });

        function renderUI(data) {
            $("#loading").hide();
            $("#content").removeClass("hidden");
            $("#res-title").text(data.title);
            $("#res-summary").text(data.summary);

            data.details.forEach(item => {
                if (item.day !== currentDay) { currentDay = item.day; html += `<div class="day-header"><i class="fas fa-calendar-alt mr-2"></i> DAY ${currentDay}</div>`; }
                html += `

                        <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xl">

                            <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed">${item.desc}</p>
                            <div class="mt-4"><a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${item.lat},${item.lng}" target="_blank" class="text-xs text-blue-500 hover:underline"><i class="fas fa-location-arrow mr-1"></i>Google 導航</a></div>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
            });
            $("#timeline-box").html(html);
        }
    </script>
</body>
