    ' 4. 萬能存檔函數 - 自動校正官方地名版
    Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                ' --- A. Summary 處理 (防止 Dictionary 亂碼) ---
                Dim finalSummary As String = ""
                If data.ContainsKey("summary") Then
                    Dim rawSum = data("summary")
                    If TypeOf rawSum Is Dictionary(Of String, Object) Then
                        For Each kvp In CType(rawSum, Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                            finalSummary &= kvp.Key & ": " & kvp.Value.ToString() & vbCrLf
                        Next
                    Else
                        finalSummary = rawSum.ToString()
                    End If
                End If

                ' --- B. 寫入 TravelTrips ---
                Dim tripDest As String = If(data.ContainsKey("destination"), data("destination").ToString(), "")
                Dim sqlTrip As String = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p)"
                Dim cmdTrip As New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", If(data.ContainsKey("title"), data("title").ToString(), "新行程"))
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", tripDest)
                cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", originalPrefs)
                Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

                ' --- C. 寫入 TravelPlans ---
                Dim sqlPlan As String = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
                Dim cmdPlan As New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 智慧方案")
                cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", finalSummary)
                Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

                ' --- D. 寫入細節 (關鍵：呼叫 Google 抓取官方地名) ---
                If data.ContainsKey("details") Then
                    For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(data("details"), IEnumerable)
                        Dim aiLocName As String = item("location").ToString()
                        Dim aiLat As Double = Val(item("lat").ToString())
                        Dim aiLng As Double = Val(item("lng").ToString())

                        ' 【核心修正】：向 Google 索取官方認證的地名與精確座標
                        Dim googleResult = GetOfficialPlaceInfo(aiLocName, tripDest, aiLat, aiLng)

                        Dim sqlDet As String = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                        Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                        cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                        cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", Val(item("day").ToString()))
                        cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", Val(item("order").ToString()))
                        
                        ' 存入 Google 抓回來的「官方地名」，導覽時才會有名字
                        cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", googleResult("name").ToString())
                        cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", googleResult("lat"))
                        cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", googleResult("lng"))
                        
                        cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc").ToString())
                        cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                        cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                    Next
                End If

                trans.Commit()
                Return planId
            Catch ex As Exception
                trans.Rollback()
                Throw ex
            End Try
        End Using
    End Function
--- ### 2. 必須配合的「地名校正助手」函式 請將這個函式放在類別內（`InternalSavePlan` 下方即可）。它負責連線 Google，把「座標」換成「漂亮的名字」。
vb
    ' 輔助函式：利用 Geocoding API 抓取「官方地名」與「精確座標」
    Private Shared Function GetOfficialPlaceInfo(ByVal locName As String, ByVal dest As String, ByVal rawLat As Double, ByVal rawLng As Double) As Dictionary(Of String, Object)
        Dim resObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)
        resObj.Add("name", locName) ' 預設用 AI 給的名字
        resObj.Add("lat", rawLat)
        resObj.Add("lng", rawLng)

        Try
            ' 組合搜尋字串 (如: 宜蘭 頭城老街)
            Dim searchQuery As String = locName
            If Not locName.Contains(dest) Then searchQuery = dest & " " & locName

            Dim mapsKey As String = "AIzaSyBjls_Lx6XQpblHvYK4zy_l1yXrwOtUFOA" 
            Dim url As String = $"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?address={Uri.EscapeDataString(searchQuery)}&key={mapsKey}&language=zh-TW"

            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
            Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                    Dim jss = New JavaScriptSerializer()
                    Dim res = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(reader.ReadToEnd())

                    If res("status").ToString() = "OK" Then
                        Dim firstRes = CType(CType(res("results"), IEnumerable)(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                        
                        ' 抓取 Google 認證的官方格式化地址 (去除非必要字眼)
                        Dim official = firstRes("formatted_address").ToString()
                        official = official.Replace("台灣", "").Replace("Taiwan", "").Trim()
                        
                        ' 移除郵遞區號 (如果有)
                        If System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(official, "^\d{3,5}") Then
                            official = official.Substring(official.IndexOf(" ") + 1)
                        End If

                        resObj("name") = official
                        resObj("lat") = Convert.ToDouble(CType(firstRes("geometry"), Dictionary(Of String, Object))("location")("lat"))
                        resObj("lng") = Convert.ToDouble(CType(firstRes("geometry"), Dictionary(Of String, Object))("location")("lng"))
                    End If
                End Using
            End Using
        Catch
            ' 失敗則維持原樣
        End Try
        Return resObj
    End Function

function startNavigation() {

function startNavigation() {
    if (!currentRouteData || currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先載入行程", "info");

    // 如果 destName 是 "24.1643, 120.6408"，這行會把它變空，然後我們補上目的地
    let cleanDestName = destName.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
    if (cleanDestName === "" || cleanDestName.length < 2) {
        cleanDestName = "目的地景點"; // 備援名稱
    }

    // 中間站點也同樣進行純淨化處理
    let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => {
        let n = p.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
        return encodeURIComponent(n || "行程站點");
    }).join('|');
    
    // 構造 URL：destination 參數絕對不準出現 lat,lng 數字
    let url = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(cleanDestName)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving`;

}

Public Class TravelPlanner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString
    ' AI Key 由前端傳入，此處地圖 Key 專供後端校正座標使用

    ' [API 1] 核心規劃與微調引擎 (智慧規劃 / 協作微調 共同調用)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Dim modelConfigs() As String = {"gemini-2.5-flash|v1beta", "gemini-1.5-pro|v1beta"}
        Dim finalAiJson As String = ""
        Dim usedModel As String = ""

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12
        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位精準的旅遊數據規劃師。請產出 JSON 行程。關鍵要求：1. location 欄位「絕對不准回傳座標數字」，必須提供景點完整全名。 2. summary 提供達人規劃建議。 格式：{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] }需求如下：" & userText

        For Each config In modelConfigs
            Try
                Dim model = config.Split("|"c)(0) : Dim api = config.Split("|"c)(1)
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{api}/models/{model}:generateContent?key={userApiKey}"
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 60000
                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    sw.Write(New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", New Object() {New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", New Object() {New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}}}}}}}}))
                End Using
                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim aiText = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                    finalAiJson = aiText.Substring(aiText.IndexOf("{"), aiText.LastIndexOf("}") - aiText.IndexOf("{") + 1)
                    usedModel = model : Exit For
                End Using
            Catch : System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1000) : End Try
        Next

        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiJson) Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "AI 連線失敗"}

        Try
            Dim newId = InternalSavePlan(finalAiJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newId, .usedModel = usedModel}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' [API 3] 行程明細讀取
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanDetails(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql = "SELECT * FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn) : cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId) : conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("location", dr("LocationName").ToString())
                        row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lat")))
                        row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lng")))
                        row.Add("desc", dr("ActivityDesc").ToString())
                        row.Add("time", dr("ArriveTime").ToString())
                        row.Add("day", dr("DayNum"))
                        list.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' [核心存檔] 自動過濾座標文字並存入官方地名
    Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open() : Dim trans = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                ' A. Summary 處理 (強制轉字串)
                Dim summaryText As String = ""
                If data.ContainsKey("summary") Then
                    If TypeOf data("summary") Is Dictionary(Of String, Object) Then
                        For Each kvp In CType(data("summary"), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                            summaryText &= kvp.Key & ": " & kvp.Value.ToString() & vbCrLf
                        Next
                    Else
                        summaryText = data("summary").ToString()
                    End If
                End If

                Dim tripId = New SqlCommand("INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (N'" & data("title").ToString().Replace("'", "''") & "', N'" & data("destination").ToString().Replace("'", "''") & "', 2, N'" & originalPrefs.Replace("'", "''") & "')", conn, trans).ExecuteScalar()
                Dim planId = New SqlCommand("INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (" & tripId & ", N'AI智慧規劃', N'" & summaryText.Replace("'", "''") & "')", conn, trans).ExecuteScalar()

                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(data("details"), IEnumerable)
                    Dim locName = item("location").ToString()
                    Dim aiLat = Val(item("lat").ToString()) : Dim aiLng = Val(item("lng").ToString())
                    ' 【核心修正】：過濾座標，獲取官方地名
                    Dim googleInfo = GetOfficialPlaceInfo(locName, data("destination").ToString(), aiLat, aiLng)

                    Dim sqlDet = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", Val(item("day").ToString()))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", Val(item("order").ToString()))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", googleInfo("name")) ' 存入純淨官方名
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", googleInfo("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", googleInfo("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next
                trans.Commit() : Return planId
            Catch ex As Exception : trans.Rollback() : Throw ex : End Try
        End Using
    End Function

    Private Shared Function GetOfficialPlaceInfo(ByVal locName As String, ByVal dest As String, ByVal rawLat As Double, ByVal rawLng As Double) As Dictionary(Of String, Object)
        Dim resObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"name", locName}, {"lat", rawLat}, {"lng", rawLng}}
        Try
            ' 如果名稱包含數字或點，代表是座標，改用城市名搜尋
            Dim query = If(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(locName, "[0-9.]+"), dest, dest & " " & locName)
            Dim url = $"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/findplacefromtext/json?input={Uri.EscapeDataString(query)}&inputtype=textquery&fields=name,geometry&key={Map_Key}&language=zh-TW"
            Using resp = CType(WebRequest.Create(url).GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim res = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())
                If res("status").ToString() = "OK" AndAlso CType(res("candidates"), IEnumerable).Cast(Of Object)().Any() Then
                    Dim candidate = CType(CType(res("candidates"), IEnumerable)(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                    resObj("name") = candidate("name").ToString()
                    resObj("lat") = Convert.ToDouble(candidate("geometry")("location")("lat"))
                    resObj("lng") = Convert.ToDouble(candidate("geometry")("location")("lng"))
                End If
            End Using
        Catch : End Try
        Return resObj
    End Function

    ' 歷史清單抓取
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
        ' (內容與 v9.0 一致，確保 SQL 欄位正確)
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql = "SELECT TOP 15 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID ORDER BY t.CreatedAt DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn) : conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("id", dr("PlanID")) : row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString()) : row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd"))
                        list.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception : Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message} : End Try
    End Function
End Class

    <style>

        .tip-badge { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); color: #60a5fa; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 11px; }
        textarea { width: 100%; height: 160px; background: #0d1117; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #444c56; border-radius: 20px; padding: 15px; outline: none; font-size: 1.1rem; }
        .map-tools { position: absolute; left: 15px; top: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; z-index: 50; }
        .tool-btn { width: 45px; height: 45px; background: white; border-radius: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); cursor: pointer; }
        .main-btn { padding: 15px 25px; border-radius: 20px; font-weight: 800; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .btn-record { background: #f85149; color: white; min-width: 130px; }
        .btn-record.active { background: #2ea043; animation: pulse 1.5s infinite; }
        @keyframes pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0.8); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 20px rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="relative">
        <div id="map"></div>
        <div class="map-tools">
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="centerMe()"><i class="fas fa-crosshairs text-blue-500"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="startNavigation()"><i class="fas fa-route text-green-600"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="exportData()"><i class="fas fa-file-download text-orange-500"></i></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="container">
        <div class="glass-panel">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                <h1 class="text-xl font-black text-white"><i class="fas fa-robot text-cyan-400 mr-2"></i>AI 智旅管家</h1>
                <select id="historyList" class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-700 text-[10px] text-cyan-400 p-2 rounded-xl outline-none w-32" onchange="loadRoute(this.value)">
                    <option value="">歷史紀錄...</option>
                </select>
            </div>

            <div class="guide-tips flex gap-2 mb-3">
                <span class="tip-badge">飯店起點？</span>
                <span class="tip-badge">交通工具？</span>
                <span class="tip-badge bg-red-900/20 text-red-400">口令：清除/逗號/句號</span>
            </div>

            <textarea id="userInput" placeholder="請說出規劃需求...建議包含飯店、交通與景點。"></textarea>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 mt-6">
                <button id="recordBtn" class="main-btn btn-record" onclick="toggleRecord()"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-cyan-600 text-black" onclick="callAPI('GenerateAIPlan')"><i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 規劃</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-orange-600 text-white" onclick="refinePlan()"><i class="fas fa-tools"></i> 微調</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-emerald-600 text-white" onclick="callAPI('ParseTextToPlan')"><i class="fas fa-rocket"></i> 文本轉圖</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-indigo-600 text-white" onclick="startVirtualTour()"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> 巡航</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-gray-700 text-white" onclick="viewReport()"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i></button>
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-gray-800 gap-2">
                <input type="password" id="mapKey" class="bg-black/50 border-0 text-[9px] w-28 p-1 rounded" placeholder="MAP KEY" onchange="saveAndLoadMap()">
                <input type="password" id="geminiKey" class="bg-transparent border-0 text-[9px] w-28 p-1 rounded text-right" placeholder="GEMINI KEY">
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        $(document).ready(function() {
            $("#mapKey").val(localStorage.getItem('google_maps_key') || '');
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');
            saveAndLoadMap();
            loadHistory();
        });

        function saveAndLoadMap() {
            const key = $("#mapKey").val().trim(); if (!key) return;
            localStorage.setItem('google_maps_key', key);
            if (window.google && window.google.maps) { initMap(); return; }
            const script = document.createElement('script');
            script.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${key}&callback=initMap&loading=async`;
            script.async = true; document.head.appendChild(script);
        }

        function initMap() {
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
            });
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ map: map, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } });
            if (navigator.geolocation) { navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true }); }
        }

        // 通用 API 調用
        function callAPI(method, customText = null) {
            const text = customText || $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const aiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if(!text || !aiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "內容與 Key 必填", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', aiKey);
            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在存入 SQL 並校正座標...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,
                data: JSON.stringify({ [method === "ParseTextToPlan" ? "rawText" : "userText"]: text, userApiKey: aiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) { loadRoute(res.d.newPlanId); loadHistory(); Swal.fire("成功", "已同步地圖與指南", "success"); }
                    else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        function refinePlan() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先讀取一個行程");
            let context = "目前行程：\n" + currentRouteData.map(p => `${p.location}(${p.time})`).join('->');
            callAPI("GenerateAIPlan", context + "\n微調要求：" + $("#userInput").val());
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return; currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(r.d.data); } }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng }; path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function startVirtualTour() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let i = 0; clearInterval(tourTimer);
            tourTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= currentRouteData.length) { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; return; }
                let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng };
                userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16);
                if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); }
                i++;
            }, 5000);
        }

        function startNavigation() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const dest = currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            const waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(p.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim())).join('|');
            window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving`, '_blank');
        }

        function exportData() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const blob = new Blob([currentRouteData.map(p=>p.location).join('\n')], { type: "text/plain" });
            const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click();
        }

        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val("");
            else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); }
        };
        function toggleRecord() {
            if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); }
            else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); }
        }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">歷史紀錄...</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function centerMe() { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); }
        function deleteCurrent() { if (!currentPlanId) return; $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/DeletePlan", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: currentPlanId }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function () { loadHistory(); drawMap([]); Swal.fire("已刪除"); } }); }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()

' 1. 最底層的 text 部分

--- ### 為什麼原本的會報錯？ VB.NET 在處理 `New Object() { ... }` 這種匿名數組嵌套在 `Dictionary` 的 `{ {key, value} }` 語法中時，如果換行或括號位置稍微不對，編譯器就會預期看到逗號來分隔下一個元素。 ### 整合進 `GenerateAIPlan` 的完整樣貌： 如果您想直接替換 `Using sw As New StreamWriter...` 內部的整塊邏輯，請參考這份：
vb
Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
    Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
    
    ' 建立結構化物件，防止語法錯誤
    Dim part As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
    Dim content As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", New Object() {part}}}
    Dim root As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", New Object() {content}}}
    
    ' 序列化成完美的 JSON 字串
    Dim jsonBody As String = jss.Serialize(root)
    sw.Write(jsonBody)
End Using
### 💡 專家提示： 1. `.ToArray()` 或 `New Object() { ... }`：在 VB.NET 中，`JavaScriptSerializer` 需要明確的數組結構才能產生 JSON 的中括號 `[]`。 2. `jss.Serialize` 的威力：這樣做還有一個好處，如果您的 `prompt` 裡面有雙引號或特殊字元，`Serialize` 函數會自動幫您做好轉義（Escape），不會導致 Google 伺服器報 `400 Bad Request`。 請將此段修正後重新發布測試，語法錯誤將會消失！

AI 沒給數字：AI 在產生 JSON 時，可能因為不知道精確位置，直接填了 `0.0`。 2. 校正失敗回傳預設值：在後端的 `GetOfficialPlaceInfo` 函式中，我們設定了失敗時回傳 `originalLat`，如果 AI 給的是 0，校正也失敗（例如：Key 權限沒開、或是地點太模糊），結果就是 0。 3. API 權限問題：您的 Google Cloud 「Places API」 或是 「Geocoding API」 可能尚未啟動。 我為您準備了 「地標校正強化版」，這版加入了更強的錯誤判斷，如果 Google 查不到，會強迫 AI 重新檢查，並修復了導致 0,0 的邏輯漏洞。 --- ### 1. 修改後端：`TravelPlanner.aspx.vb` (核心校正邏輯) 請替換這兩個關鍵函式。我改用了 Geocoding API 作為備援，並確保不會輕易回傳 0。
vb
    ' 核心修正：雙重校正機制 (Places API 優先，Geocoding 備援)
    Private Shared Function GetOfficialPlaceInfo(ByVal locName As String, ByVal dest As String, ByVal rawLat As Double, ByVal rawLng As Double) As Dictionary(Of String, Object)
        ' 預設保留 AI 給的原始座標，不輕易設為 0
        Dim resObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"name", locName}, {"lat", rawLat}, {"lng", rawLng}}

        ' 如果 AI 給的是 0，且名字太模糊，則不執行
        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(locName) OrElse locName.Length < 2 Then Return resObj

        Try
            Dim searchQuery As String = If(locName.Contains(dest), locName, dest & " " & locName)
            ' 移除座標字眼，避免干擾 Google 搜尋
            searchQuery = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(searchQuery, "[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+", "").Trim()

            ' 【重要】：確保此處使用的是 Google Cloud 申請的地圖金鑰
            Dim mapsKey As String = "AIzaSyBjls_Lx6XQpblHvYK4zy_l1yXrwOtUFOA"
            
            ' 第一步：嘗試用 Find Place 找景點名
            Dim url As String = $"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/findplacefromtext/json?input={Uri.EscapeDataString(searchQuery)}&inputtype=textquery&fields=name,geometry&key={mapsKey}&language=zh-TW"

            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
            Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                    Dim res = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(reader.ReadToEnd())

                    If res("status").ToString() = "OK" AndAlso CType(res("candidates"), IEnumerable).Cast(Of Object)().Any() Then
                        Dim candidate = CType(CType(res("candidates"), IEnumerable)(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                        resObj("name") = candidate("name").ToString()
                        resObj("lat") = Convert.ToDouble(candidate("geometry")("location")("lat"))
                        resObj("lng") = Convert.ToDouble(candidate("geometry")("location")("lng"))
                        Return resObj ' 成功找到地標，直接回傳
                    End If
                End Using
            End Using

            ' 第二步：如果 Places API 沒中，嘗試 Geocoding API (地址搜尋)
            Dim geoUrl As String = $"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?address={Uri.EscapeDataString(searchQuery)}&key={mapsKey}&language=zh-TW"
            Dim geoRequest As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(geoUrl), HttpWebRequest)
            Using geoResponse As HttpWebResponse = CType(geoRequest.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Using reader As New StreamReader(geoResponse.GetResponseStream())
                    Dim res = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(reader.ReadToEnd())
                    If res("status").ToString() = "OK" Then
                        Dim firstRes = CType(CType(res("results"), IEnumerable)(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                        resObj("name") = firstRes("formatted_address").ToString()
                        resObj("lat") = Convert.ToDouble(firstRes("geometry")("location")("lat"))
                        resObj("lng") = Convert.ToDouble(firstRes("geometry")("location")("lng"))
                    End If
                End Using
            End Using

        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 紀錄錯誤但繼續執行，避免整個網頁崩潰
        End Try

        ' 最終檢查：如果座標還是 0，且 original 不是 0，就用 original
        If Val(resObj("lat").ToString()) = 0 AndAlso rawLat <> 0 Then
            resObj("lat") = rawLat : resObj("lng") = rawLng
        End If

        Return resObj
    End Function

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        $(document).ready(function() {
            $("#mapKey").val(localStorage.getItem('google_maps_key') || '');
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');
            saveAndLoadMap();
            loadHistory();
        });

        function saveAndLoadMap() {
            const key = $("#mapKey").val().trim(); if (!key) return;
            localStorage.setItem('google_maps_key', key);
            if (window.google && window.google.maps) { initMap(); return; }
            const script = document.createElement('script');
            script.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${key}&callback=initMap&loading=async`;
            script.async = true; document.head.appendChild(script);
        }

        function initMap() {
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
            });
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ map: map, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } });
            if (navigator.geolocation) { navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true }); }
        }

        // --- 【核心】智慧規劃功能 ---
        async function runAI() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if(!text || !apiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "內容與 Key 必填", "warning");

            const prompt = `你是一位資深旅遊導覽。請根據需求規劃全新行程。
            【重要規範】：
            1. JSON 的 "summary" 欄位必須是【純文字字串】，不准用物件。
            2. summary 內容必須包含：◆預算規劃、◆交通工具建議、◆天數優勢、◆特別提醒(如逆時鐘)。
            3. location 欄位：必須提供「縣市名稱 + 景點全名」(例如：苗栗縣勝興車站)，嚴禁回傳座標數字作為名稱。
            4. 格式：{ "title": "...", "destination": "...", "summary": "...", "details": [ {"day":1, "order":1, "location":"...", "lat":0.0, "lng":0.0, "desc":"...", "time":"09:00"} ] }
            需求：${text}`;

            sendToBackend("GenerateAIPlan", prompt, apiKey, text);
        }

        // --- 【核心】協作微調功能 ---
        function refinePlan() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先讀取一個行程");
            if (!text) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入修改意見");

            let context = "【當前行程如下】：\n" + currentRouteData.map(p => `Day${p.day}: ${p.location}`).join('\n');
            const prompt = `你是一位旅遊秘書。針對現有行程進行修改。
            ${context}
            修改要求：『${text}』
            【任務】：必須回傳「整份行程」的完整 JSON。除了修改處外，其餘原本行程原封不動保留。`;

            sendToBackend("GenerateAIPlan", prompt, apiKey, text);
        }

        // --- 【核心】文本轉地名功能 ---
        function parseText() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (text.length < 20) return Swal.fire("提示", "請貼入更完整的文本");

            const prompt = `你是一位精準數據分析師。請分析這段文本並轉換為 JSON。
            任務：1. 絕對不准更改原本行程順序。 2. 必須查詢每個景點最準確的地標名稱與座標。 3. summary 整理原有的提醒。
            待處理文本：${text}`;

            sendToBackend("ParseTextToPlan", prompt, apiKey, text);
        }

        // 統一後端發送器
        function sendToBackend(method, prompt, apiKey, originalText) {
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', apiKey);
            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在校正官方地名並存入 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
            
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", 
                url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,
                data: JSON.stringify({ [method === "ParseTextToPlan" ? "rawText" : "userText"]: prompt, userApiKey: apiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        loadRoute(res.d.newPlanId); loadHistory();
                        Swal.fire("成功", "行程已同步至地圖", "success");
                    } else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        // --- 輔助與導航功能 ---
        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return; currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(r.d.data); } }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng }; path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function startVirtualTour() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let i = 0; clearInterval(tourTimer);
            tourTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= currentRouteData.length) { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; return; }
                let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng };
                userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16);
                if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); }
                i++;
            }, 5000);
        }

        function startNavigation() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const dest = currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            const waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(p.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim())).join('|');
            window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving`, '_blank');
        }

        function exportData() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const blob = new Blob([currentRouteData.map(p=>`第${p.day}天: ${p.location}`).join('\n')], { type: "text/plain" });
            const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click();
        }

        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val("");
            else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); }
        };
        function toggleRecord() {
            if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); }

javascript
function startNavigation() {
    if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先載入行程", "info");

    // 取得最後一個點
    let lastPoint = currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1];
    let destName = lastPoint.location;

    // 【終極過濾器】：如果地名包含座標特徵 (數字+點+逗號)，則過濾掉它
    // 這樣 Google Maps 就會根據「目的地城市 + 站點序號」重新定位，而不是死守座標
    const isCoords = /[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/.test(destName);
    if (isCoords) {
        // 如果資料庫存的還是座標，我們改用 description 的前半段作為地名
        destName = lastPoint.desc.split('，')[0] || "導航目的地";
    }

    let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => {
        // 去除所有數字座標干擾
        let cleanName = p.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
        return encodeURIComponent(cleanName || "路經點");
    }).join('|');

    // 構造 URL：destination 絕對不能是座標數字
    let url = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(destName)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving`;

    window.open(url, '_blank');
}

vb
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        ' 【2026 穩定模型清單】：優先順序調整
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-1.5-flash", "gemini-1.5-pro", "gemini-2.0-flash"}
        Dim lastErrorMessage As String = ""
        Dim finalAiResponseText As String = ""
        Dim successfulModel As String = ""

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        ' 如果傳進來的 Key 不是 AIza 開頭，直接報警（預防貼錯 Key）
        If Not userApiKey.StartsWith("AIza") Then
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "金鑰格式錯誤！Gemini Key 應為 AIza 開頭。"}
        End If

        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位精準的旅遊數據規劃師。請產出 JSON 行程。關鍵要求：1. location 欄位「絕對不准回傳座標數字」，必須提供景點完整全名。 格式：{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] } 需求如下：" & userText

        For Each modelName In models
            Try
                ' 嘗試使用 v1beta 端點
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{modelName}:generateContent?key={userApiKey}"
                
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 60000 ' 60秒超時

                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                    Dim part As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
                    Dim content As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", New Object() {part}}}
                    Dim root As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", New Object() {content}}}
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(root))
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                        Dim resText = reader.ReadToEnd()
                        Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                        
                        ' 擷取回應
                        finalAiResponseText = resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                        successfulModel = modelName
                        Exit For 
                    End Using
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                ' 【關鍵除錯】：抓取 Google 伺服器的原始錯誤
                Dim errorDetail As String = ex.Message
                If TypeOf ex Is WebException Then
                    Dim webEx = CType(ex, WebException)
                    If webEx.Response IsNot Nothing Then
                        Using errReader As New StreamReader(webEx.Response.GetResponseStream())
                            errorDetail = errReader.ReadToEnd() ' 這裡會顯示真正的錯誤內容
                        End Using
                    End If
                End If
                lastErrorMessage &= $"[{modelName}]: {errorDetail}; "
                System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1000)
            End Try
        Next

        ' 如果所有模型都失敗，回傳詳細的診斷報告
        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiResponseText) Then
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "連線失敗報告: " & lastErrorMessage}
        End If

        Try
            Dim startIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.IndexOf("{")
            Dim endIdx As Integer = finalAiResponseText.LastIndexOf("}")
            Dim cleanJson As String = finalAiResponseText.Substring(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1)
            Dim newId = InternalSavePlan(cleanJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newId, .usedModel = successfulModel}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- 【萬能規劃引擎】：處理智慧規劃、微調與文本轉換 ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        ' 1. 模型備援清單 (依照目前 Google 最穩定的型號)
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-1.5-pro", "gemini-1.5-flash-8b"}
        Dim finalAiJson As String = ""
        Dim usedModelName As String = ""
        Dim lastError As String = ""

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        ' 2. 核心 Prompt
        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位精準的旅遊規劃專家。請根據需求產出純 JSON 行程。" &
            "【嚴格要求】：1. location 必須是「完整官方景點名」，絕對不准只回傳座標。 " &
            "2. 務必查出精確的 lat 與 lng。 3. summary 提供專業的預算、交通、維修與安全建議。" &
            "格式：{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] } " &
            "需求內容：" & userText

        ' 3. 模型輪詢連線
        For Each m In models
            Try
                ' 判斷端點：2.0 系列走 v1beta，1.5 走 v1
                Dim apiVer As String = "v1"
                If m.Contains("2.0") Then apiVer = "v1beta"
                
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{m}:generateContent?key={userApiKey}"
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 90000 ' 提高到 90 秒

                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                    Dim rootObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                        {"contents", New Object() {New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                            {"parts", New Object() {New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}}}
                        }}}
                    }
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(rootObj))
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim resText = New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                    Dim aiText = resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                    
                    ' 擷取 JSON 部分
                    Dim startIdx = aiText.IndexOf("{")
                    Dim endIdx = aiText.LastIndexOf("}")
                    If startIdx <> -1 AndAlso endIdx <> -1 Then
                        finalAiJson = aiText.Substring(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1)
                        usedModelName = m : Exit For
                    End If
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                lastError &= $"[{m}]: {ex.Message}; "
                System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1000)
            End Try
        Next

        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiJson) Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "連線失敗: " & lastError}

        ' 4. 解析並存入 SQL
        Try
            Dim newId = InternalSavePlan(finalAiJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newId, .usedModel = usedModelName}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- 輔助函數：文本轉地圖 (直接調用上面的萬能引擎) ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function ParseTextToPlan(ByVal rawText As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Return GenerateAIPlan("【解析以下文本並存為行程】：" & rawText, userApiKey)
    End Function

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO
Imports System.Collections.Generic

<ScriptService()>
Public Class TravelPlanner
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    ' 請確認連線字串名稱
    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString
    ' 後端校正專用 Key (使用您的 Google Cloud 金鑰)
    Private Shared ReadOnly Map_Key As String = "AIzaSyBjls_Lx6XQpblHvYK4zy_l1yXrwOtUFOA"

    ' [主功能] 智慧規劃與文本解析萬能接口
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-1.5-pro"}
        Dim finalAiJson As String = ""
        Dim usedModel As String = ""
        Dim lastError As String = ""

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位精準的旅遊數據規劃師。請根據需求產出 JSON 行程。" &
            "【嚴格要求】：1. location 欄位必須是「完整官方景點名」，絕對不准回傳座標數字作為名稱。 " &
            "2. 務必查出精確的 lat 與 lng。 3. summary 提供專業的預算、交通、維修與安全建議 (字串格式)。" &
            "格式範例：{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""建議...\\n預算..."" ,""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] } " &
            "需求內容：" & userText

        For Each m In models
            Try
                Dim apiVer = If(m.Contains("2.0") Or m.Contains("2.5"), "v1beta", "v1")
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{m}:generateContent?key={userApiKey}"
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 90000
                
                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                    Dim root = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", New Object() {New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", New Object() {New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}}}}}}}}
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(root))
                End Using

                Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim resText = New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                    Dim aiText = resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                    finalAiJson = aiText.Substring(aiText.IndexOf("{"), aiText.LastIndexOf("}") - aiText.IndexOf("{") + 1)
                    usedModel = m : Exit For
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                lastError &= $"[{m}]: {ex.Message}; "
                System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1000)
            End Try
        Next

        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiJson) Then Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "AI 連線失敗: " & lastError}

        Try
            Dim newId = InternalSavePlan(finalAiJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newId, .usedModel = usedModel}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' [解析專用] 直接複用萬能接口
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function ParseTextToPlan(ByVal rawText As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Return GenerateAIPlan("【解析文本任務】：" & rawText, userApiKey)
    End Function

    ' [核心存檔邏輯] 含地名校正
    Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)
        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open() : Dim trans = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                Dim summaryText As String = ""
                If data.ContainsKey("summary") Then
                    If TypeOf data("summary") Is Dictionary(Of String, Object) Then
                        For Each kvp In CType(data("summary"), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                            summaryText &= kvp.Key & ": " & kvp.Value.ToString() & vbCrLf
                        Next
                    Else
                        summaryText = data("summary").ToString()
                    End If
                End If

                Dim tripId = New SqlCommand("INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (N'" & data("title").ToString().Replace("'", "''") & "', N'" & data("destination").ToString().Replace("'", "''") & "', 2, N'" & originalPrefs.Replace("'", "''") & "')", conn, trans).ExecuteScalar()
                Dim planId = New SqlCommand("INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (" & tripId & ", N'AI智慧方案', N'" & summaryText.Replace("'", "''") & "')", conn, trans).ExecuteScalar()

                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(data("details"), IEnumerable)
                    Dim locName = item("location").ToString()
                    Dim aiLat = Val(item("lat").ToString()) : Dim aiLng = Val(item("lng").ToString())
                    ' 【自動校正】：去 Google 抓官方名字與精確座標
                    Dim googleInfo = GetOfficialPlaceInfo(locName, data("destination").ToString(), aiLat, aiLng)

                    Dim sqlDet = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet = New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", Val(item("day").ToString()))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", Val(item("order").ToString()))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", googleInfo("name")) ' 存入官方名
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", googleInfo("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", googleInfo("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next
                trans.Commit() : Return planId
            Catch ex As Exception : trans.Rollback() : Throw ex : End Try
        End Using
    End Function

    ' [校正輔助]
    Private Shared Function GetOfficialPlaceInfo(ByVal locName As String, ByVal dest As String, ByVal rawLat As Double, ByVal rawLng As Double) As Dictionary(Of String, Object)
        Dim resObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"name", locName}, {"lat", rawLat}, {"lng", rawLng}}
        Try
            Dim query = If(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch(locName, "[0-9.]+"), dest, dest & " " & locName)
            Dim url = $"https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/findplacefromtext/json?input={Uri.EscapeDataString(query)}&inputtype=textquery&fields=name,geometry&key={Map_Key}&language=zh-TW"
            Using resp = CType(WebRequest.Create(url).GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim res = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())
                If res("status") = "OK" AndAlso CType(res("candidates"), IEnumerable).Cast(Of Object)().Any() Then
                    Dim cand = CType(CType(res("candidates"), IEnumerable)(0), Dictionary(Of String, Object))
                    resObj("name") = cand("name").ToString()
                    resObj("lat") = Convert.ToDouble(cand("geometry")("location")("lat"))
                    resObj("lng") = Convert.ToDouble(cand("geometry")("location")("lng"))
                End If
            End Using
        Catch : End Try
        Return resObj
    End Function

    ' [歷史/刪除/詳情]
    <WebMethod()> Public Shared Function GetPlanHistory() As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql = "SELECT TOP 15 p.PlanID, t.Title, t.CreatedAt FROM TravelPlans p JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID ORDER BY p.PlanID DESC"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn) : conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read() : Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("id", dr("PlanID")) : row.Add("title", dr("Title").ToString()) : row.Add("date", Convert.ToDateTime(dr("CreatedAt")).ToString("MM/dd"))
                        list.Add(row)
                    End While : End Using : End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception : Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message} : End Try
    End Function

    <WebMethod()> Public Shared Function GetPlanDetails(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                Dim sql = "SELECT * FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn) : cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId) : conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read() : Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        row.Add("location", dr("LocationName").ToString()) : row.Add("lat", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lat"))) : row.Add("lng", Convert.ToDouble(dr("Lng"))) : row.Add("desc", dr("ActivityDesc").ToString()) : row.Add("time", dr("ArriveTime").ToString()) : row.Add("day", dr("DayNum"))
                        list.Add(row) : End While : End Using : End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception : Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message} : End Try
    End Function

    <WebMethod()> Public Shared Function DeletePlan(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try : Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString) : conn.Open()
                New SqlCommand("DELETE FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = " & planId & "; DELETE FROM TravelPlans WHERE PlanID = " & planId, conn).ExecuteNonQuery()
            End Using : Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception : Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message} : End Try
    End Function
End Class

                <button class="main-btn bg-emerald-600 text-white" onclick="callAPI('ParseTextToPlan')"><i class="fas fa-rocket"></i> 文本轉圖</button>
                <button id="tourBtn" class="main-btn bg-indigo-600 text-white" onclick="startVirtualTour()"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> 巡航</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-gray-700 text-white" onclick="viewReport()"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i></button>
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-gray-800 gap-2">
                <input type="password" id="mapKey" class="bg-black/50 border-0 text-[9px] w-28 p-1 rounded" placeholder="MAP KEY" onchange="saveAndLoadMap()">
                <input type="password" id="geminiKey" class="bg-transparent border-0 text-[9px] w-28 p-1 rounded text-right" placeholder="GEMINI KEY">
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        $(document).ready(function() {
            $("#mapKey").val(localStorage.getItem('google_maps_key') || '');
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');
            saveAndLoadMap(); loadHistory();
        });

        function saveAndLoadMap() {
            const key = $("#mapKey").val().trim(); if (!key) return;
            localStorage.setItem('google_maps_key', key);
            if (window.google && window.google.maps) { initMap(); return; }
            const script = document.createElement('script');
            script.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${key}&callback=initMap&loading=async`;
            script.async = true; document.head.appendChild(script);
        }

        function initMap() {
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
            });
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ map: map, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } });
            if (navigator.geolocation) { navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true }); }
        }

        function callAPI(method, customText = null) {
            const text = customText || $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if(!text || !apiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "內容與 Key 必填", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', apiKey);
            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在校正官方地名並存入 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,
                data: JSON.stringify({ [method === "ParseTextToPlan" ? "rawText" : "userText"]: text, userApiKey: apiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) { loadRoute(res.d.newPlanId); loadHistory(); Swal.fire("成功", "行程已同步至地圖", "success"); }
                    else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        function refinePlan() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先讀取一個行程");
            let context = "目前行程：\n" + currentRouteData.map(p => `Day${p.day}: ${p.location}`).join('\n');
            callAPI("GenerateAIPlan", context + "\n微調要求：" + $("#userInput").val());
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return; currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(r.d.data); } }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng }; path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function startVirtualTour() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let i = 0; clearInterval(tourTimer);
            tourTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= currentRouteData.length) { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; return; }
                let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng };
                userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16);
                if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); }
                i++;
            }, 5000);
        }

        function startNavigation() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const dest = currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            const waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(p.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim())).join('|');
            window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving`, '_blank');
        }

        function exportData() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const blob = new Blob([currentRouteData.map(p=>p.location).join('\n')], { type: "text/plain" });
            const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click();
        }

        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val("");
            else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); }
        };

        function toggleRecord() {
            if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); }
            else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); }
        }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">歷史紀錄...</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function centerMe() { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); }
        function deleteCurrent() { if (!currentPlanId) return; $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/DeletePlan", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: currentPlanId }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function () { loadHistory(); drawMap([]); Swal.fire("已刪除"); } }); }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

這個錯誤是因為在 VB.NET 中，你不能直接把 `New SqlCommand(...).ExecuteNonQuery()` 寫成一行指令而不進行賦值或包裝。VB.NET 的語法要求必須先建立物件實例，或者將其包在括號內。 此外，為了程式的穩定性與安全性，建議使用參數化查詢，避免 SQL 注入風險。 以下是修正後的 `DeletePlan` 完整程式碼：
vb
    ' 5. 刪除行程 (修正語法錯誤版)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function DeletePlan(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
        Try
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                conn.Open()
                ' 使用參數化查詢最安全
                Dim sql As String = "DELETE FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid; DELETE FROM TravelPlans WHERE PlanID = @pid;"
                Using cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery()
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "刪除失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
### 為什麼原本的會錯？ 在 VB.NET 中，`New` 是一個運算式。如果你要直接呼叫它的方法而不宣告變數，必須寫成這樣（加上括號）： `DirectCast(New SqlCommand(sql, conn), SqlCommand).ExecuteNonQuery()` 或是： `(New SqlCommand(sql, conn)).ExecuteNonQuery()` 但這兩種寫法在 VB 裡都不推薦，且容易造成連線釋放不完全。使用我上面提供的 `Using cmd As New SqlCommand` 是最專業、最標準的寫法。 ### 💡 專家提示： 1. 刪除順序：您的 SQL 語法 `DELETE FROM PlanDetails ... DELETE FROM TravelPlans` 順序是正確的（先刪除子表，再刪除主表），這樣才不會觸發外鍵約束（Foreign Key Constraint）報錯。 2. 連線池：`Using` 會自動幫您關閉連線，這對高頻率使用的「智旅工作站」非常重要，能防止資料庫卡死。 請將此段替換掉原本報錯的函數，編譯就會立刻通過！

vb
    ' [API 1] 核心規劃引擎 - 強化 429 流量避讓版
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GenerateAIPlan(ByVal userText As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        ' 調整清單：加入 8b 模型 (這隻目前額度最高，最不容易 429)
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-1.5-flash-8b", "gemini-1.5-pro", "gemini-2.0-flash"}
        Dim finalAiJson As String = ""
        Dim usedModel As String = ""
        Dim lastError As String = ""

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        ' 強制要求格式，並請 AI 在規劃時多查幾次座標
        Dim prompt As String = "你是一位精準旅遊大師。請規劃行程並回傳 JSON。location 不准回傳數字座標，必須是地標全名。格式：{ ""title"": ""..."",""destination"": ""..."",""summary"": ""..."",""details"": [ {""day"":1,""order"":1,""location"":""..."",""lat"":0.0,""lng"":0.0,""desc"":""..."",""time"":""09:00""} ] } 需求內容：" & userText

        For Each m In models
            Try
                ' 判斷版本：Pro 多半在 v1 比較穩，Flash 2.5 在 v1beta
                Dim apiVer = "v1beta"
                If m.Contains("pro") Then apiVer = "v1"
                
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{m}:generateContent?key={userApiKey}"
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 60000

                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                    ' 使用分步建立法，確保 JSON 結構完美
                    Dim partDict As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
                    Dim contentObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", New Object() {partDict}}}
                    Dim rootObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", New Object() {contentObj}}}
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(rootObj))
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                        Dim resText = reader.ReadToEnd()
                        Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                        Dim aiText = resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                        
                        Dim startIdx = aiText.IndexOf("{")
                        Dim endIdx = aiText.LastIndexOf("}")
                        If startIdx <> -1 Then
                            finalAiJson = aiText.Substring(startIdx, endIdx - startIdx + 1)
                            usedModel = m : Exit For
                        End If
                    End Using
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                ' 【核心修正】：若遇到 429，等待 2.5 秒讓 Google 的流量窗口重啟
                If ex.Message.Contains("429") Then
                    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(2500) 
                End If
                lastError &= $"[{m}]: {ex.Message}; "
            End Try
        Next

        If String.IsNullOrEmpty(finalAiJson) Then 
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "AI 忙碌中(429)或連線失敗。請等一分鐘再按一次。詳細: " & lastError}
        End If

        Try
            Dim newId = InternalSavePlan(finalAiJson, userText)
            Return New With {.success = True, .newPlanId = newId, .usedModel = usedModel}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "存檔失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
        Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()
            Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
            Try
                ' --- A. 寫入 TravelTrips 與 TravelPlans (省略，維持您原本的邏輯) ---
                Dim tripId As Integer = 0 ' 請沿用您原本的 Insert 邏輯取得 tripId
                ' ... 執行原本的 Insert TravelTrips ...
                
                Dim planId As Integer = 0 ' 請沿用您原本的 Insert 邏輯取得 planId
                ' ... 執行原本的 Insert TravelPlans ...

                ' --- B. 寫入細節 (關鍵：校正名稱) ---
                Dim detailsObj As Object = data("details")
                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(detailsObj, IEnumerable)
                    ' 1. 取得 AI 給的原始地名與座標
                    Dim aiLocName As String = item("location").ToString()
                    Dim latVal As Double = Val(item("lat").ToString())
                    Dim lngVal As Double = Val(item("lng").ToString())

                    ' 2. 【核心校正】：如果是座標或模糊地名，去問 Google 官方正確名稱
                    ' 這樣導航時左側就會出現照片
                    Dim googleInfo = GetOfficialPlaceInfo(aiLocName, latVal, lngVal)
                    Dim finalName As String = googleInfo("name").ToString()

                    Dim sqlDet As String = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) " &
                                         "VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", Val(item("day").ToString()))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", Val(item("order").ToString()))
                    
                    ' 存入 Google 認證的地標名稱 (如: 高雄美麗島站)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", finalName) 
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", googleInfo("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", googleInfo("lng"))

                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next

                Return planId
