<body>

    <div style="height: 60px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #050a15, #0b0e14);"></div>

    <div class="container">
        <!-- 核心控制面板 -->
        <div class="glass-panel mb-6">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tighter"><i class="fas fa-chart-line text-cyan-400 mr-2"></i>AI 股票智能助教</h1>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <!-- 常用話術下拉 -->
                    <select id="phraseSelect" class="bg-gray-800 border-0 text-xs text-yellow-400 p-2 rounded-xl outline-none w-32" onchange="injectCmd(this.value)">
                        <option value="">💬 常用話術</option>
                        <option value="找本益比低於 15 且殖利率大於 5% 的股票">⚖️ 價值投資</option>
                        <option value="找今天量價齊揚且 OBV 翻正的股票">🔥 帶量起漲</option>
                        <option value="找 KD 20 以下黃金交叉的股票">📉 跌深反彈</option>
                        <option value="找一週庫存增加且均價金叉的股票">💎 大戶吸碼</option>
                    </select>
                    <input type="password" id="geminiKey" class="bg-black/50 border border-gray-700 text-[10px] p-2 rounded-lg w-32 text-white" placeholder="Gemini Key">
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 指令引導標籤 -->
            <div class="flex gap-2 mb-4 overflow-x-auto pb-2" style="scrollbar-width: none;">
                <span class="tip-badge" onclick="injectCmd('找今天最強勢的金融股')">🔥 強勢股</span>
                <span class="tip-badge" onclick="injectCmd('找大戶正在吸碼的股票')">💎 大戶吸碼</span>
                <span class="tip-badge" onclick="injectCmd('找OBV能量噴發的股票')">⚡ 能量噴發</span>
                <span class="tip-badge" onclick="injectCmd('找KD低檔起漲股')">📈 KD起漲</span>
                <span class="tip-badge" onclick="injectCmd('找站上所有均線的股票')">📏 多頭排列</span>
                <span class="tip-badge text-red-400 border-red-900/30" onclick="injectCmd('清除')">🗑️ 清除</span>
            </div>

            <textarea id="userInput" placeholder="請說出您的選股需求..."></textarea>

            <div class="flex gap-4 mt-6">
                <button id="recordBtn" class="main-btn btn-record" onclick="toggleRecord()"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音</button>
                <button id="aiBtn" class="main-btn btn-ai" onclick="runStockAI()"><i class="fas fa-robot"></i> 啟動 AI 智能選股</button>
            </div>
            
            <div id="statusInfo" class="text-center text-[10px] text-gray-600 mt-4 italic">Ready | Sync: View_AI_Stock_Pro</div>
        </div>

        <!-- 結果顯示區 -->
        <div class="glass-panel p-0 overflow-hidden">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table id="stockTable" class="table table-dark table-hover w-100 m-0"></table>
            </div>
        </div>

    <script>
        var stockTable = null;
        var API_AI = "StockAI.aspx";
        var API_DATA = "DataService2.aspx";

        $(document).ready(function() {
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_stock_key') || '');
        });

        function injectCmd(t) {
            if(!t) return;
            if(t === '清除') { $("#userInput").val(""); return; }
            $("#userInput").val(t);
        }

        // --- 修正後的核心函數 ---
        async function runStockAI() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if(!text || !key) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入需求與 API Key", "warning");

            localStorage.setItem('gemini_stock_key', key);
            $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", true).text("AI 分析中...");
            
            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 分析中', html: '正在將您的指令轉譯為 SQL...', background: '#0f172a', color: '#fff', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: API_AI + "/TranslateToSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userSpeech: text, userApiKey: key }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function(res) {
                    if(res.d.success) { 
                        // 【名稱修正】：統一呼叫 fetchStockData
                        fetchStockData(res.d.sql); 
                    } 
                    else { 
                        Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); 
                        resetBtn(); 
                    }
                },
                error: function(xhr) { 
                    Swal.fire("錯誤", "連線至 AI 引擎失敗", "error"); 
                    console.log(xhr.responseText);
                    resetBtn(); 
                }
            });
        }

        function fetchStockData(sql) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: API_DATA + "/ExecuteSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: "stockchangedate", pwd: "2157" }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function(res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    const data = JSON.parse(res.d);
                    if(data && data.length > 0) renderTable(data);
                    else Swal.fire("查無結果", "請更換選股條件", "info");
                    resetBtn();
                },
                error: function(xhr) {
                    Swal.fire("SQL 執行失敗", "請檢查語法或資料庫連線", "error");
                    console.log(xhr.responseText);
                    resetBtn();
                }
            });
        }

        function renderTable(data) {
            if (stockTable) stockTable.destroy();
            $("#stockTable").empty();
            let columns = Object.keys(data[0]).map(key => ({ title: key, data: key, className: "dt-center" }));
            
            stockTable = $('#stockTable').DataTable({
                data: data, columns: columns, 
                scrollX: true, 
                pageLength: 15,
                pagingType: "full_numbers",
                language: { url: "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" },
                "drawCallback": function() {
                    // 強制分頁容器樣式
                    $('.dataTables_paginate .pagination').addClass('pagination-sm justify-content-end');
                }
            });
        }

        function resetBtn() { $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", false).html('<i class="fas fa-robot"></i> 啟動 AI 智能選股'); }

        // --- 語音輸入邏輯 ---
        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for(let i=e.resultIndex; i<e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if(t.includes("清除")) injectCmd('清除');
            else {
                t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。");
                $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t);
            }
        };
        var isRecording = false;
        function toggleRecord() {
            if(isRecording) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); }
            else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); }
            isRecording = !isRecording;
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>

                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",

            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在校正地標名稱並寫入 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

                type: "POST", url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,

                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();

                        const newId = res.d.newPlanId;

                        // --- 顯示 Summary 到畫面上 ---

                        // --- 規劃成功後的雙選項彈窗 ---
                        Swal.fire({
                            title: '行程規劃成功！',
                            text: '資料已存入 SQL，要查看完整明細指南嗎？',
                            icon: 'success',

        function saveAndLoadMap() { const key = $("#mapKey").val().trim(); if (!key) return; localStorage.setItem('google_maps_key', key); if (window.google && window.google.maps) { initMap(); return; } const script = document.createElement('script'); script.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${key}&callback=initMap&loading=async&v=weekly`; script.async = true; document.head.appendChild(script); }
        function initMap() { $("#map").empty(); map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), { center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14, fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER }, styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}] }); userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ map: map, zIndex: 999, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } }); if (navigator.geolocation) { navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true }); } }
        function drawMap(data) { markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null); const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds(); data.forEach((loc, i) => { const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng }; path.push(pos); markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() })); bounds.extend(pos); }); routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5, strokeOpacity: 0.8 }); if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds); }
        function startNavigation() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim(); let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location); let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|'); window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`, '_blank'); }
        function syncToMobile() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim(); let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location); let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|'); let url = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`; Swal.fire({ title: '同步至手機導航', html: '<div id="qrcode" class="flex justify-center p-5 bg-white rounded-2xl mx-auto w-fit shadow-2xl"></div><p class="text-xs text-blue-400 mt-4 font-bold">請用手機相機掃描</p>', background: '#111827', confirmButtonText: '完成同步', didOpen: () => { new QRCode(document.getElementById("qrcode"), { text: url, width: 280, height: 280, correctLevel : QRCode.CorrectLevel.L }); } }); }
        function startVirtualTour() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let i = 0; clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = setInterval(() => { if (i >= currentRouteData.length) { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; return; } let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng }; userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16); if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); } i++; }, 5000); }
        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)(); recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true; recognition.onresult = (e) => { let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript; if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val(""); else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); } };
        function toggleRecord() { if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); } else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); } }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">▼ 歷史紀錄</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function centerMe() { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); }
        function deleteCurrent() { if (!currentPlanId) return; $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/DeletePlan", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: currentPlanId }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function () { loadHistory(); drawMap([]); Swal.fire("已刪除"); } }); }
        function refinePlan() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先讀取一個行程"); let context = "目前行程清單：\n" + currentRouteData.map(p => `Day${p.day}: ${p.location}`).join('\n'); callAPI("GenerateAIPlan", context + "\n使用者修改要求：" + $("#userInput").val()); }
        function exportData() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; const blob = new Blob([currentRouteData.map(p=>`第${p.day}天: ${p.location}`).join('\n')], { type: "text/plain" }); const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click(); }

javascript
// --- [完整最終版] 渲染行程明細介面 ---
function renderUI(data) {
    // 1. 介面切換：隱藏讀取動畫，顯示主內容
    $("#loading").hide();
    $("#content").removeClass("hidden");

    // 2. 設定行程總標題
    $("#res-title").text(data.title);

    // 3. 處理「AI 達人規劃建議」(Summary)
    // 檢查是否有內容，若有則顯示並美化排版
    if (data.summary && data.summary !== "無簡介" && data.summary.trim() !== "") {
        $("#summary-card").removeClass("hidden");
        // 將 AI 回傳的換行符號 \n 或 \\n 轉換為網頁的 <br>
        let formattedSummary = data.summary.replace(/\\n/g, '<br>').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
        $("#res-summary").html(formattedSummary);
    } else {
        $("#summary-card").addClass("hidden");
    }

    // 4. 產生每日行程時間軸 (Timeline)
    let html = "";
    let currentDay = 0;

    data.details.forEach((item, index) => {
        // A. 天數標題列：若進入新的一天，插入 Day Header
        if (item.day !== currentDay) {
            currentDay = item.day;
            html += `
                <div class="day-header">
                    <i class="fas fa-calendar-check mr-2 text-yellow-400"></i> 
                    第 ${currentDay} 天 行程安排
                </div>`;
        }

        // B. 地名清洗邏輯：移除字串中的座標數字 (如 24.123, 121.123)
        // 這樣 Google 導航才會抓到「名字」而不是只顯示「數字」
        let cleanName = item.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
        if (cleanName.length < 2) cleanName = item.location; // 若洗完太短則還原

        // C. 產生單個行程卡片 HTML
        html += `
            <div class="relative pl-12 pb-8">
                <!-- 時間軸裝飾線與點 -->
                <div class="timeline-line"></div>
                <div class="timeline-dot mt-1"></div>
                
                <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xl hover:border-blue-500/50 transition duration-300">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                        <!-- 景點/飯店名稱 -->
                        <h3 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-lg leading-snug">${item.location}</h3>
                        <!-- 抵達時間標籤 -->
                        <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-gray-500 bg-black/40 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-gray-700">
                            ${item.time}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- 行程描述內容 -->
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed mb-4">${item.desc}</p>
                    
                    <!-- 底部功能列：Google 導航連結 -->
                    <div class="flex justify-start border-t border-gray-800/50 pt-3">
                        <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(cleanName)}" 
                           target="_blank" 
                           class="text-xs text-blue-400 flex items-center gap-2 hover:text-white transition group">
                            <div class="w-8 h-8 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center group-hover:bg-blue-600 transition">
                                <i class="fas fa-location-arrow text-[10px] group-hover:text-white"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex flex-col">
                                <span class="font-bold">開啟 Google 導航</span>
                                <span class="text-[9px] opacity-60">點擊查看景點照片與資訊</span>
                            </div>
                        </a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>`;
    });

    // 5. 將生成的 HTML 寫入頁面
    $("#timeline-box").html(html);

    // 6. 如果有包含地圖座標，嘗試自動滾動至頂部 (UX優化)
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

        .map-tools { position: absolute; left: 15px; top: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; z-index: 50; }
        .tool-btn { width: 52px; height: 52px; background: white; border-radius: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.3rem; }

        /* 2. 按鍵佈局與放大 */

        .btn-record { background: #f85149; color: white; min-width: 140px; }
        .btn-record.active { background: #2ea043; animation: pulse 1.5s infinite; }
        
        /* 智慧規劃：寬度最大化 */
        .btn-ai { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f2fe, #4facfe); color: #0b0e14; flex: 2.5; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.3rem; box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.3); }

        /* 歷史選單與金鑰字體加大 */
        #historyList { font-size: 15px !important; padding: 8px 15px; width: 230px; background: #0f172a; color: #00f2fe; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 12px; }
        .key-input { font-size: 14px !important; padding: 10px !important; width: 170px !important; color: #fff !important; }

        @keyframes pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0.8); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 20px rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } }

<body>

    <div class="relative">
        <div id="map"><div class="flex items-center justify-center h-full text-gray-700 text-sm">正在初始化系統...</div></div>
        <div class="map-tools">
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="centerMe()"><i class="fas fa-crosshairs text-blue-500"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="startNavigation()"><i class="fas fa-route text-green-600"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="exportData()"><i class="fas fa-file-download text-orange-500"></i></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="container">
        <div class="glass-panel">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight"><i class="fas fa-robot text-cyan-400 mr-2"></i>AI 智旅管家</h1>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <select id="historyList" onchange="loadRoute(this.value)">
                        <option value="">載入過往紀錄...</option>
                    </select>
                    <i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-gray-600 hover:text-red-500 cursor-pointer text-xl" onclick="deleteCurrent()"></i>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 新增：主畫面摘要區 -->
            <div id="summary-box" class="hidden mb-5 bg-blue-900/10 border border-blue-500/20 p-5 rounded-2xl">
                <h4 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-sm mb-2"><i class="fas fa-lightbulb mr-2"></i> AI 達人建議</h4>
                <div id="summary-text" class="text-gray-300 text-xs leading-relaxed" style="white-space: pre-wrap;"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="guide-tips flex gap-3 mb-4">
                <span class="tip-badge">住宿點？</span><span class="tip-badge">交通工具？</span>
                <span class="tip-badge bg-red-900/20 text-red-400 border-red-900/30">清除/逗號/句號</span>
            </div>

            <textarea id="userInput" placeholder="請說出您的規劃需求...&#10;💡 建議：包含飯店名稱、交通方式與想去的景點。"></textarea>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 mt-8">
                <button id="recordBtn" class="main-btn btn-record" onclick="toggleRecord()"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音輸入</button>
                <button class="main-btn btn-ai" onclick="callAPI('GenerateAIPlan')"><i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 智慧規劃</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-orange-600 text-white" onclick="refinePlan()"><i class="fas fa-tools"></i> 微調</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-emerald-600 text-white" onclick="callAPI('ParseTextToPlan')"><i class="fas fa-rocket"></i> 文本轉圖</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-purple-600 text-white" onclick="syncToMobile()"><i class="fas fa-mobile-screen-button"></i> 同步</button>
                <button id="tourBtn" class="main-btn bg-indigo-600 text-white" onclick="startVirtualTour()"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> 巡航</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-gray-700 text-white px-5" onclick="viewReport()"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i></button>
            </div>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-800 gap-4">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span class="text-[12px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase">Map Key:</span>
                    <input type="password" id="mapKey" class="bg-black/50 border-0 rounded-lg key-input" placeholder="地圖金鑰" onchange="saveAndLoadMap()">
                    <span class="text-[12px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase ml-2">AI Key:</span>
                    <input type="password" id="geminiKey" class="bg-black/50 border-0 rounded-lg key-input" placeholder="Gemini 金鑰">
                </div>
                <div id="statusInfo" class="text-sm text-gray-600 italic">GPS Linked | v16.1 Stable</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        $(document).ready(function () {
            $("#mapKey").val(localStorage.getItem('google_maps_key') || '');
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');
            if ($("#mapKey").val()) saveAndLoadMap();
            loadHistory();
            $("#mapKey").on('keypress', function(e) { if(e.which == 13) saveAndLoadMap(); });
        });

        function saveAndLoadMap() {
            const key = $("#mapKey").val().trim();
            if (!key) { $("#map").html('<div class="flex items-center justify-center h-full text-gray-600">請輸入地圖金鑰</div>'); return; }
            localStorage.setItem('google_maps_key', key);
            if (window.google && window.google.maps) { initMap(); return; }
            $("#map").html('<div class="flex items-center justify-center h-full text-blue-400 animate-pulse">連線中...</div>');
            const script = document.createElement('script');
            script.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${key}&callback=initMap`;
            script.async = true; document.head.appendChild(script);
        }

        function initMap() {
            const mapDiv = document.getElementById('map');
            mapDiv.innerHTML = "";
            map = new google.maps.Map(mapDiv, {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
            });
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ map: map, zIndex: 999, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } });
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
            }
            $("#statusInfo").text("GPS Linked | 系統就緒");
        }

        function callAPI(method, customText = null) {
            const text = customText || $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (!text || !apiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "內容與 Key 必填", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', apiKey);

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在校正地標名稱並寫入 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,
                data: JSON.stringify({ [method === "ParseTextToPlan" ? "rawText" : "userText"]: text, userApiKey: apiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        const newId = res.d.newPlanId;
                        loadRoute(newId); loadHistory();
                        
                        // 智慧規劃成功後顯示摘要並彈窗
                        if(res.d.summary) {
                            $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden");
                            $("#summary-text").text(res.d.summary);
                        }

                        Swal.fire({
                            title: '行程規劃成功！', text: '是否另開分頁查看完整明細？', icon: 'success',
                            showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonColor: '#00f2fe', cancelButtonColor: '#444', confirmButtonText: '查看明細', cancelButtonText: '留在地圖'
                        }).then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${newId}`, '_blank'); });
                    } else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return; currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(r.d.data); } }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng }; path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5, strokeOpacity: 0.8 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function startNavigation() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location);
            let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|');
            window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`, '_blank');
        }

        function syncToMobile() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location);
            let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|');
            let url = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`;
            Swal.fire({
                title: '同步至手機導航',
                html: '<div id="qrcode" class="flex justify-center p-5 bg-white rounded-2xl mx-auto w-fit shadow-2xl"></div><p class="text-xs text-blue-400 mt-4 font-bold">請用手機相機掃描</p>',
                background: '#111827', confirmButtonText: '完成同步',
                didOpen: () => { new QRCode(document.getElementById("qrcode"), { text: url, width: 280, height: 280, correctLevel : QRCode.CorrectLevel.L }); }
            });
        }

        function startVirtualTour() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let i = 0; clearInterval(tourTimer);
            tourTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= currentRouteData.length) { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; return; }
                let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng };
                userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16);
                if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); }
                i++;
            }, 5000);
        }

        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val("");
            else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); }
        };
        function toggleRecord() { if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); } else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); } }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">▼ 歷史紀錄</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function centerMe() { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); }
        function deleteCurrent() { if (!currentPlanId) return; $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/DeletePlan", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: currentPlanId }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function () { loadHistory(); drawMap([]); Swal.fire("已刪除"); } }); }
        function refinePlan() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先讀取一個行程"); let context = "目前行程清單：\n" + currentRouteData.map(p => `Day${p.day}: ${p.location}`).join('\n'); callAPI("GenerateAIPlan", context + "\n使用者要求：" + $("#userInput").val()); }
        function exportData() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; const blob = new Blob([currentRouteData.map(p=>`第${p.day}天: ${p.location}`).join('\n')], { type: "text/plain" }); const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click(); }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    // 3. 【核心修正】：處理並顯示「AI 達人規劃建議」

    if (data.summary && data.summary !== "無簡介" && data.summary.trim() !== "") {
        $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden");
        // 使用 text() 填入內容，配合 CSS 的 white-space: pre-wrap 即可完美換行
        $("#res-summary").text(data.summary);
    } else {
        $("#summary-box").addClass("hidden");
    }

    // 4. 產生每日行程時間軸 (Timeline)
    let html = "";
    let currentDay = 0;

    // 遍歷所有景點細節
    data.details.forEach((item, index) => {
        // A. 判斷是否為新的一天，如果是則加入 Day Header
        if (item.day !== currentDay) {
            currentDay = item.day;
            html += `
                <div class="day-header" style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1f6feb 0%, transparent 100%); padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 35px 0 15px 0; font-weight: bold; color: white;">
                    <i class="fas fa-calendar-day mr-2 text-yellow-400"></i> 
                    第 ${currentDay} 天 行程安排
                </div>`;
        }

        // B. 【地名清洗邏輯】：過濾掉地名中的座標數字
        // 這是為了確保點擊導航連結時，Google 地圖會顯示「景點名字與照片」，而不是只有「數字座標」
        let cleanName = item.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
        if (cleanName.length < 2) cleanName = item.location; // 防止過濾後變空

        // C. 產生行程卡片 HTML
        html += `
            <div class="relative pl-12 pb-8">
                <!-- 時間軸裝飾線 -->
                <div class="timeline-line" style="position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: #30363d;"></div>
                <!-- 時間軸圓點 -->
                <div class="timeline-dot" style="position: absolute; left: 13px; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #58a6ff; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #0d1117; z-index: 1;"></div>
                
                <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xl hover:border-blue-500/50 transition duration-300">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                        <!-- 顯示校正後的景點名稱 -->
                        <h3 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-lg leading-tight">${item.location}</h3>
                        <!-- 顯示時間標籤 -->
                        <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-gray-500 bg-black/40 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-gray-700">
                            ${item.time}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- 顯示 AI 對該地點的描述 -->
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed mb-4">${item.desc}</p>
                    
                    <!-- 【導航按鈕】：強制傳送「純文字地名」給 Google，觸發景點卡片 -->
                    <div class="flex justify-start border-t border-gray-800/50 pt-3">
                        <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(cleanName)}" 
                           target="_blank" 
                           class="text-xs text-blue-400 flex items-center gap-2 hover:text-white transition group">
                            <div class="w-8 h-8 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center group-hover:bg-blue-600 transition">
                                <i class="fas fa-location-arrow text-[10px] group-hover:text-white"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex flex-col">
                                <span class="font-bold">開啟 Google 導航</span>
                                <span class="text-[9px] opacity-60">查看景點照片與官方資訊</span>
                            </div>
                        </a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>`;
    });

    // 5. 將生成的 HTML 內容渲染到頁面上
    $("#timeline-box").html(html);

    // 6. UX 優化：渲染完成後自動回到頂部
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}

        body { background: var(--bg); color: #adbac7; font-family: 'Segoe UI', "Microsoft JhengHei"; margin: 0; overflow-x: hidden; }
        
        /* 1. 地圖與面板佈局調整 */
        #map { height: 480px; width: 100%; border-bottom: 2px solid #30363d; background: #000; }
        .container { max-width: 950px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 15px; position: relative; top: -15px; z-index: 10; }
        .glass-panel { background: rgba(28, 33, 40, 0.98); backdrop-filter: blur(25px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 35px; padding: 30px; box-shadow: 0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); }

        /* 字體加大 */
        .tip-badge { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: #60a5fa; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; }
        textarea { width: 100%; height: 160px; background: #0d1117; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #444c56; border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; outline: none; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.6; }
        
        .map-tools { position: absolute; left: 15px; top: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; z-index: 50; }
        .tool-btn { width: 52px; height: 52px; background: white; border-radius: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.3rem; }

        /* 2. 按鈕加大加寬 */
        .main-btn { padding: 18px 22px; border-radius: 22px; font-weight: 800; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
        .btn-record { background: #f85149; color: white; min-width: 140px; }
        .btn-record.active { background: #2ea043; animation: pulse 1.5s infinite; }
        
        /* 智慧規劃按鈕：權重放大 */
        .btn-ai { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f2fe, #4facfe); color: #0b0e14; flex: 2.5; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.3rem; box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.3); }

        /* 歷史選單：字體加大 */
        #historyList { font-size: 15px !important; padding: 8px 15px; width: 230px; background: #0f172a; color: #00f2fe; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 12px; }

        @keyframes pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0.8); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 20px rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="relative">
        <div id="map"></div>
        <div class="map-tools">
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="centerMe()"><i class="fas fa-crosshairs text-blue-500"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="startNavigation()"><i class="fas fa-route text-green-600"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="exportData()"><i class="fas fa-file-download text-orange-500"></i></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="container">
        <div class="glass-panel">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight"><i class="fas fa-robot text-cyan-400 mr-2"></i>AI 智旅管家</h1>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <select id="historyList" onchange="loadRoute(this.value)">
                        <option value="">載入過往紀錄...</option>
                    </select>
                    <i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-gray-600 hover:text-red-500 cursor-pointer text-xl" onclick="deleteCurrent()"></i>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 新增：主畫面摘要建議區 -->
            <div id="summary-box" class="hidden mb-5 bg-blue-900/10 border border-blue-500/20 p-5 rounded-2xl">
                <h4 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-sm mb-2"><i class="fas fa-lightbulb mr-2 text-yellow-400"></i> AI 達人規劃建議</h4>
                <div id="summary-text" class="text-gray-300 text-xs leading-relaxed" style="white-space: pre-wrap;"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="guide-tips flex gap-3 mb-4">
                <span class="tip-badge">住宿點？</span><span class="tip-badge">交通工具？</span>
                <span class="tip-badge bg-red-900/20 text-red-400 border-red-900/30">清除/逗號/句號</span>
            </div>

            <textarea id="userInput" placeholder="請說出或貼入需求..."></textarea>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 mt-8">
                <button id="recordBtn" class="main-btn btn-record" onclick="toggleRecord()"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音輸入</button>
                <button class="main-btn btn-ai" onclick="callAPI('GenerateAIPlan')"><i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 智慧規劃</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-orange-600 text-white" onclick="refinePlan()"><i class="fas fa-tools"></i> 微調</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-emerald-600 text-white" onclick="callAPI('ParseTextToPlan')"><i class="fas fa-rocket"></i> 文本轉圖</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-purple-600 text-white" onclick="syncToMobile()"><i class="fas fa-mobile-screen-button"></i> 同步</button>
                <button id="tourBtn" class="main-btn bg-indigo-600 text-white" onclick="startVirtualTour()"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> 巡航</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-gray-700 text-white px-5" onclick="viewReport()"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i></button>
            </div>

            <!-- 金鑰與狀態：移除 Map Key 輸入框 -->
            <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-800 gap-4">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span class="text-[12px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase">AI Key:</span>
                    <input type="password" id="geminiKey" class="bg-black/50 border-0 rounded-lg" style="font-size:14px; padding:10px; width:250px; color:#fff;" placeholder="輸入 Gemini 金鑰">
                </div>
                <div id="statusInfo" class="text-sm text-gray-600 italic">GPS Linked | v16.1 Stable</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 地圖腳本寫死在此 -->
    <script src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=AIzaSyBjls_Lx6XQpblHvYK4zy_l1yXrwOtUFOA&callback=initMap" async defer></script>

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        $(document).ready(function () {
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');
            loadHistory();
        });

        // 修正：不再需要 saveAndLoadMap，由 Script 標籤直接觸發此函式
        function initMap() {
            map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById('map'), {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
            });
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ map: map, zIndex: 999, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } });
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
            }
        }

        function callAPI(method, customText = null) {
            const text = customText || $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (!text || !apiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "內容與 Key 必填", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', apiKey);

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在校正地標名稱並寫入 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,
                data: JSON.stringify({ [method === "ParseTextToPlan" ? "rawText" : "userText"]: text, userApiKey: apiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        const newId = res.d.newPlanId;
                        loadRoute(newId); loadHistory();
                        
                        // 顯示規劃建議摘要
                        if(res.d.summary) {
                            $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden");
                            $("#summary-text").text(res.d.summary);
                        }

                        Swal.fire({
                            title: '行程規劃成功！', text: '是否另開分頁查看完整明細？', icon: 'success',
                            showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonColor: '#00f2fe', cancelButtonColor: '#444', confirmButtonText: '查看明細', cancelButtonText: '留在地圖'
                        }).then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${newId}`, '_blank'); });
                    } else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return; currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(r.d.data); } }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng }; path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5, strokeOpacity: 0.8 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function startNavigation() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location);
            let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|');
            window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`, '_blank');
        }

        function syncToMobile() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location);
            let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|');
            let url = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`;
            Swal.fire({
                title: '同步至手機導航',
                html: '<div id="qrcode" class="flex justify-center p-5 bg-white rounded-2xl mx-auto w-fit shadow-2xl"></div><p class="text-xs text-blue-400 mt-4 font-bold">請用手機相機掃描</p>',
                background: '#111827', confirmButtonText: '完成同步',
                didOpen: () => { new QRCode(document.getElementById("qrcode"), { text: url, width: 280, height: 280, correctLevel : QRCode.CorrectLevel.L }); }
            });
        }

        function startVirtualTour() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let i = 0; clearInterval(tourTimer);
            tourTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= currentRouteData.length) { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; return; }
                let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng };
                userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16);
                if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); }
                i++;
            }, 5000);
        }

        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val("");
            else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); }
        };
        function toggleRecord() { if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); } else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); } }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">▼ 歷史紀錄</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function centerMe() { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); }
        function deleteCurrent() { if (!currentPlanId) return; $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/DeletePlan", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: currentPlanId }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function () { loadHistory(); drawMap([]); Swal.fire("已刪除"); } }); }
        function refinePlan() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先讀取一個行程"); let context = "目前行程清單：\n" + currentRouteData.map(p => `Day${p.day}: ${p.location}`).join('\n'); callAPI("GenerateAIPlan", context + "\n使用者要求：" + $("#userInput").val()); }
        function exportData() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; const blob = new Blob([currentRouteData.map(p=>`第${p.day}天: ${p.location}`).join('\n')], { type: "text/plain" }); const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click(); }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>AI 旅遊行程明細</title>
    <!-- 引入核心資源 -->
    <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        :root { --bg: #0d1117; --card: #161b22; --accent: #58a6ff; }
        body { background-color: var(--bg); color: #c9d1d9; font-family: 'Segoe UI', "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif; }
        
        /* 時間軸線條 */
        .timeline-line { position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: #30363d; z-index: 0; }
        /* 時間軸圓點 */
        .timeline-dot { position: absolute; left: 13px; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #58a6ff; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #0d1117; z-index: 1; }
        
        /* 達人建議卡片樣式 */
        #summary-box { 
            background: rgba(31, 111, 235, 0.1); 
            border: 1px solid rgba(31, 111, 235, 0.3); 
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }
        
        /* 保留 AI 回傳的換行符號 */
        #res-summary { white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.8; }
        
        /* 每天的標題樣式 */
        .day-header { 
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1f6feb 0%, transparent 100%); 
            padding: 12px 20px; 
            border-radius: 10px; 
            margin: 40px 0 20px 0; 
            font-weight: bold; 
            color: white;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        @media print {
            .no-print { display: none; }
            body { background: white; color: black; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="p-4 md:p-10">

    <div class="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        <!-- 頂部功能列 -->
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-8 no-print">
            <button onclick="window.close()" class="text-gray-500 hover:text-white transition flex items-center gap-2">
                <i class="fas fa-times"></i> 關閉分頁
            </button>
            <button onclick="window.print()" class="bg-gray-800 text-gray-300 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs hover:bg-gray-700 transition">
                <i class="fas fa-print mr-1"></i> 列印行程
            </button>
        </div>

        <!-- 1. 載入中動畫 -->
        <div id="loading" class="text-center py-20">
            <i class="fas fa-circle-notch fa-spin fa-3x text-blue-500"></i>
            <p class="mt-4 text-gray-500 font-bold">正在提取 SQL 行程數據...</p>
        </div>

        <!-- 2. 主內容區 (初始隱藏) -->
        <div id="content" class="hidden">
            <!-- 行程大標題 -->
            <h1 id="res-title" class="text-3xl font-black text-white text-center mb-8 leading-tight"></h1>

            <!-- AI 達人規劃建議卡片 -->
            <div id="summary-box" class="hidden p-6 rounded-3xl mb-12">
                <h4 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-sm mb-3 flex items-center">
                    <i class="fas fa-lightbulb mr-2 text-yellow-400"></i> AI 達人專屬建議
                </h4>
                <div id="res-summary" class="text-gray-300 text-sm"></div>
            </div>

            <!-- 時間軸清單容器 -->
            <div id="timeline-box" class="relative">
                <!-- 由 JavaScript 動態生成內容 -->
            </div>

            <div class="text-center mt-20 mb-10 opacity-20 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest no-print">
                End of Report | Zen AI Traveler System
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        $(document).ready(function () {
            // 從網址獲取 ID (?id=123)
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const planId = urlParams.get('id');

            if (!planId) {
                $("#loading").html('<div class="text-red-500">❌ 網址缺少行程編號</div>');
                return;
            }

            // 呼叫後端 API
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "travelgo.aspx/GetFullReport", // 確保這指向您改名後的 aspx
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(planId) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) {
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        renderUI(res.d.data);
                    } else {
                        $("#loading").html(`<div class="text-red-500">❌ 讀取失敗：${res.d.msg}</div>`);
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr) {
                    $("#loading").html('<div class="text-red-500">❌ 伺服器連線錯誤 (500)</div>');
                }
            });
        });

        // --- [核心渲染函數] ---
        function renderUI(data) {
            $("#loading").hide();
            $("#content").removeClass("hidden");
            $("#res-title").text(data.title);

            // 1. 處理達人建議區塊 (Summary)
            if (data.summary && data.summary !== "無簡介" && data.summary.trim() !== "") {
                $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden");
                // 處理可能存在的轉義換行
                let cleanSummary = data.summary.replace(/\\n/g, '\n'); 
                $("#res-summary").text(cleanSummary);
            } else {
                $("#summary-box").addClass("hidden");
            }

            // 2. 處理行程明細 (Timeline)
            let html = "";
            let currentDay = 0;

            data.details.forEach((item, index) => {
                // 加入天數分隔線
                if (item.day !== currentDay) {
                    currentDay = item.day;
                    html += `
                        <div class="day-header">
                            <i class="fas fa-calendar-day mr-2 text-yellow-400"></i> 
                            第 ${currentDay} 天 行程安排
                        </div>`;
                }

                // 【去座標化】：確保 Google 導航按鈕只傳地名
                let cleanName = item.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
                if (cleanName.length < 2) cleanName = item.location;

                html += `
                    <div class="relative pl-12 pb-8">
                        <div class="timeline-line"></div>
                        <div class="timeline-dot mt-1"></div>
                        
                        <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xl hover:border-blue-500/50 transition duration-300">
                            <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                                <h3 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-lg leading-tight">${item.location}</h3>
                                <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-gray-500 bg-black/40 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-gray-700">
                                    ${item.time}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                            
                            <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed mb-4">${item.desc}</p>
                            
                            <!-- 導航功能 -->
                            <div class="flex justify-start border-t border-gray-800/50 pt-3">
                                <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(cleanName)}" 
                                   target="_blank" 
                                   class="text-xs text-blue-400 flex items-center gap-2 hover:text-white transition group">
                                    <div class="w-7 h-7 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center group-hover:bg-blue-600 transition">
                                        <i class="fas fa-location-arrow text-[9px] group-hover:text-white"></i>
                                    </div>
                                    <span class="font-bold">開啟 Google 導航 (顯示景點資訊)</span>
                                </a>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
            });

            $("#timeline-box").html(html);
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sweetalert2@11"></script>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js"></script>

    <style>
        :root { --bg: #0b0e14; --card: #1c2128; --primary: #00f2fe; }
        body { background: var(--bg); color: #adbac7; font-family: 'Segoe UI', "Microsoft JhengHei"; margin: 0; overflow-x: hidden; }
        
        /* 地圖：高度增加，背景黑 */
        #map { height: 480px; width: 100%; border-bottom: 2px solid #30363d; background: #000; }
        
        /* 面板：下移 (top: -15px)，露出更多地圖 */
        .container { max-width: 950px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 15px; position: relative; top: -15px; z-index: 10; }
        .glass-panel { background: rgba(28, 33, 40, 0.98); backdrop-filter: blur(25px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 35px; padding: 25px; box-shadow: 0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); }

        /* 字體加大 */
        .tip-badge { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); color: #60a5fa; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; }
        textarea { width: 100%; height: 160px; background: #0d1117; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #444c56; border-radius: 22px; padding: 20px; outline: none; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.6; }
        
        /* 歷史選單加大 */
        #historyList { font-size: 16px !important; padding: 10px 15px; width: 250px; background: #0f172a; color: #00f2fe; border: 1px solid #444; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; }

        /* 地圖工具 */
        .map-tools { position: absolute; left: 15px; top: 15px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; z-index: 50; }
        .tool-btn { width: 55px; height: 55px; background: white; border-radius: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.4rem; color: #333; }

        /* 按鈕佈局與放大 */
        .main-btn { padding: 18px 25px; border-radius: 22px; font-weight: 800; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 1.15rem; }
        .btn-record { background: #f85149; color: white; min-width: 140px; }
        .btn-record.active { background: #2ea043; animation: pulse 1.5s infinite; }
        
        /* 智慧規劃按鈕：寬度最大化 */
        .btn-ai { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f2fe, #4facfe); color: #0b0e14; flex: 2.5; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.35rem; box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.3); }

        /* 建議區塊樣式 */
        #summary-box { background: rgba(31, 111, 235, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(31, 111, 235, 0.3); padding: 20px; border-radius: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; }

        @keyframes pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0.8); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 20px rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="relative">
        <!-- 地圖容器 -->
        <div id="map"></div>
        
        <!-- 自訂工具列 -->
        <div class="map-tools">
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="centerMe()"><i class="fas fa-crosshairs text-blue-500"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="startNavigation()"><i class="fas fa-route text-green-600"></i></div>
            <div class="tool-btn" onclick="exportData()"><i class="fas fa-file-download text-orange-500"></i></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="container">
        <div class="glass-panel">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight"><i class="fas fa-robot text-cyan-400 mr-2"></i>AI 智旅管家</h1>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <select id="historyList" onchange="loadRoute(this.value)">
                        <option value="">載入過往紀錄...</option>
                    </select>
                    <i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-gray-600 hover:text-red-500 cursor-pointer text-2xl" onclick="deleteCurrent()"></i>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 新功能區：顯示 AI 達人建議摘要 -->
            <div id="summary-box" class="hidden">
                <h4 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-sm mb-2 flex items-center">
                    <i class="fas fa-lightbulb mr-2 text-yellow-400"></i> AI 達人規劃建議
                </h4>
                <div id="summary-text" class="text-gray-300 text-xs leading-relaxed" style="white-space: pre-wrap;"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="guide-tips flex gap-3 mb-4">
                <span class="tip-badge">住宿點？</span><span class="tip-badge">交通工具？</span>
                <span class="tip-badge bg-red-900/20 text-red-400 border-red-900/30">清除/逗號/句號</span>
            </div>

            <textarea id="userInput" placeholder="請說出或貼入旅遊需求...&#10;💡 建議包含飯店名稱、交通與必去景點。"></textarea>

            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 mt-8">
                <button id="recordBtn" class="main-btn btn-record" onclick="toggleRecord()"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音輸入</button>
                <button class="main-btn btn-ai" onclick="callAPI('GenerateAIPlan')"><i class="fas fa-magic"></i> 智慧規劃</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-orange-600 text-white" onclick="refinePlan()"><i class="fas fa-tools"></i> 微調</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-emerald-600 text-white" onclick="callAPI('ParseTextToPlan')"><i class="fas fa-rocket"></i> 文本轉圖</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-purple-600 text-white" onclick="syncToMobile()"><i class="fas fa-mobile-screen-button"></i> 同步</button>
                <button id="tourBtn" class="main-btn bg-indigo-600 text-white" onclick="startVirtualTour()"><i class="fas fa-bolt"></i> 巡航</button>
                <button class="main-btn bg-gray-700 text-white px-5" onclick="viewReport()"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i></button>
            </div>

            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-800">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span class="text-[13px] text-gray-500 font-bold">AI KEY:</span>
                    <input type="password" id="geminiKey" class="bg-black/50 border border-gray-700 text-[14px] p-2 rounded-lg w-64 text-white" placeholder="請在此貼上 Gemini API Key">
                </div>
                <div id="statusInfo" class="text-sm text-gray-600 italic">GPS Linked | v16.2 Stable</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 地圖金鑰直接寫死在此，callback 觸發 initMap -->
    <script src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=AIzaSyBjls_Lx6XQpblHvYK4zy_l1yXrwOtUFOA&callback=initMap" async defer></script>

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        $(document).ready(function () {
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');
            loadHistory();
        });

        // 核心：由 Google Script Callback 直接呼叫
        function initMap() {
            const mapDiv = document.getElementById('map');
            mapDiv.innerHTML = ""; // 清空文字
            map = new google.maps.Map(mapDiv, {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
            });
            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ map: map, zIndex: 999, icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } });
            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
            }
        }

        // --- 功能函數 ---
        function renderUI(data) {
            // 這個函數在規劃頁面主要負責更新摘要顯示
            if (data.summary && data.summary !== "無簡介") {
                $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden");
                $("#summary-text").text(data.summary);
            } else {
                $("#summary-box").addClass("hidden");
            }
        }

        function callAPI(method, customText = null) {
            const text = customText || $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (!text || !apiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "內容與 Key 必填", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', apiKey);

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在校正地標名稱並寫入 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,
                data: JSON.stringify({ [method === "ParseTextToPlan" ? "rawText" : "userText"]: text, userApiKey: apiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        const newId = res.d.newPlanId;
                        loadRoute(newId); loadHistory();
                        
                        // 調用 renderUI 更新主畫面摘要
                        renderUI(res.d);

                        Swal.fire({
                            title: '行程規劃成功！', text: '是否另開分頁查看完整明細？', icon: 'success',
                            showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonColor: '#00f2fe', cancelButtonColor: '#444', confirmButtonText: '查看明細', cancelButtonText: '留在地圖'
                        }).then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${newId}`, '_blank'); });
                    } else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return; currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(r.d.data); } }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: loc.lat, lng: loc.lng }; path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5, strokeOpacity: 0.8 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function startNavigation() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先載入行程", "info");
            const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location);
            let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|');
            window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`, '_blank');
        }

        function syncToMobile() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location);
            let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|');
            let url = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`;
            Swal.fire({
                title: '同步至手機導航',
                html: '<div id="qrcode" class="flex justify-center p-5 bg-white rounded-2xl mx-auto w-fit shadow-2xl"></div><p class="text-xs text-blue-400 mt-4 font-bold">請用手機相機掃描</p>',
                background: '#111827', confirmButtonText: '完成同步',
                didOpen: () => { new QRCode(document.getElementById("qrcode"), { text: url, width: 280, height: 280, correctLevel : QRCode.CorrectLevel.L }); }
            });
        }

        function startVirtualTour() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; let i = 0; clearInterval(tourTimer);
            tourTimer = setInterval(() => {
                if (i >= currentRouteData.length) { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; return; }
                let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng };
                userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16);
                if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); }
                i++;
            }, 5000);
        }

        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (t.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val("");
            else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); }
        };

        function toggleRecord() {
            if ($("#recordBtn").hasClass('active')) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); }
            else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); }
        }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">▼ 歷史紀錄</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function centerMe() { clearInterval(tourTimer); tourTimer = null; map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); }
        function deleteCurrent() { if (!currentPlanId) return; $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/DeletePlan", data: JSON.stringify({ planId: currentPlanId }), contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function () { loadHistory(); drawMap([]); Swal.fire("已刪除"); } }); }
        function refinePlan() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return Swal.fire("提示", "請先讀取一個行程"); let context = "目前行程清單：\n" + currentRouteData.map(p => `Day${p.day}: ${p.location}`).join('\n'); callAPI("GenerateAIPlan", context + "\n使用者要求：" + $("#userInput").val()); }
        function exportData() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; const blob = new Blob([currentRouteData.map(p=>`第${p.day}天: ${p.location}`).join('\n')], { type: "text/plain" }); const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click(); }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
### 💡 關鍵變動說明： 1. 地圖加載：直接使用 `<script ... &callback=initMap>`。這會在瀏覽器解析完腳本後自動執行 `initMap`。 2. `renderUI(data)` 實作：這個函數現在會把資料庫傳回來的 `summary`（達人建議）填入畫面上的藍色小卡片中，讓規劃頁也能直接看到行程精華。 3. 語音與字體：保留了清除、逗號、句號的累積式聽寫邏輯。字體、選單、輸入框全部調大，工作面板下移 35 像素，操作感更佳。 4. 去座標化：導航與同步功能都加入了文字清洗，確保 Google 地圖出現地名與封面照。 您現在可以直接佈署這個版本。規劃完成後，畫面上應該會立刻跳出「AI 達人規劃建議」並詢問是否查看明細報告。

--- ### 2. 補全 `renderUI` 函數 請確保您的 `renderUI` 函數是長這樣的，特別注意 第 3 點 處理 summary 的邏輯：
javascript
function renderUI(data) {
    // 1. 介面切換
    $("#loading").hide();
    $("#content").removeClass("hidden");

    // 2. 設定標題
    $("#res-title").text(data.title);

    // 3. 【核心修正】：處理「AI 達人規劃建議」(Summary)
    // 確保後端回傳的欄位名稱是 summary
    if (data.summary && data.summary.trim() !== "" && data.summary !== "無簡介") {
        $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden");
        // 使用 text() 填入，配合 CSS 的 white-space: pre-wrap 可自動換行
        $("#res-summary").text(data.summary);
    } else {
        $("#summary-box").addClass("hidden");
    }

    // 4. 產生每日行程時間軸 (Timeline)
    let html = "";
    let currentDay = 0;

    data.details.forEach((item, index) => {
        if (item.day !== currentDay) {
            currentDay = item.day;
            html += `<div class="day-header" style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1f6feb 0%, transparent 100%); padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 35px 0 15px 0; font-weight: bold; color: white;"><i class="fas fa-calendar-day mr-2 text-yellow-400"></i> 第 ${currentDay} 天 行程安排</div>`;
        }

        // 地名清洗 (去座標化)
        let cleanName = item.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
        if (cleanName.length < 2) cleanName = item.location;

        html += `
            <div class="relative pl-12 pb-8">
                <div class="timeline-line" style="position: absolute; left: 20px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: #30363d;"></div>
                <div class="timeline-dot" style="position: absolute; left: 13px; width: 16px; height: 16px; background: #58a6ff; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #0d1117; z-index: 1;"></div>
                <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xl hover:border-blue-500/50 transition">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                        <h3 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-lg">${item.location}</h3>
                        <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-gray-500 bg-black/40 px-2 py-1 rounded">${item.time}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed mb-4">${item.desc}</p>
                    <div class="flex justify-start border-t border-gray-800/50 pt-3">
                        <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(cleanName)}" target="_blank" class="text-xs text-blue-400 flex items-center gap-2">
                            <i class="fas fa-location-arrow"></i> 開啟 Google 導航
                        </a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>`;
    });
    $("#timeline-box").html(html);
}
