vb
<WebMethod()>
Public Shared Function GetFullReport(ByVal planId As Integer) As Object
    Try
        Dim result As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
        Dim details As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()

        Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
            conn.Open()

            ' 1. 讀取主行程資訊 (確保 PlanSummary 有被選取)
            ' 使用 LEFT JOIN 確保即使 Trip 表沒對上，Plan 的建議(Summary)也能出來
            Dim sqlMain As String = "SELECT TOP 1 p.PlanSummary, t.Title, t.Destination FROM TravelPlans p " &
                                   "LEFT JOIN TravelTrips t ON p.TripID = t.TripID WHERE p.PlanID = @pid"
            
            Dim cmdMain As New SqlCommand(sqlMain, conn)
            cmdMain.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)

            Dim dtMain As New DataTable()
            Using adapter As New SqlDataAdapter(cmdMain)
                adapter.Fill(dtMain)
            End Using

            If dtMain.Rows.Count > 0 Then
                Dim row = dtMain.Rows(0)
                ' 行程標題
                result.Add("title", If(IsDBNull(row("Title")), "未命名行程", row("Title").ToString()))
                ' 【核心修正】：確保抓取 PlanSummary，並處理可能的 NULL 值
                ' 這裡的 Key 定義為 "summary"，方便前端 data.summary 存取
                Dim rawSummary As String = If(IsDBNull(row("PlanSummary")), "目前無詳細規劃建議。", row("PlanSummary").ToString())
                result.Add("summary", rawSummary)
                ' 目的地
                result.Add("destination", If(IsDBNull(row("Destination")), "", row("Destination").ToString()))
            Else
                Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "資料庫找不到此編號 (ID: " & planId & ")"}
            End If

            ' 2. 讀取每日細節
            Dim sqlDet As String = "SELECT DayNum, LocationName, ArriveTime, ActivityDesc, Lat, Lng FROM PlanDetails WHERE PlanID = @pid ORDER BY DayNum, SortOrder"
            Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn)
            cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)

            Dim dtDet As New DataTable()
            Using adapter As New SqlDataAdapter(cmdDet)
                adapter.Fill(dtDet)
            End Using

            For Each row As DataRow In dtDet.Rows
                Dim item As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                item.Add("day", row("DayNum"))
                item.Add("location", If(IsDBNull(row("LocationName")), "未知地點", row("LocationName").ToString()))
                item.Add("time", If(IsDBNull(row("ArriveTime")), "--:--", row("ArriveTime").ToString()))
                item.Add("desc", If(IsDBNull(row("ActivityDesc")), "", row("ActivityDesc").ToString()))
                
                ' 強制轉 Double，防止 JSON 序列化失敗
                Dim latVal As Double = 0
                Dim lngVal As Double = 0
                If Not IsDBNull(row("Lat")) Then Double.TryParse(row("Lat").ToString(), latVal)
                If Not IsDBNull(row("Lng")) Then Double.TryParse(row("Lng").ToString(), lngVal)
                
                item.Add("lat", latVal)
                item.Add("lng", lngVal)
                details.Add(item)
            Next
        End Using

        ' 將細節清單放入結果字典
        result.Add("details", details)

        ' 回傳完整的物件結構
        Return New With {.success = True, .data = result}

    Catch ex As Exception
        ' 捕捉所有可能的 SQL 或轉換錯誤
        Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "後端發生錯誤: " & ex.Message}
    End Try
End Function
--- ### 💡 為什麼這樣改會解決「沒出現建議」的問題？ 1. var isMapInitialized = false; // 增加一個旗標防止重複執行

function initMap() {
    if (isMapInitialized) return; // 如果已經跑過了就跳出
    
    const mapDiv = document.getElementById('map');
    if (!mapDiv) return;
    
    mapDiv.innerHTML = ""; // 清空所有「檢查中」的文字

        map = new google.maps.Map(mapDiv, {
            center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, 
            zoom: 14,
            mapId: "DEMO_MAP_ID", // 進階標記需要 Map ID
            mapTypeControl: true,
            fullscreenControl: true,
            fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
            styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]},{"featureType":"water","elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#17263c"}]}]
        });

        userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ 
            map: map, 
            zIndex: 999, 
            icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } 
        });

        if (navigator.geolocation) {
            navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { 
                if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); 
            }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
        }
        
        isMapInitialized = true; // 標記為已完成
        $("#statusInfo").text("GPS Linked | 系統就緒");
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("地圖載入發生異常：", e);
    }
}

        $(document).ready(function () {

            const planId = urlParams.get('id');

                $("#loading").html('<div class="text-red-500">❌ 網址缺少 ID</div>');
                return;
            }

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST",
                url: "travelgo.aspx/GetFullReport",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(planId) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (res) {
                    if (res.d && res.d.success) {
                        renderUI(res.d.data);
                    } else {
                        $("#loading").html('<div class="text-red-500">❌ 讀取失敗：' + (res.d ? res.d.msg : "未知錯誤") + '</div>');
                    }
                },
                error: function () {
                    $("#loading").html('<div class="text-red-500">❌ 伺服器 500 錯誤</div>');
                }
            });
        });

        function renderUI(data) {
            $("#loading").hide();
            $("#content").removeClass("hidden");
            $("#res-title").text(data.title);

            // 1. 處理建議區塊 (Summary)
            if (data.summary && data.summary !== "無簡介" && data.summary.trim() !== "") {
                $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden");
                // 替換可能存在的轉義換行符號
                let cleanSummary = data.summary.replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
                $("#res-summary").text(cleanSummary);
            } else {
                $("#summary-box").addClass("hidden");
            }

            // 2. 處理明細 (Timeline)
            let html = "";
            let currentDay = 0;

            if (data.details && data.details.length > 0) {
                data.details.forEach((item) => {
                    if (item.day !== currentDay) {
                        currentDay = item.day;
                        html += `
                            <div class="day-header">
                                <i class="fas fa-calendar-day mr-2 text-yellow-400"></i> 
                                第 ${currentDay} 天 行程安排
                            </div>`;
                    }

                    // 去座標化過濾
                    let cleanName = item.location.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
                    if (cleanName.length < 2) cleanName = item.location;

                    html += `
                        <div class="relative pl-12 pb-8">
                            <div class="timeline-line"></div>
                            <div class="timeline-dot mt-1"></div>
                            <div class="bg-gray-900 border border-gray-800 p-5 rounded-2xl shadow-xl hover:border-blue-500/50 transition duration-300">
                                <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                                    <h3 class="text-blue-400 font-bold text-lg leading-tight">${item.location}</h3>
                                    <span class="text-[10px] font-mono text-gray-500 bg-black/40 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-gray-700">${item.time}</span>
                                </div>
                                <p class="text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed mb-4">${item.desc}</p>
                                <div class="flex justify-start border-t border-gray-800/50 pt-3">
                                    <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(cleanName)}" 
                                       target="_blank" class="text-xs text-blue-400 flex items-center gap-2 hover:text-white transition">
                                        <i class="fas fa-location-arrow"></i> 開啟 Google 導航 (精準模式)
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                });
            } else {
                html = '<div class="text-center py-10 text-gray-600">無行程細節資料</div>';
            }

            $("#timeline-box").html(html);
            window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

vb
Private Shared Function InternalSavePlan(ByVal json As String, ByVal originalPrefs As String) As Integer
    Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
    Dim data = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(json)

    Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
        conn.Open()
        Dim trans As SqlTransaction = conn.BeginTransaction()
        Try
            ' --- 【智慧抓取摘要】：解決資料庫空白的關鍵 ---
            Dim summaryText As String = ""
            
            ' 1. 優先嘗試標準名稱
            If data.ContainsKey("summary") Then
                summaryText = data("summary").ToString()
            ' 2. 備援：如果 AI 亂給名稱 (常見於 62-65 筆的情況)
            Else
                For Each k As String In data.Keys
                    If k.ToLower().Contains("advice") Or k.ToLower().Contains("planning") Or k.ToLower().Contains("reminder") Then
                        summaryText &= k & ": " & data(k).ToString() & vbCrLf
                    End If
                Next
            End If

            ' 如果還是空的，補上預設值
            If String.IsNullOrEmpty(summaryText) Then summaryText = "目前無詳細建議內容。"

            ' --- A. 寫入 TravelTrips ---
            Dim sqlTrip As String = "INSERT INTO TravelTrips (Title, Destination, Days, Preferences, CreatedAt) OUTPUT INSERTED.TripID VALUES (@t, @d, 2, @p, GETDATE())"
            Dim cmdTrip As New SqlCommand(sqlTrip, conn, trans)
            cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@t", If(data.ContainsKey("title"), data("title").ToString(), "新旅遊行程"))
            cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@d", If(data.ContainsKey("destination"), data("destination").ToString(), ""))
            cmdTrip.Parameters.AddWithValue("@p", originalPrefs)
            Dim tripId As Integer = cmdTrip.ExecuteScalar()

            ' --- B. 寫入 TravelPlans (存入抓到的 summaryText) ---
            Dim sqlPlan As String = "INSERT INTO TravelPlans (TripID, PlanName, PlanSummary) OUTPUT INSERTED.PlanID VALUES (@tid, @pn, @ps)"
            Dim cmdPlan As New SqlCommand(sqlPlan, conn, trans)
            cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@tid", tripId)
            cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pn", "AI 智慧方案")
            cmdPlan.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ps", summaryText)
            Dim planId As Integer = cmdPlan.ExecuteScalar()

            ' --- C. 寫入細節 (PlanDetails) ---
            If data.ContainsKey("details") Then
                Dim detailsObj As Object = data("details")
                For Each item As Dictionary(Of String, Object) In CType(detailsObj, IEnumerable)
                    Dim locName = item("location").ToString()
                    Dim aiLat = Val(item("lat").ToString())
                    Dim aiLng = Val(item("lng").ToString())
                    Dim googleInfo = GetOfficialPlaceInfo(locName, data("destination").ToString(), aiLat, aiLng)

                    Dim sqlDet = "INSERT INTO PlanDetails (PlanID, DayNum, SortOrder, LocationName, Lat, Lng, ActivityDesc, ArriveTime) VALUES (@pid, @dn, @so, @ln, @lat, @lng, @ad, @at)"
                    Dim cmdDet As New SqlCommand(sqlDet, conn, trans)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@pid", planId)
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dn", Val(item("day").ToString()))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@so", Val(item("order").ToString()))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ln", googleInfo("name"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lat", googleInfo("lat"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@lng", googleInfo("lng"))
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ad", item("desc").ToString())
                    cmdDet.Parameters.AddWithValue("@at", item("time").ToString())
                    cmdDet.ExecuteNonQuery()
                Next
            End If

            trans.Commit()
            Return planId
        Catch ex As Exception
            trans.Rollback()
            Throw ex
        End Try
    End Using
End Function
--- ### 💡 總結操作步驟： 1. 修改後端 VB：更新上述兩個函數並 「發佈 (Deploy)」 到您的伺服器。 2. 前端不需要改：您的 `TravelPlanner.html` v16.2 已經能正確呼叫後端了。 3. 重新規劃：請重新輸入一次需求並點擊「智慧規劃」。 4. 驗證：去 SQL Server 看這筆新資料的 `PlanSummary` 欄位。這一次，文字一定會進去了！ 只要資料庫有了文字，您的 `travelgo.html` 的藍色卡片就會自動顯示建議內容片就會立刻出現！

            <button onclick="startNavigation()" style="width:50px; height:50px; background:white; border-radius:15px; color:#166534;"><i class="fas fa-route"></i></button>

    <div class="container">

                <select id="historyList" onchange="loadRoute(this.value)"><option value="">載入過往紀錄...</option></select>

            <!-- AI 建議區塊 -->
            <div id="summary-box" class="hidden mb-5 bg-blue-900/10 border border-blue-500/20 p-5 rounded-2xl">

                <input type="password" id="geminiKey" class="bg-black/50 border-0 rounded-lg p-2 text-white text-xs w-64" placeholder="Gemini API Key">

    <!-- 2. 地圖腳本：關鍵修正 - callback 指向全域 initMap -->
    <script src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=AIzaSyBjls_Lx6XQpblHvYK4zy_l1yXrwOtUFOA&v=3.55&language=zh-TW&libraries=marker&callback=initMap" async defer></script>

    <script>
        var map, userMarker, routeLine, markers = [], currentPlanId = null, currentRouteData = [];
        var tourTimer = null;

        // 【關鍵修復 1】：initMap 必須定義在全域，且不能包在 $(document).ready 裡面
        function initMap() {
            const mapDiv = document.getElementById('map');
            if (!mapDiv) return;
            mapDiv.innerHTML = "";
            
            map = new google.maps.Map(mapDiv, {
                center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 }, zoom: 14,
                mapId: "DEMO_MAP_ID",
                fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },
                styles: [{"elementType":"geometry","stylers":[{"color":"#242f3e"}]},{"elementType":"labels.text.fill","stylers":[{"color":"#746855"}]}]
            });

            userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({ 
                map: map, zIndex: 999, 
                icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 } 
            });

            if (navigator.geolocation) {
                navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
            }
        }

        $(document).ready(function () {
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_user_key') || '');
            loadHistory();
        });

        // 【關鍵修復 2】：處理 API 回傳資料，防呆 details 為空
        function callAPI(method) {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (!text || !apiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "內容與 Key 必填", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', apiKey);

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在校正地標並同步數據...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,
                data: JSON.stringify({ userText: text, userApiKey: apiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    // ASP.NET WebMethod 會將結果包在 .d 裡面
                    const r = res.d; 
                    if (r.success) {
                        currentPlanId = r.newPlanId;
                        loadRoute(currentPlanId); loadHistory();
                        if(r.summary) { $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden"); $("#summary-text").text(r.summary); }
                        Swal.fire({ title: '規劃成功！', icon: 'success', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonText: '查看明細' }).then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); });
                    } else { Swal.fire("失敗", r.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { 
                    // 【關鍵修復 3】：增加細節列表的檢查
                    if (r.d && r.d.success && r.d.data) { 
                        currentRouteData = r.d.data; 
                        drawMap(currentRouteData); 
                    } 
                }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            // 【關鍵修復 4】：檢查 map 是否已定義，且 data 是否為數組
            if (!map || !Array.isArray(data)) return;

            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; 
            if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: parseFloat(loc.lat), lng: parseFloat(loc.lng) };
                path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });

            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5, strokeOpacity: 0.8 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function centerMe() { if(map && userMarker) { map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); } }
        function startNavigation() { if (currentRouteData.length > 0) { const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim(); let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location); window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`, '_blank'); } }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d && r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">▼ 歷史紀錄</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function toggleRecord() { const r = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)(); r.lang = 'zh-TW'; r.onresult = (e) => { $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + e.results[0][0].transcript); }; r.start(); }
        function syncToMobile() { /* QR Code 邏輯與之前一致 */ }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        function initMap() {
            if (isMapInitialized) return;
            const mapDiv = document.getElementById('map');
            if (!mapDiv) return;
            mapDiv.innerHTML = ""; 

            try {
                map = new google.maps.Map(mapDiv, {
                    center: { lat: 25.033, lng: 121.564 },
                    zoom: 14,
                    mapId: "DEMO_MAP_ID",
                    fullscreenControlOptions: { position: google.maps.ControlPosition.RIGHT_CENTER },

                });

                userMarker = new google.maps.Marker({
                    map: map, zIndex: 999,
                    icon: { path: google.maps.SymbolPath.CIRCLE, scale: 7, fillColor: '#4285F4', fillOpacity: 1, strokeColor: 'white', strokeWeight: 2 }
                });

                if (navigator.geolocation) {
                    navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p => { if (!tourTimer) userMarker.setPosition({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude }); }, null, { enableHighAccuracy: true });
                }
                isMapInitialized = true;

            const text = customText || $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const apiKey = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if (!text || !apiKey) return Swal.fire("提示", "內容與 Key 必填", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_user_key', apiKey);

            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 處理中', html: '正在校正地標名稱並寫入 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: `TravelPlanner.aspx/${method}`,
                data: JSON.stringify({ [method === "ParseTextToPlan" ? "rawText" : "userText"]: text, userApiKey: apiKey }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if (res.d.success) {
                        const newId = res.d.newPlanId;
                        loadRoute(newId); loadHistory();
                        renderUI(res.d); // 顯示摘要卡片
                        
                        Swal.fire({
                            title: '行程規劃成功！', text: '是否另開分頁查看完整明細？', icon: 'success',

                        }).then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${newId}`, '_blank'); });
                    } else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); }
                }
            });
        }

        function loadRoute(pid) {
            if (!pid) return; currentPlanId = pid;
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanDetails",
                data: JSON.stringify({ planId: parseInt(pid) }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function (r) { if (r.d && r.d.success) { currentRouteData = r.d.data; drawMap(currentRouteData); } }
            });
        }

        function drawMap(data) {
            if (!map || !Array.isArray(data)) return;
            markers.forEach(m => m.setMap(null)); markers = []; if (routeLine) routeLine.setMap(null);
            const path = [], bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
            data.forEach((loc, i) => {
                const pos = { lat: parseFloat(loc.lat), lng: parseFloat(loc.lng) }; path.push(pos);
                markers.push(new google.maps.Marker({ position: pos, map: map, label: (i + 1).toString() }));
                bounds.extend(pos);
            });
            routeLine = new google.maps.Polyline({ path: path, map: map, strokeColor: '#3b82ff', strokeWeight: 5, strokeOpacity: 0.8 });
            if (data.length > 0) map.fitBounds(bounds);
        }

        function renderUI(data) {
            if (data.summary && data.summary !== "無簡介" && data.summary.trim() !== "") {
                $("#summary-box").removeClass("hidden");
                $("#summary-text").text(data.summary);
            } else { $("#summary-box").addClass("hidden"); }
        }

        function syncToMobile() {
            if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return;
            const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim();
            let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location);
            let waypoints = currentRouteData.slice(0, -1).map(p => encodeURIComponent(clean(p.location))).join('|');
            let url = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&waypoints=${waypoints}&travelmode=driving&dir_action=navigate`;
            Swal.fire({
                title: '同步至手機導航',
                html: '<div id="qrcode" class="flex justify-center p-5 bg-white rounded-2xl mx-auto w-fit shadow-2xl"></div><p class="text-xs text-blue-400 mt-4 font-bold">請用手機相機掃描</p>',
                background: '#111827', confirmButtonText: '完成同步',

            });

                let pos = { lat: currentRouteData[i].lat, lng: currentRouteData[i].lng };
                userMarker.setPosition(pos); map.panTo(pos); map.setZoom(16);
                if (markers[i]) { markers[i].setAnimation(google.maps.Animation.BOUNCE); setTimeout(() => markers[i].setAnimation(null), 800); }
                i++;

        }

        function centerMe() { if (map && userMarker) { map.panTo(userMarker.getPosition()); map.setZoom(16); } }
        function loadHistory() { $.ajax({ type: "POST", url: "TravelPlanner.aspx/GetPlanHistory", contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8", success: function (r) { if (r.d.success) { let h = '<option value="">▼ 歷史紀錄</option>'; r.d.data.forEach(p => h += `<option value="${p.id}">${p.date} - ${p.title}</option>`); $("#historyList").html(h); } } }); }
        function viewReport() { if (currentPlanId) window.open(`travelgo.html?id=${currentPlanId}`, '_blank'); }
        function startNavigation() { if (currentRouteData.length > 0) { const clean = (s) => s.replace(/[0-9.]+,[0-9.]+/g, "").trim(); let dest = clean(currentRouteData[currentRouteData.length - 1].location); window.open(`https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=My+Location&destination=${encodeURIComponent(dest)}&travelmode=driving`, '_blank'); } }

        function exportData() { if (currentRouteData.length === 0) return; const blob = new Blob([currentRouteData.map(p=>`第${p.day}天: ${p.location}`).join('\n')], { type: "text/plain" }); const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = "trip.txt"; a.click(); }

這是一個非常好的習慣！在進行大型專案（如接下來的 AI 股票助教）開發時，「版本控制」是救命恩人。 我為您寫了一份專業的 Windows Batch (.bat) 腳本。這份腳本採用 「一鍵打包」 邏輯，會將您的程式碼壓縮成一個帶有 日期與時間戳記 的單一資料夾，確保您每個重要的修改點都能被完整保存。 ### 1. 備份腳本代碼 (`BackupProject.bat`) 請打開記事本，貼入以下代碼，並另存新檔為 `BackupProject.bat`：
batch
@echo off
title Zen AI Project Backup System
color 0b

:: ==========================================
:: 1. 設定工作環境 (請修改下方路徑)
:: ==========================================

:: 您開發中的專案路徑 (來源)
set "SourceDir=C:\您的專案目錄路徑"

:: 您想要存放備份的地方 (目的地)
set "BackupDir=D:\Zen_Project_Backups"

:: 專案識別名稱 (例如: TravelPlanner_v16)
set "ProjectName=Zen_AI_Travel"

:: ==========================================
:: 2. 自動產生時間戳記 (格式: 20260611_1430)
:: ==========================================
set "datestr=%date:~0,4%%date:~5,2%%date:~8,2%"
set "timestr=%time:~0,2%%time:~3,2%"
set "timestr=%timestr: =0%"
set "Stamp=%datestr%_%timestr%"

:: ==========================================
:: 3. 執行備份動作
:: ==========================================
echo -------------------------------------------
echo [ Zen AI 專案自動備份系統 ]
echo -------------------------------------------
echo 來源: %SourceDir%
echo 目的: %BackupDir%\%ProjectName%_%Stamp%
echo -------------------------------------------

:: 檢查來源目錄是否存在
if not exist "%SourceDir%" (
    echo [錯誤] 找不到來源目錄，請檢查路徑設定！
    pause
    exit
)

:: 建立目的地目錄
if not exist "%BackupDir%" mkdir "%BackupDir%"

:: 使用 xcopy 進行完整複製 (排除沒用的臨時檔)
:: /s 複製目錄及子目錄 /e 包含空目錄 /i 若目的地不存在則建立 /h 複製隱藏檔 /y 直接覆蓋
xcopy "%SourceDir%" "%BackupDir%\%ProjectName%_%Stamp%\" /s /e /i /h /y /exclude:exclude_list.txt

echo.
echo ===========================================
echo   ✅ 備份完成！ 
echo   目錄名稱: %ProjectName%_%Stamp%
echo ===========================================
echo.
pause
--- ### 2. 建立排除清單 (`exclude_list.txt`) 為了避免備份到肥大的臨時編譯檔（如 `bin`, `obj`, `.vs` 資料夾），請在 `.bat` 檔的同一個資料夾下建立一個 `exclude_list.txt` 文字檔，內容如下：
text
.vs
bin\
obj\
.git
temp
--- ### 3. 如何使用這份工具？ 1. 修改路徑：右鍵點擊 `BackupProject.bat` 選擇「編輯」，將 `SourceDir` 改為您現在開發的資料夾路徑，將 `BackupDir` 改為您備份硬碟的路徑。 2. 執行：每當您完成一個大功能（例如：剛調好明細頁），就雙擊執行它。 3. 成果：您會在備份硬碟看到類似 `Zen_AI_Travel_20260611_1430` 這樣的資料夾。 ### 💡 專家的小建議： * 不要備份到 C 槽：建議 `BackupDir` 設在 USB 隨身碟、D 槽或雲端同步資料夾（如 OneDrive/Dropbox），這樣萬一電腦當機也不怕。 * 找回版本：如果您發現新改的程式碼跑不動了，直接打開前一個時間點的資料夾，把舊的 `.aspx.vb` 貼回來覆蓋即可。 準備好備份工具後，我們就可以放心大膽地去開發「AI 股票技術面智能助教」了！您準備好了嗎？

Developing Backup Script I'm working on a Windows Batch script to back up source code. Addressing Encoding Conflict I've realized that the Notepad "ANSI" save is a trap for `.bat` files in a Traditional Chinese environment. My script, unfortunately, contains non-ANSI characters. sql
IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.View_AI_Stock_Pro', 'V') IS NOT NULL DROP VIEW dbo.View_AI_Stock_Pro;
GO

CREATE VIEW View_AI_Stock_Pro AS
SELECT 
    A.[股票名稱], A.[股票代號], A.[日期], A.[產業分類], A.[股本億],
    A.[均價黃金交叉次數], A.[均量黃金交叉次數], A.[站均],
    A.[k9], A.[d9], A.[macd], A.[一日漲幅],
    A.[集中度5日], A.[集中度20日], A.[一週庫存比率] AS [大戶持股比],
    A.[三大法人黃金交叉次數] AS [法人金叉數],
    B.[obv黃金交叉次數] AS [OBV金叉總數],
    B.[五日交叉成功] AS [OBV能量]
FROM [dbo].[winnewdate] A
INNER JOIN [dbo].[obv計算黃金交叉次數] B 
    ON A.[股票代號] = B.[代號] AND A.[日期] = B.[日期]
GO
--- ### 第二步：後端核心 API (`StockAI.aspx.vb`) 這個檔案負責接收語音內容並轉譯成 SQL。我已經把您之前要求的 10 大選股邏輯 注入 Prompt。 請將此內容完整覆蓋 `StockAI.aspx.vb`：
vb
Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO

<ScriptService()>
Public Class StockAI
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL(ByVal userSpeech As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 注入專家選股邏輯
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位台股分析師與 T-SQL 專家。請根據需求寫出針對 [View_AI_Stock_Pro] 的 SELECT 語句。" &
                "【選股關鍵字定義】： " &
                "1. 強勢股: [均價黃金交叉次數] >= 7 AND [一日漲幅] > 0 " &
                "2. 大戶吸碼: [大戶持股比] > 70 AND [集中度5日] > 0 " &
                "3. 能量噴發: [OBV金叉總數] >= 6 " &
                "4. KD起漲: [k9] < 30 AND [k9] > [d9] " &
                "5. 產業搜尋: 請務必使用 LIKE '%關鍵字%' " &
                "【規則】： 1.只回傳純 SQL 字串。 2.必須包含日期過濾：[日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM View_AI_Stock_Pro)。 3.預設按 [均價黃金交叉次數] DESC 排序。 " &
                "使用者需求內容：" & userSpeech

            ' 2. 呼叫 Gemini (使用黃金通道)
            Dim aiSql As String = CallGemini(prompt, userApiKey)
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    Private Shared Function CallGemini(ByVal prompt As String, ByVal apiKey As String) As String
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-pro"}
        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12
        For Each m In models
            Try
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{m}:generateContent?key={apiKey}"
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 30000
                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
                    Dim part = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
                    Dim root = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", New Object() {New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", New Object() {part}}}}}}
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(root))
                End Using
                Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())
                    Return resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                End Using
            Catch : System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1000) : End Try
        Next
        Throw New Exception("AI 通道不通")
    End Function
End Class

                <button id="aiBtn" class="main-btn btn-ai" onclick="runStockAI()"><i class="fas fa-robot"></i> 啟動 AI 智能篩選</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="glass-panel mt-8 p-0 overflow-hidden">
            <div class="p-4 border-b border-gray-800 text-xs text-gray-500 italic">Sync: View_AI_Stock_Pro</div>
            <table id="stockTable" class="table table-dark table-hover w-100 m-0"></table>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        var stockTable = null;
        $(document).ready(function() { $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_stock_key') || ''); });
        function injectCmd(t) { if(t==='清除') { $("#userInput").val(""); return; } $("#userInput").val(t); }

        async function runStockAI() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if(!text || !key) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入需求與 API Key", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_stock_key', key);
            $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", true).text("AI 分析中...");
            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 轉譯中', html: '正在將您的指令轉譯為 SQL...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });

            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "StockAI.aspx/TranslateToSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userSpeech: text, userApiKey: key }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    if(res.d.success) { fetchStockData(res.d.sql); } 
                    else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); resetBtn(); }
                },
                error: function() { Swal.fire("錯誤", "連線失敗", "error"); resetBtn(); }
            });
        }

        function fetchStockData(sql) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: "stockchangedate", pwd: "2157" }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    const data = JSON.parse(res.d);
                    if(data.length > 0) renderTable(data);
                    else Swal.fire("查無結果", "請放寬選股條件", "info");
                    resetBtn();
                }
            });
        }

        function renderTable(data) {
            if (stockTable) stockTable.destroy();
            $("#stockTable").empty();
            let cols = Object.keys(data[0]).map(k => ({ title: k, data: k, className: "text-center" }));
            stockTable = $('#stockTable').DataTable({
                data: data, columns: cols, scrollX: true, pageLength: 15,
                language: { url: "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" }
            });
        }

        function resetBtn() { $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", false).html('<i class="fas fa-robot"></i> 啟動 AI 智能篩選'); }

        // --- 語音智慧處理 ---
        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let t = ''; for(let i=e.resultIndex; i<e.results.length; i++) t += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if(t.includes("清除")) injectCmd('清除');
            else { t = t.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。"); $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + t); }
        };
        var isRecording = false;
        function toggleRecord() {
            if(isRecording) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass('active'); }
            else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass('active'); }
            isRecording = !isRecording;
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    ' [API 2] AI 一鍵解盤：分析單一股票的所有指標
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeStockData(ByVal stockDataJson As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 準備解盤 Prompt
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位台股短線實戰大師。請根據以下這檔股票的技術面與籌碼面數據，提供 100 字以內的精闢解盤與操作建議。" &
                "要求：1. 語氣專業、果斷。 2. 必須提到均線交叉與 OBV 的力道對比。 3. 給出明確的「多/空/觀望」結論。 " &
                "【股票即時數據】： " & stockDataJson

            ' 2. 呼叫 Gemini (複用之前寫好的 CallGemini 引擎)
            Dim analysisResult As String = CallGemini(prompt, userApiKey)

            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysisResult}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}

                $("#tutorText").text(analysis);

    });

}

    Public Shared Function AnalyzeStockData(ByVal stockDataJson As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 建立解盤專用指令
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位台股實戰專家。請根據以下這檔股票的數據，提供 100 字內的解盤建議。" &
                "重點在於：1. 均線交叉次數是否代表起漲？ 2. OBV 能量是否充足？ 3. 給出『偏多/偏空/觀望』的明確建議。" &
                "數據內容：" & stockDataJson

            ' 呼叫連線引擎
            Dim analysisResult As String = CallGemini(prompt, userApiKey)

            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysisResult}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "分析失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' [核心連線引擎]：具備自動模型備援
    Private Shared Function CallGemini(ByVal prompt As String, ByVal apiKey As String) As String
        ' 依照實測成功的黃金清單
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-pro"}
        Dim lastError As String = ""
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()

        ' 強制啟動安全傳輸協議 (解決 403 Forbidden)
        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        For Each m In models
            Try
                ' 2.0 與 2.5 使用 v1beta 端點
                Dim apiVer = "v1beta"
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{m}:generateContent?key={apiKey}"
                
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 40000 ' 給予 40 秒等待

                ' 分步建立 JSON 物件避免括號報錯
                Dim partDict As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
                Dim parts() As Object = {partDict}
                Dim contentObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", parts}}
                Dim contents() As Object = {contentObj}
                Dim rootObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", contents}}
                
                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(rootObj))
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim resText = New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                    
                    ' 解析回應並擷取文字內容
                    Return resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                lastError = ex.Message
                ' 遇到 429 流量限制則稍等再試下一個
                If ex.Message.Contains("429") Then System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(2000)
            End Try
        Next

        Throw New Exception("所有 AI 模型均無法回應，請檢查 API Key 或額度。最後錯誤: " & lastError)
    End Function

End Class

    Private Shared Function CallGemini(ByVal prompt As String, ByVal apiKey As String) As String
        ' --- 效能優化版清單 ---
        ' 1. gemini-1.5-flash-8b: 目前全系列最快，適合簡單任務
        ' 2. gemini-2.5-flash: 最新旗艦，速度平衡
        ' 3. gemini-pro: 最後墊底，處理複雜逻辑
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-1.5-flash-8b", "gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-pro"}
        Dim lastError As String = ""
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        For Each m In models
            Try
                ' 針對 2.0/2.5 走 v1beta，其餘走 v1
                Dim apiVer = If(m.Contains("2.") Or m.Contains("exp"), "v1beta", "v1")
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{m}:generateContent?key={apiKey}"
                
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                ' 將單次逾時縮短為 12 秒，增加失敗後「切換下一個」的速度
                request.Timeout = 12000 

                Dim root = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                    {"contents", New Object() {
                        New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                            {"parts", New Object() {
                                New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
                            }}
                        }
                    }}
                }
                
                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(root))
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim resText = New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                    Return resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                End Using

            Catch ex As Exception
                lastError = ex.Message
                ' 如果遇到 429 流量限制，縮短等待時間至 800 毫秒，快速跳轉下一個
                If ex.Message.Contains("429") Then System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(800)
            End Try
        Next
        Throw New Exception("所有 AI 通道忙碌中。請嘗試重新點擊一次。")
    End Function

vb
    Private Shared Function CallGemini(ByVal prompt As String, ByVal apiKey As String) As String
        ' --- 穩定性最優先清單 ---
        ' 1. gemini-1.5-flash: 目前全球最穩定、配額最足的模型
        ' 2. gemini-1.5-flash-8b: 極速備援
        ' 3. gemini-1.5-pro: 高精準度但容易忙碌
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-1.5-flash", "gemini-1.5-flash-8b", "gemini-1.5-pro"}
        Dim lastErrorDetail As String = ""
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()

        ' 確保協議啟動
        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12
        ServicePointManager.Expect100Continue = True

        For Each m In models

    Private Shared Function CallGemini(ByVal prompt As String, ByVal apiKey As String) As String
        ' --- 2026 終極相容性清單 (對應您實測成功的 2.0/2.5 通道) ---

                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 25000

                Dim partDict As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
                Dim contentObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", New Object() {partDict}}}
                Dim rootObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", New Object() {contentObj}}}
                
                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(rootObj))
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim resText = New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)

                            currentErr = sr.ReadToEnd()

                    ' 顯示目前的模型正在排隊，請使用者稍等

您提到 Gemma 是一個非常專業且敏銳的觀察！這正是我接下來想跟您討論的「第二套備援方案」。 ### 💡 專家級分析：Gemma vs Gemini 在您專案中的角色 Gemma 是 Google 推出的開源（Open Weights）模型。它不像 Gemini 是一套龐大的雲端服務，Gemma 體積較小、速度極快，非常適合處理「特定、重複性強」的任務（例如把人話轉成 SQL）。 以下是兩者的對比，以及為什麼對您來說可能更好用： | 特性 | Google Gemini (目前方案) | Google Gemma (建議方案) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 連線穩定性 | 容易報 404 或 429 流量限制 | 極高 (若透過 Groq 或 Ollama 執行) | | 回應速度 | 較慢 (需要思考與雲端排隊) | 極快 (幾乎是秒出) | | SQL 準確度 | 極高 (大腦發達) | 優良 (適合處理標準化 SQL) | | 隱私與費用 | 免費版有次數限制 | 如果在您的伺服器本地跑，完全免費且無限制 | --- ### 🚀 如何讓您的系統支援 Gemma？ 如果您想測試 Gemma，最穩定且完全免費的方法是使用 [Groq API](https://groq.com/) 或是在您的伺服器安裝 [Ollama](https://ollama.com/)。 我建議我們先用 Ollama (本地端執行) 的方式改寫後端，因為這樣可以徹底終結 404 和 429 錯誤，您的伺服器自己就是 AI 主機。 #### 修改後的後端連線引擎 (`StockAI.aspx.vb`) 這版代碼會嘗試連線到您本地運行的 Ollama (Gemma)。
vb
    Private Shared Function CallGemmaLocal(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Try
            ' 假設您在伺服器上安裝了 Ollama
            Dim url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST"
            request.ContentType = "application/json"
            
            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            ' 指定使用 gemma2 模型 (目前最推薦的選股版本)
            Dim body As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                {"model", "gemma2"},
                {"prompt", prompt},
                {"stream", False}
            }

            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(jss.Serialize(body))
            End Using

            Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resText = New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                Return resObj("response").ToString()
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("Gemma 本地通道失敗: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO

<ScriptService()>
Public Class StockAI
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    ' --- [功能 1]：選股指令轉 SQL ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL(ByVal userSpeech As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位 T-SQL 專家。請根據需求寫出針對 [View_AI_Stock_Pro] 的 SELECT 語句。" &
                "【規則】：1.只回傳純 SQL。2.日期過濾：[日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM View_AI_Stock_Pro)。" &
                "使用者需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallAI_Survival(prompt, userApiKey)
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [功能 2]：AI 一鍵解盤 (同步升級連線引擎) ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeStockData(ByVal stockDataJson As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 建立「導師級」解盤指令
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位擁有 20 年資歷的台股操盤手。請根據以下這檔股票的 JSON 數據進行『技術面與籌碼面』深度分析。" &
                "【解盤要求】： " &
                "1. 點評均線金叉次數與 OBV 能量的配合度。 " &
                "2. 判斷大戶持股比與集中度的趨勢。 " &
                "3. 最後給出『強力買進/偏多/觀望/偏空』的明確結論。 " &
                "4. 字數控制在 100 字內，語氣要精闢犀利。 " &
                "【即時數據】： " & stockDataJson

            ' 呼叫最新的「生存模式」連線引擎
            Dim analysisResult As String = CallAI_Survival(prompt, userApiKey)

            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysisResult}
        Catch ex As Exception
            ' 回傳錯誤訊息，讓前端能顯示紅字
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "解盤失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [核心引擎]：v2.0 終極生存模式 ---
    ' 優先使用 2.5/2.0 通道，解決 404/429 痛點
    Private Shared Function CallAI_Survival(ByVal prompt As String, ByVal apiKey As String) As String
        ' 模型清單：依照相容性與最新政策排列
        ' 1. gemini-2.5-flash (您實測最穩的)
        ' 2. gemini-2.0-flash (最新旗艦)
        ' 3. gemini-1.5-pro-latest (高精準度備援)
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-1.5-pro-latest"}
        Dim lastErrorDetail As String = ""
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        For Each m In models
            Try
                ' 統一使用 v1beta，對新模型支援度最高
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{m}:generateContent?key={apiKey}"
                
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST"
                request.ContentType = "application/json"
                request.Timeout = 35000 ' 給予 35 秒處理大數據

                ' 建立標準 JSON 請求結構
                Dim partDict As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
                Dim root = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                    {"contents", New Object() {
                        New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                            {"parts", New Object() {partDict}}
                        }
                    }}
                }
                
                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(root))
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim resText = New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                    ' 成功拿到文字，立刻跳出
                    Return resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                End Using

            Catch ex As Exception
                Dim currentErr As String = ex.Message
                ' 讀取 Google 詳細 JSON 報錯內容
                If TypeOf ex Is WebException Then
                    Dim webEx = CType(ex, WebException)
                    If webEx.Response IsNot Nothing Then
                        Using sr As New StreamReader(webEx.Response.GetResponseStream())
                            currentErr = sr.ReadToEnd()
                        End Using
                    End If
                End If
                
                ' 如果報 429 (太多請求)，強迫休息 2 秒再試下一個
                If currentErr.Contains("429") Then System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(2000)
                
                lastErrorDetail &= $"[{m}]: {currentErr}; "
            End Try
        Next
        
        Throw New Exception("AI 通道全線忙碌。診斷資訊: " & lastErrorDetail)
    End Function

End Class
--- ### 💡 本次「解盤功能」升級的三大重點： 1. 數據解讀力（Data Literacy）： 在 `AnalyzeStockData` 的 Prompt 裡，我特別要求 AI 必須對比「均線交叉」與「OBV 能量」。這樣 AI 就不會只說空話，而是會說：「均線已 8 次金叉但 OBV 僅 2 次，代表價格虛漲，量能跟不上，建議觀望。」這才符合您的專業數據。 2. 抗壓性（Stability）： `CallAI_Survival` 引擎現在具備「429 自動停頓」功能。解盤時發送的資料量較大，如果 Google 覺得太頻繁，VB 會自動停 2 秒鐘換下一個模型，這大幅減少了「連線超時」的機率。 3. 關於 Gemma 的未來擴充： 我在程式碼中保留了 `v1beta` 的彈性。如果您之後決定在伺服器跑 Ollama (Gemma)，我們只需在 `models` 迴圈的最前面加一條 `If modelName = "gemma" Then ...` 指向 `localhost:11434`，整個系統架構完全不需要重寫，這就是「專家級」的模組化設計。 ### 📅 下一步測試： 1. 發布 VB 後端。 2. 在 `StockMaster.html` 的清單中隨便點一檔股票的「解盤」按鈕。 3. 聽聽看：AI 會不會根據這筆資料，給出有溫度的專業分析。 佈署完成後請試試看！如果有某檔股票分析得特別慢，請告訴我，我們再來微調 Prompt 的精簡度！ 📈🎙️🤖

            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位台股實戰專家。請根據以下這檔股票的數據，提供 100 字內的解盤建議。" &
                "重點在於：1. 均線交叉次數是否代表起漲？ 2. OBV 能量是否充足？ 3. 給出『偏多/偏空/觀望』的明確建議。" &
                "數據內容：" & stockDataJson

            ' 呼叫本地 Ollama 引擎
            Dim analysisResult As String = CallOllama(prompt)

            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysisResult}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "Ollama 分析失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 3. [核心連線引擎]：改為本地 Ollama 通訊協議
    Private Shared Function CallOllama(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        ' --- Ollama 配置設定 ---
        Dim ollamaUrl As String = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
        Dim modelName As String = "gemma2" ' 建議使用 gemma2 (9b) 或 gemma
        ' -----------------------

        Try
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(ollamaUrl), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST"
            request.ContentType = "application/json"
            request.Timeout = 60000 ' 本地跑模型需要較多時間，給予 60 秒

            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            ' Ollama 的請求格式：model, prompt, stream: false
            Dim body As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                {"model", modelName},
                {"prompt", prompt},
                {"stream", False}
            }

            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(jss.Serialize(body))
            End Using

            Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                    Dim resText = reader.ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                    
                    ' Ollama 的結果欄位是 "response"
                    Return resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
                End Using
            End Using

        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("無法連線至本地 Ollama，請確認服務已啟動且已安裝 " & modelName & "。錯誤: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

End Class

    Private Shared Function CallOllama(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        ' --- 請根據您在 CMD 輸入 [ollama list] 看到的名稱修改這裡 ---

                sw.Write(jss.Serialize(body))
            End Using

            Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Using reader As New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream())
                    Dim resText = reader.ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                    
                    ' Ollama 成功時會回傳 "response" 欄位

            End Using

            If ex.Response IsNot Nothing Then

        Catch ex As Exception

        End Try
    End Function

function startTutor(rowData) {
    const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
    if (!key) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入 API Key", "warning");

    // 1. 取得這檔股票的名稱與代號

    const sId = rowData["股票代號"] || rowData["代號"] || "";

    // 2. 顯示解盤區塊，並立刻「清空舊內容」填入「新標的載入文字」

        <div class="animate-pulse">
            <i class='fas fa-sync fa-spin mr-2 text-cyan-400'></i>
            AI 助教正在讀取 <span class="text-white font-bold">${sName} (${sId})</span> 10 餘項技術指標...
        </div>
    `);

    // 3. 停止目前的語音，避免重疊
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();

    // 4. 自動滾動到解盤區（如果您在下方點擊，會自動飛上去看結果）
    document.getElementById('tutorSection').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });

    $.ajax({

        data: JSON.stringify({ 
            stockDataJson: JSON.stringify(rowData),

        }),

        success: function(res) {

                const analysis = res.d.analysis;
                // 最終顯示時，也在最前面加上標題作為二次確認
                $("#tutorText").html(`
                    <div class="mb-2 pb-2 border-b border-gray-800">
                        <span class="badge bg-primary text-black mr-2">分析標的</span>
                        <b class="text-white">${sName} (${sId})</b>

                    <div class="leading-relaxed">${analysis}</div>
                `);

            }

            $("#tutorText").html(`<span class="text-danger">系統連線超時，請稍後重試。</span>`);
        }
    });
}

javascript
function renderTable(data) {
    if (stockTable) stockTable.destroy();
    $("#stockTable").empty();

    if (!data || data.length === 0) return;

    // 1. 自動抓取後端回傳的所有欄位 Key
    let allKeys = Object.keys(data[0]);
    
    // 2. 建立欄位定義
    let columns = allKeys.map(key => ({ 
        title: key, 
        data: key,
        className: "dt-center",
        // 如果是漲幅，我們可以特別標顏色 (可選)
        render: function(val, type, row) {
            if (key === "一日漲幅" || key === "漲幅") {
                let color = val > 0 ? "#ff4d4d" : (val < 0 ? "#2ea043" : "#fff");
                return `<span style="color:${color}; font-weight:bold">${val}%</span>`;
            }
            return val;
        }
    }));

    // 3. 在最前面補上 AI 解盤按鈕
    columns.unshift({
        title: "AI 智取",
        data: null,
        orderable: false,
        render: function(data, type, row) {
            return `<button class="bg-cyan-900/50 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px]" 
                    onclick='startTutor(${JSON.stringify(row)})'>
                    <i class="fas fa-robot"></i> 解盤</button>`;
        }
    });

    // 4. 初始化 DataTable
    stockTable = $('#stockTable').DataTable({
        data: data,
        columns: columns,
        scrollX: true,         // 【關鍵】開啟橫向捲軸
        scrollY: "500px",      // 凍結表頭高度
        scrollCollapse: true,
        paging: true,
        pageLength: 50,
        fixedHeader: true,
        language: { url: "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" },
        drawCallback: function() {
            $('.dataTables_paginate .pagination').addClass('pagination-sm justify-content-end');
        }

function renderTable(data) {
    if (stockTable) stockTable.destroy();
    $("#stockTable").empty();

    if (!data || data.length === 0) return;

    // 1. 自動偵測所有從資料庫回傳的欄位
    let allKeys = Object.keys(data[0]);
    
    // 2. 建立欄位定義，並設定寬度避免擠壓
    let columns = allKeys.map(key => ({ 
        title: key, 
        data: key,
        className: "dt-center nowrap", // 加入 nowrap 防止換行
        render: function(val, type, row) {
            // 漲幅變色邏輯
            if (key.includes("漲幅")) {
                let color = val > 0 ? "#ff4d4d" : (val < 0 ? "#2ea043" : "#fff");
                return `<span style="color:${color}; font-weight:bold">${val}%</span>`;
            }
            // 交叉次數加粗
            if (key.includes("次數") && val >= 7) {
                return `<span class="text-cyan-400 font-bold">${val}</span>`;
            }
            return val;
        }
    }));

    // 3. 在最前面插入 AI 解盤按鈕
    columns.unshift({
        title: "AI 智取",
        data: null,
        width: "80px",
        render: function(data, type, row) {
            return `<button class="bg-cyan-900/50 text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/30 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] hover:bg-cyan-400 hover:text-black transition" 
                    onclick='startTutor(${JSON.stringify(row)})'>
                    <i class="fas fa-robot"></i> 解盤</button>`;
        }
    });

    // 4. 初始化 DataTable (強化橫向滾動)
    stockTable = $('#stockTable').DataTable({
        data: data,
        columns: columns,
        scrollX: true,           // 開啟橫向捲軸
        scrollY: "500px",        // 凍結表頭
        scrollCollapse: true,
        paging: true,
        pageLength: 50,
        fixedColumns: { left: 2 }, // 【進階】固定左側「解盤」與「名稱」兩欄
        language: { url: "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" },
        drawCallback: function() {
            $('.dataTables_paginate .pagination').addClass('pagination-sm justify-content-end');
        }
    });
}

這個錯誤是由於 AI (DeepSeek-R1) 在產出 T-SQL 語法時，可能混淆了 MySQL (使用 LIMIT) 與 SQL Server (使用 TOP) 的語法，或是將 `TOP` 關鍵字放錯了位置（例如放到了 `SELECT *` 之後）。 在 SQL Server 中，正確的順序必須是：`SELECT TOP 50 * FROM ...`。 為了徹底解決這個問題，我針對後端 Prompt 指令 進行了「語法鎖定」，並在 VB 程式碼中加入了一段「自動修正邏輯」，萬一 AI 寫錯，後端會自動幫它排好順序。 ### 1. 修改後端：`StockAI.aspx.vb` (語法修正版) 請覆蓋您的 `TranslateToSQL` 函式，這版加強了對 SQL Server 語法的規範：
vb
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL(ByVal userSpeech As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 強勢導引 Prompt：確保 AI 遵守 SQL Server (T-SQL) 標準
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位精通 SQL Server (T-SQL) 的專家。請針對 [View_AI_Stock_Pro] 寫出查詢語法。" &
                "【語法嚴格要求】： " &
                "1. 必須使用『SELECT TOP 50 *』開頭。 " &
                "2. 禁止使用 MySQL 的 'LIMIT' 語法。 " &
                "3. 產業搜尋使用 LIKE '%關鍵字%'。 " &
                "4. 必須包含日期過濾：[日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM View_AI_Stock_Pro)。 " &
                "5. 預設按 [均價黃金交叉次數] DESC 排序。 " &
                "6. 只回傳純文字 SQL，不要有任何 Markdown 或解釋。 " &
                "使用者指令：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama(prompt)
            
            ' --- 【核心修正邏輯】：自動清理並校正 SQL 順序 ---
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

            ' A. 防止 AI 把 TOP 寫在後面 (常見錯誤：SELECT * FROM ... TOP 50)
            ' 如果發現有 LIMIT 則改為 TOP
            If aiSql.ToUpper().Contains("LIMIT") Then
                aiSql = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(aiSql, "LIMIT \d+", "", System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)
                If Not aiSql.ToUpper().Contains("TOP") Then
                    aiSql = aiSql.ToUpper().Replace("SELECT", "SELECT TOP 50")
                End If
            End If

            ' B. 確保 SELECT 與 TOP 的正確位置
            ' 如果 AI 回傳 SELECT * TOP 50，將其修正為 SELECT TOP 50 *
            If aiSql.ToUpper().Contains("SELECT * TOP") Then
                aiSql = aiSql.ToUpper().Replace("SELECT * TOP 50", "SELECT TOP 50 *")
            End If

            ' C. 再次確認是以 SELECT 開頭
            If aiSql.ToUpper().Contains("SELECT") Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Substring(aiSql.ToUpper().IndexOf("SELECT"))
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "轉譯出錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

            ' --- 【核心修正邏輯】：強力過濾非 SQL 文字 ---
            
            ' A. 移除反引號 (Markdown) 與常見中文字元
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("`", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

            ' B. 【精準切割】：找到第一個 SELECT 的位置，把前面的廢話全部切掉
            Dim selectIdx As Integer = aiSql.IndexOf("SELECT", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            If selectIdx <> -1 Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Substring(selectIdx)
            End If

            ' C. 【尾部清理】：找到最後一個 SQL 關鍵字後的內容，防止後面帶廢話
            ' 如果 AI 在最後加了中文字解釋，嘗試截斷 (搜尋最後一個關鍵字)
            ' 這裡簡單處理：只要是 SELECT 開頭，剩下的交給 SQL 引擎嘗試執行

            ' D. 常見欄位名稱自動校正 (Hard-Fix)
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("Industry Search", "[產業分類]")
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("IndustryCategory", "[產業分類]")
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("站上均線數", "[站均]")

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "轉譯出錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

這個錯誤是地圖規劃中最後一個「語法方言」問題。AI (DeepSeek) 習慣寫 `DATE([日期])` 這種 MySQL 或通用語法，但 SQL Server 沒有 `DATE()` 函數，它直接用 `[日期]` 即可（因為您的資料格式是 `20260610` 這種整數或日期型態）。 我針對 VB 後端 進行了「T-SQL 語法補強」。這版代碼會自動把 AI 寫錯的 `DATE(...)` 函數拿掉，並強化 Prompt 規範。 ### 1. 修改後端：`StockAI.aspx.vb` (T-SQL 語法過濾版) 請覆蓋您的 `TranslateToSQL` 函式。我加入了對 `DATE` 關鍵字的自動替換邏輯：
vb
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL(ByVal userSpeech As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 更加嚴厲且具備技術細節的 Prompt
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 SQL Server (T-SQL) 專家。" &
                "【資料庫規範】： " &
                "1. 只有一個 View：[View_AI_Stock_Pro]。 " &
                "2. 日期欄位名稱為 [日期]，格式為整數(YYYYMMDD)。 " &
                "【絕對禁令】： " &
                "1. 嚴禁使用 DATE() 函數，SQL Server 不支援。 " &
                "2. 嚴禁使用 LIMIT，請用 SELECT TOP 100 *。 " &
                "3. 嚴禁 Markdown 與任何中文解釋。 " &
                "【範例語法】：SELECT TOP 100 * FROM View_AI_Stock_Pro WHERE [日期] = (SELECT MAX([日期]) FROM View_AI_Stock_Pro) AND [均價黃金交叉次數] >= 7 " &
                "使用者需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama(prompt)
            
            ' --- 【核心修正邏輯】：語法自動轉正 ---
            
            ' A. 基礎清理
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("`", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

            ' B. 【關鍵修正】：移除 AI 亂加的 DATE() 函數
            ' 範例：將 WHERE DATE([日期]) = ... 轉為 WHERE [日期] = ...
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("DATE([日期])", "[日期]")
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("date([日期])", "[日期]")
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("DATE(日期)", "[日期]")
            
            ' C. 確保從 SELECT 開始 (過濾廢話)
            Dim selectIdx As Integer = aiSql.ToUpper().IndexOf("SELECT")
            If selectIdx <> -1 Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Substring(selectIdx)
            End If

            ' D. 修正 TOP 的位置 (防止 AI 寫成 SELECT * TOP 100)
            If aiSql.ToUpper().Contains("SELECT * TOP") Then
                aiSql = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(aiSql, "SELECT \* TOP (\d+)", "SELECT TOP $1 *", System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "轉譯出錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
--- ### 2. 為什麼會報 `DATE` 錯誤？ DeepSeek 在訓練資料中看過太多 `WHERE DATE(created_at) = '2026-06-11'` 這種寫法。它以為這是一個通用的 SQL 函數。 但在您的 SQL Server 中： * 如果 `[日期]` 是數字（`20260610`），不需要任何函數。 * 如果 `[日期]` 是日期型態，SQL Server 應該用 `CONVERT` 或 `CAST`，但對您的系統來說，直接用 `[日期]` 比較快。 新版的改進： 我在後端加了 `.Replace("DATE([日期])", "[日期]")`。這是一個「強制補償」，不管 AI 怎麼寫，我們送給資料庫之前都會把它修正為正確的 T-SQL。 --- ### 3. 下一步測試 請發布此 VB 代碼後，再次點擊「強勢股」。 💡 專業觀察點： 如果這次成功顯示表格了，請按 F12 到 Console 看一下那句 SQL 長怎樣。 您應該會看到類似： `SELECT TOP 100 * FROM View_AI_Stock_Pro WHERE [日期] = (SELECT MAX([日期])...` 只要 `DATE(` 不見了，這題就解開了！ 請佈署這版「語法補償版」後端，這次我們直接在門口攔截掉不相容的函數！

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO

<ScriptService()>
Public Class StockAI
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    ' --- [功能 1]：語音轉 SQL (雲端版) ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL(ByVal userSpeech As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 核心 Prompt：鎖定 T-SQL 語法，防止 DATE() 等錯誤
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位精通 SQL Server (T-SQL) 的選股大師。請針對 View_AI_Stock_Pro 寫 SELECT 指令。" &
                "【重要定義】：1.強勢股: [均價黃金交叉次數] >= 7  2.大戶吸碼: [大戶持股比] > 70  3.能源噴發: [OBV金叉總數] >= 6 " &
                "【語法規範】：1.嚴禁使用 DATE() 函數。 2.日期過濾用：[日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM View_AI_Stock_Pro)。 3.嚴禁 Markdown 與解釋。" &
                "使用者需求：" & userSpeech

            ' 調用雲端引擎
            Dim aiSql As String = CallGemini(prompt, userApiKey)
            
            ' 清理 SQL 雜質
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()
            If aiSql.ToUpper().Contains("SELECT") Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Substring(aiSql.ToUpper().IndexOf("SELECT"))
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [功能 2]：AI 一鍵解盤 (雲端版) ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeStockData(ByVal stockDataJson As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位犀利的台股操盤手。請根據數據直接給出分析結論。" &
                "【要求】：1.點評均線與 OBV 配合度。 2.點評籌碼。 3.結論明確(多/空/觀望)。 4.不准有開場白，60字內。" &
                "數據：" & stockDataJson

            Dim result As String = CallGemini(prompt, userApiKey)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [核心引擎 A]：雲端 Gemini 通道 (黃金清單版) ---
    Private Shared Function CallGemini(ByVal prompt As String, ByVal apiKey As String) As String
        Dim models() As String = {"gemini-2.5-flash", "gemini-2.0-flash", "gemini-pro"}
        Dim lastError As String = ""
        Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()

        ServicePointManager.SecurityProtocol = SecurityProtocolType.Tls12

        For Each m In models
            Try
                Dim apiVer = "v1beta"
                Dim url = $"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{apiVer}/models/{m}:generateContent?key={apiKey}"
                
                Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
                request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 25000

                ' 建立標準 JSON 結構
                Dim partDict As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"text", prompt}}
                Dim contentObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"parts", New Object() {partDict}}}
                Dim rootObj As New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"contents", New Object() {contentObj}}}
                
                Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                    sw.Write(jss.Serialize(rootObj))
                End Using

                Using response As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                    Dim resText = New StreamReader(response.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                    Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                    Return resObj("candidates")(0)("content")("parts")(0)("text").ToString()
                End Using
            Catch ex As Exception
                lastError = ex.Message
                If ex.Message.Contains("429") Then System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(1500)
            End Try
        Next
        Throw New Exception("雲端 AI 通道繁忙: " & lastError)
    End Function

    ' --- [核心引擎 B]：本地 Ollama 通道 (備用留存) ---
    Private Shared Function CallOllama(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Try
            Dim url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 60000
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"model", "deepseek-r1:8b"}, {"prompt", prompt}, {"stream", False}}
            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(body))
            End Using
            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())
                Dim raw = resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
                If raw.Contains("</think>") Then raw = raw.Substring(raw.LastIndexOf("</think>") + 8).Trim()
                Return raw
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("本地通道失敗: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function
End Class

vb
    ' [API 3] 獲取單股歷史趨勢 (供圖表使用)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetStockTrendData(ByVal stockId As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim list As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 抓取最近 15 天的關鍵指標 (價、量、交叉數、OBV)
                ' 注意：這裡要按日期升冪(ASC)排列，圖表才會從左往右畫
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 15 [日期], [成交價], [均價黃金交叉次數], [一日漲幅] " &
                                   "FROM [View_AI_Stock_Pro] " &
                                   "WHERE [股票代號] = @id " &
                                   "ORDER BY [日期] ASC"
                
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", stockId)
                conn.Open()
                Using dr = cmd.ExecuteReader()
                    While dr.Read()
                        Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
                        ' 格式化日期 MM/dd 方便圖表顯示
                        Dim dStr = dr("日期").ToString()
                        row.Add("date", dStr.Substring(4, 2) & "/" & dStr.Substring(6, 2))
                        row.Add("price", Convert.ToDouble(dr("成交價")))
                        row.Add("goldCount", Convert.ToInt32(dr("均價黃金交叉次數")))
                        list.Add(row)
                    End While
                End Using
            End Using
            Return New With {.success = True, .data = list}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

                speak(res.d.analysis);

        }

function drawTrendChart(sId, sName) {
    $.ajax({
        type: "POST",
        url: "StockAI.aspx/GetStockTrendData",
        data: JSON.stringify({ stockId: sId }),
        contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        success: function(res) {
            if(!res.d.success) return;
            const history = res.d.data;
            
            const labels = history.map(h => h.date);
            const prices = history.map(h => h.price);
            const golds = history.map(h => h.goldCount);

            if (chartInstance) chartInstance.destroy(); // 銷毀舊圖

            const ctx = document.getElementById('stockTrendChart').getContext('2d');
            chartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: labels,
                    datasets: [
                        {
                            label: '成交價',
                            data: prices,
                            borderColor: '#00f2fe',
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 242, 254, 0.1)',
                            yAxisID: 'y',
                            fill: true,
                            tension: 0.4
                        },
                        {
                            label: '均線金叉數',
                            data: golds,
                            type: 'bar',
                            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                            yAxisID: 'y1'
                        }
                    ]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    scales: {
                        y: { type: 'linear', display: true, position: 'left', grid: { color: '#333' } },
                        y1: { type: 'linear', display: true, position: 'right', grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }, min: 0, max: 8 }
                    },
                    plugins: { legend: { display: false } }
                }
            });
        }
    });
}

SELECT 
    A.[股票名稱], A.[股票代號], A.[日期], A.[產業分類], A.[股本億],
    C.[成交價] AS [盤中現價], -- 從 View_basicinfo 抓取盤中最新價

    C.[最高] AS [盤中最高],
    C.[最低] AS [盤中最低],
    A.[均價黃金交叉次數], 
    A.[均量黃金交叉次數], 
    A.[站均],
    A.[k9], A.[d9], A.[macd],
    B.[obv黃金交叉次數] AS [OBV金叉總數],
    B.[五日交叉成功] AS [OBV能量]
FROM [dbo].[winnewdate] A
INNER JOIN [dbo].[obv計算黃金交叉次數] B ON A.[股票代號] = B.[代號] AND A.[日期] = B.[日期]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[View_basicinfo] C ON A.[股票代號] = C.[代號]

vb
    ' [API 4] 獲取產業熱力數據 (分析全市場產業強弱)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function GetIndustryAnalysis(ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim dt As New DataTable()
            Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnString)
                ' 核心 SQL：按產業分組，計算平均漲幅、平均金叉數、與總成交量
                Dim sql As String = "SELECT TOP 10 [產業分類], " &
                                   "AVG([一日漲幅]) as [平均漲幅], " &
                                   "AVG([均價黃金交叉次數]) as [平均金叉數], " &
                                   "SUM([總量]) as [族群總張數] " &
                                   "FROM [View_AI_Stock_Pro] " &
                                   "WHERE [日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM View_AI_Stock_Pro) " &
                                   "GROUP BY [產業分類] " &
                                   "ORDER BY [平均漲幅] DESC"
                
                Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
                Dim da As New SqlDataAdapter(cmd)
                conn.Open()
                da.Fill(dt)
            End Using

            ' 將數據轉為 JSON 丟給 AI 進行「大局觀」分析
            Dim dataJson As String = New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(ConvertDataTableToDict(dt))
            
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位資深市場分析師。請根據以下這份『產業聚合數據』，用 100 字分析今天哪個族群最值得關注？" &
                "請點評該族群的強勢原因與操作建議。 數據：" & dataJson

            Dim analysisResult As String = CallGemini(prompt, userApiKey)

            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysisResult, .rawData = ConvertDataTableToDict(dt)}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' 輔助：將 DataTable 轉為 Dictionary 清單
    Private Shared Function ConvertDataTableToDict(ByVal dt As DataTable) As List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))
        Dim rows As New List(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))()
        For Each dr As DataRow In dt.Rows
            Dim row As New Dictionary(Of String, Object)()
            For Each col As DataColumn In dt.Columns
                row.Add(col.ColumnName, dr(col))
            Next
            rows.Add(row)
        Next
        Return rows
    End Function

                        <b class="text-white">本日最強勢族群分析</b>
                    </div>
                    <div class="leading-relaxed text-blue-200">${r.analysis}</div>

recognition.lang = 'zh-TW';

            $("#statusInfo").text("已清空");

        // 3. 【一般聽寫】：累積文字並替換標點

        $("#userInput").val(currentText + cleanText);
        $("#charCount").text($("#userInput").val().length);
    }
};

                type: "POST", url: "StockAI.aspx/TranslateToSQL",

                    if(res.d.success) fetchStockData(res.d.sql);

                },
                error: function() { Swal.fire("連線錯誤", "後端 API 無回應", "error"); resetBtn(); }
            });
        }
