    ' [功能 1]：選股轉 SQL (支援 StockScore)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL(ByVal userSpeech As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 注入 StockScore 知識庫
            Dim columnsInfo As String = "資料表 [StockScore] 欄位說明： " &
                "[股票名稱], [股票代號], [日期], [專家實戰總分](關鍵指標), [實戰標籤](★追高/🔥量價齊揚/💎大戶鎖碼), " &
                "[價五日乖離], [量倍數], [OBV分], [價均分], [技術分], [籌碼分], [量能分], [盤中現價], [盤中漲幅], [產業分類]。"

            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位精通台股實戰的 T-SQL 大師。請針對 [StockScore] 寫 SELECT 語句。" &
                "【重要定義】： " &
                "1. 分數連三升：指的是 A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分。 " &
                "2. 產業搜尋：用 LIKE '%關鍵字%'。 " &
                "3. 預設規則：必須包含日期過濾 [日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM StockScore)，且按 [今日分數] 降冪。 " &
                "【規則】：只回傳純 SQL，嚴禁 Markdown。 使用者需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallGemini(prompt, userApiKey)
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()
            If aiSql.ToUpper().Contains("SELECT") Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Substring(aiSql.ToUpper().IndexOf("SELECT"))
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' [功能 2]：AI 一鍵解盤 (修正亂碼問題)
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeStockData(ByVal stockDataJson As String, ByVal userApiKey As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 【關鍵修正】：強制 AI 不准使用任何特殊符號
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位台股操盤手。請根據數據給出 80 字內分析。" &
                "【禁令】：1. 嚴禁使用 LaTeX 數學符號(如 $, \, ge)。 2. 嚴禁 Markdown 粗體。 3. 只用純文字回覆。" &
                "重點：專家總分與實戰標籤的含意。 數據：" & stockDataJson

            Dim analysisResult As String = CallGemini(prompt, userApiKey)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = analysisResult}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "專家轉譯失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [專家解盤 1]：AI 一鍵解盤 (走本地 Ollama) ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeStockData1(ByVal stockDataJson As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位實戰派操盤導師。請根據這檔股票的 [StockScore] 數據，提供犀利的 80 字解盤建議。" &
                "重點：判斷『專家實戰總分』與『實戰標籤』。 數據：" & stockDataJson

            Dim result As String = CallOllama1(prompt)
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = result}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [核心引擎 B]：本地 Ollama 通道 (DeepSeek-R1) ---
    Private Shared Function CallOllama1(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Try
            Dim url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 90000
            
            ' 使用您主機上最強的 deepseek-r1:8b
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                {"model", "deepseek-r1:8b"}, 
                {"prompt", prompt}, 
                {"stream", False}
            }
            
            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(body))
            End Using

            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())
                Dim raw = resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
                ' 自動過濾 DeepSeek 的思考標籤
                If raw.Contains("</think>") Then raw = raw.Substring(raw.LastIndexOf("</think>") + 8).Trim()
                Return raw
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("本地專家通道連線失敗: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

這個錯誤 `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '錯'` 是因為 Ollama (Gemma) 產出的 SQL 語法有誤（通常是括號未對齊或多了分號），導致資料庫回傳了「錯誤：接近 ')' 之處的語法不正確」的文字，而前端程式碼沒檢查就直接用 `JSON.parse` 去解析這段文字，導致 JavaScript 當機。 既然您換成了 `gemma4:e4b`，這款模型的「脾氣」與 DeepSeek 不同，它更需要明確的範例。我為您優化了後端 Prompt，並加入了「語法自動糾錯」機制。 --- ### 1. 修改後端：`StockAI.aspx.vb` (Gemma 專用穩定版) 請覆蓋 `TranslateToSQL1` 與 `CallOllama1` 函數。我加入了對 Gemma 產出格式的特殊處理，並修正了「連三升」的邏輯範例。
vb
    ' --- [專家選股 1]：語音轉 SQL (Gemma 專用版) ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL1(ByVal userSpeech As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 強力範例 Prompt：給 Gemma 範本，它才不會亂寫括號
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 工程師。請針對 [StockScore] 表寫指令。" &
                "【欄位】：[名稱], [代號], [專家實戰總分], [日期], [產業分類], [一日漲幅]。" &
                "【重要定義】：分數連三升語法範例： " &
                "SELECT A.* FROM StockScore A " &
                "INNER JOIN StockScore B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.日期 = (前一交易日) " &
                "INNER JOIN StockScore C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.日期 = (前二交易日) " &
                "WHERE A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分 " &
                "【規則】：1.只回傳 SQL。2.嚴禁 Markdown。3.日期過濾最新。 " &
                "需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama1(prompt)
            
            ' --- 【Gemma 語法自動修復】 ---
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()
            
            ' 處理 Gemma 喜歡在括號後加贅字的問題
            If aiSql.Contains(")") AndAlso aiSql.LastIndexOf(")") < aiSql.Length - 1 Then
                ' 如果括號後面還有字，嘗試只截取到最後一個有效字元
            End If

            ' 確保以 SELECT 開頭
            Dim selectIdx = aiSql.ToUpper().IndexOf("SELECT")
            If selectIdx <> -1 Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Substring(selectIdx)
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "專家引擎報錯: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [核心引擎 B]：Ollama 通道 (Gemma 專用) ---
    Private Shared Function CallOllama1(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        ' 確保名稱與您 [ollama list] 看到的一模一樣
        Dim modelName As String = "gemma4:e4b" 
        Try
            Dim url = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create(url), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 90000
            
            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {
                {"model", modelName}, 
                {"prompt", prompt}, 
                {"stream", False}
            }
            
            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(jss.Serialize(body))
            End Using

            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resText = New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                ' Gemma 回傳的是純 response 欄位
                Return resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception

function fetchStockData(sql, isExpert = false) {

            if (typeof rawData === "string" && rawData.includes("錯誤：")) {
                Swal.close();
                Swal.fire({
                    title: "SQL 語法出錯",
                    html: `<div class="text-left text-xs bg-black p-3 rounded text-red-400 font-mono">${rawData}</div>
                           <p class="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500 text-center">AI 寫錯了，請嘗試點擊標籤重新產生。</p>`,
                    icon: "error"
                });
                resetBtn();
                return;
            }

            try {
                const data = JSON.parse(rawData);
                Swal.close();
                if(data && data.length > 0) {
                    renderTable(data, isExpert);
                } else {
                    Swal.fire("查無結果", "可能今日分數尚未計算，或條件太嚴苛。", "info");
                }
            } catch (e) {
                Swal.close();
                Swal.fire("解析失敗", "格式異常: " + rawData, "error");
            }
            resetBtn();
        }
    });
}

Imports System.Web.Services
Imports System.Web.Script.Services
Imports System.Data.SqlClient
Imports System.Web.Script.Serialization
Imports System.Net
Imports System.IO

<ScriptService()>
Public Class StockAI
    Inherits System.Web.UI.Page

    Private Shared ReadOnly ConnString As String = System.Web.Configuration.WebConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings("stockchangedateConnectionString3").ConnectionString

    ' --- [專家選股 1]：Ollama (Gemma) 轉 SQL ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL1(ByVal userSpeech As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。請針對 [StockScore] 表寫 SELECT 指令。" &
                "【欄位】：[名稱], [代號], [今日分數], [昨日分數], [前日分數], [專家實戰總分], [實戰標籤], [日期]。" &
                "【規則】：1.只回傳 SQL。 2.禁止解釋。 3.日期過濾：[日期] = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM StockScore)。" &
                "【範例】：SELECT TOP 100 * FROM StockScore WHERE [今日分數] > [昨日分數] AND [昨日分數] > [前日分數] AND [專家實戰總分] > 25" &
                "需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama1(prompt)
            
            ' 強力清理：只抓取 SELECT 開始的部分，移除末尾分號與 Markdown
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()
            Dim selectIdx = aiSql.ToUpper().IndexOf("SELECT")
            If selectIdx <> -1 Then aiSql = aiSql.Substring(selectIdx)

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [專家解盤 1]：Ollama (Gemma) 一鍵解盤 ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function AnalyzeStockData1(ByVal stockDataJson As String) As Object
        Try
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一位台股操盤導師。請根據數據提供 80 字內解盤結論(多/空/觀望)。不准有開場白。數據：" & stockDataJson
            Return New With {.success = True, .analysis = CallOllama1(prompt)}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [核心引擎]：連線 Ollama (Gemma) ---
    Private Shared Function CallOllama1(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Dim modelName As String = "gemma4:e4b" 
        Try
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create("http://localhost:11434/api/generate"), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 90000
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"model", modelName}, {"prompt", prompt}, {"stream", False}}
            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(New JavaScriptSerializer().Serialize(body))
            End Using
            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resObj = New JavaScriptSerializer().Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd())
                Return resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("Ollama通道異常: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- 補齊缺失功能：GetWinRateAnalysis, GetIndustryAnalysis, GetStockTrendData (維持之前成功的版本) ---

### 3. JavaScript 關鍵修復：`renderTable` 請確保您的 `renderTable` 是這個版本，它整合了雙按鈕且解決了 `isExpert` 切換問題：
javascript
function renderTable(data, isExpert) {
    if (stockTable) stockTable.destroy();
    $("#stockTable").empty();

    let columns = Object.keys(data[0]).map(key => ({ 
        title: key, data: key, className: "dt-center" 
    }));

    // 【核心修復】：補回雙功能按鈕，並根據 isExpert 決定解盤核心
    columns.unshift({
        title: "AI 實戰",
        data: null,
        render: function(data, type, row) {
            const rowJson = JSON.stringify(row).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
            const sId = row["股票代號"] || row["代號"];
            const sName = row["股票名稱"] || row["名稱"];
            const tutorFunc = isExpert ? 'startTutor1' : 'startTutor';

            return `
                <div class="flex gap-1 justify-center">
                    <button class="bg-cyan-600 text-black px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold" onclick="${tutorFunc}(${rowJson})">解盤</button>
                    <button class="bg-yellow-500 text-black px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold" onclick="runBacktest('${sId}', '${sName}')">🎯勝率</button>
                </div>`;
        }
    });

    stockTable = $('#stockTable').DataTable({
        data: data, columns: columns, scrollX: true, scrollY: "500px", scrollCollapse: true,
        pageLength: 50, language: { url: "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" }
    });
}

        @keyframes pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0.7); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 15px rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(46, 160, 67, 0); } }

        /* DataTables 修正 (橫向排列分頁) */
        .dataTables_wrapper { color: #ffffff !important; padding: 15px; }
        .dataTables_scrollHead { background-color: #1e293b !important; border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; }
        table.dataTable thead th { color: var(--primary) !important; font-weight: 900 !important; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--primary) !important; text-align: center !important; white-space: nowrap !important; padding: 12px !important; }
        table.dataTable tbody td { text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #1e293b !important; vertical-align: middle; }

        .dataTables_paginate .pagination { display: flex !important; flex-direction: row !important; justify-content: flex-end !important; list-style: none !important; margin: 15px 0 !important; }
        .pagination .page-item .page-link { background-color: #1e293b !important; border: 1px solid #334155 !important; color: #adbac7 !important; padding: 8px 14px !important; margin: 0 2px; border-radius: 6px; }
        .pagination .page-item.active .page-link { background-color: var(--primary) !important; color: #000 !important; }

        .dataTables_length label, .dataTables_filter label { color: #fff !important; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; }
        .dataTables_length select, .dataTables_filter input { background: #020617 !important; color: #00f2fe !important; border: 1px solid #1e293b !important; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 12px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="top-spacer"></div>

    <div class="container">
        <!-- AI 導師解盤區 (含圖表) -->
        <div id="tutorSection" class="hidden glass-panel mb-6 border-l-4 border-l-cyan-400 p-4">
            <div class="row align-items-center">
                <div class="col-md-7 border-r border-gray-800">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
                        <h4 class="text-sm font-bold text-cyan-400"><i class="fas fa-robot mr-2"></i>AI 助教即時解盤</h4>
                        <button onclick="$('#tutorSection').addClass('hidden');window.speechSynthesis.cancel();" class="text-gray-500 text-xs">關閉</button>
                    </div>
                    <div id="tutorText" class="text-sm text-gray-300 leading-relaxed italic" style="min-height: 100px; white-space: pre-wrap;"></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-end mt-2"><button onclick="window.speechSynthesis.cancel()" class="text-[9px] text-red-400 opacity-50">停止語音</button></div>
                </div>
                <div class="col-md-5" id="chartContainer">
                    <div class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mb-1 font-bold text-center">趨勢動能分析 (價/金叉)</div>
                    <div style="height: 180px;"><canvas id="stockTrendChart"></canvas></div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 控制面板 -->
        <div class="glass-panel mb-6">
            <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-5">
                <h1 class="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tighter"><i class="fas fa-chart-line text-cyan-400 mr-2"></i>AI 股票智能助教</h1>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <select id="phraseSelect" class="bg-gray-800 border-0 text-xs text-yellow-400 p-2 rounded-xl outline-none w-36" onchange="injectCmd(this.value)">
                        <option value="">💬 常用話術</option>
                        <option value="找今日分數連三升的強勢股">🏆 專家連三升</option>
                        <option value="找均價金叉大於 6 次且 OBV 總數大於 0 的強勢股">🔥 強勢攻擊</option>
                        <option value="找大戶持股連續增加且集中度翻正的股票">💎 大戶吸碼</option>
                        <option value="找本益比低於 15 且殖利率大於 5% 的股票">⚖️ 價值選股</option>
                    </select>
                    <input type="password" id="geminiKey" class="bg-black/50 border border-gray-700 text-[10px] p-2 rounded-lg w-32 text-white" placeholder="Gemini API Key">
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="flex gap-2 mb-4 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide">
                <span class="tip-badge" onclick="injectCmd('找今天最強勢的金融股')">🔥 金融強勢</span>
                <span class="tip-badge" onclick="injectCmd('找大戶正在吸碼的股票')">💎 籌碼集中</span>
                <span class="tip-badge" onclick="injectCmd('找OBV能量噴發的股票')">⚡ 能量噴發</span>
                <span class="tip-badge bg-purple-900/40" onclick="runIndustryAI()"><i class="fas fa-layer-group"></i> 產業熱力</span>
                <span class="tip-badge text-red-400" onclick="injectCmd('清除')">🗑️ 清除</span>
            </div>

            <textarea id="userInput" placeholder="請說出您的選股需求... (口令：清除、逗號、句號)"></textarea>

            <div class="flex gap-4 mt-6">
                <button id="recordBtn" class="main-btn btn-record" onclick="toggleRecord()"><i class="fas fa-microphone"></i> 語音輸入</button>
                <button id="aiBtn" class="main-btn btn-ai" onclick="runStockAI()"><i class="fas fa-brain"></i> 啟動 AI 篩選</button>
                <button id="expertBtn" class="main-btn btn-expert" onclick="runStockAI1()"><i class="fas fa-user-tie"></i> 專家實戰選股</button>
            </div>
            <div id="statusInfo" class="text-center text-[10px] text-gray-600 mt-4 italic">Ready | v21.0 Stable</div>
        </div>

        <!-- 資料表格 -->
        <div class="glass-panel p-0 overflow-hidden">
            <table id="stockTable" class="table table-dark table-hover w-100 m-0"></table>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        var stockTable = null;
        var chartInstance = null;
        var isRecording = false;

        $(document).ready(function() {
            $("#geminiKey").val(localStorage.getItem('gemini_stock_key') || '');
            loadHistory();
        });

        function injectCmd(t) { if(t==='清除') { $("#userInput").val(""); return; } $("#userInput").val(t); }

        // --- 核心 A：雲端 AI 選股 ---
        async function runStockAI() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            if(!text || !key) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入需求與 API Key", "warning");
            localStorage.setItem('gemini_stock_key', key);
            Swal.fire({ title: 'AI 轉譯中', html: '正在生成 T-SQL 指令...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "StockAI.aspx/TranslateToSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userSpeech: text, userApiKey: key }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) { if(res.d.success) fetchStockData(res.d.sql, false); else { Swal.fire("失敗", res.d.msg, "error"); resetBtn(); } }
            });
        }

        // --- 核心 B：本地專家選股 (Ollama) ---
        async function runStockAI1() {
            const text = $("#userInput").val().trim();
            if(!text) return Swal.fire("提示", "請輸入專家指令", "info");
            Swal.fire({ title: '專家系統啟動', html: '正在調用本地 gemma4 運算數據...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "StockAI.aspx/TranslateToSQL1",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userSpeech: text }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) { if(res.d.success) fetchStockData(res.d.sql, true); else { Swal.fire("專家引擎錯誤", res.d.msg, "error"); resetBtn(); } }
            });
        }

        function fetchStockData(sql, isExpert) {
            console.log("執行 SQL:", sql);
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL",
                data: JSON.stringify({ sql: sql, db: "stockchangedate", pwd: "2157" }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if(res.d.startsWith("錯誤")) { Swal.fire("語法錯誤", res.d, "error"); resetBtn(); return; }
                    const data = JSON.parse(res.d);
                    if(data && data.length > 0) renderTable(data, isExpert);
                    else Swal.fire("查無資料", "請調整條件", "info");
                    resetBtn();
                }
            });
        }

        function renderTable(data, isExpert) {
            if (stockTable) stockTable.destroy();
            $("#stockTable").empty();
            let cols = Object.keys(data[0]).map(k => ({ title: k, data: k, className: "text-center nowrap" }));
            const tutorFunc = isExpert ? 'startTutor1' : 'startTutor';
            
            cols.unshift({
                title: "AI 實戰", data: null,
                render: (d, t, row) => {
                    const sId = row["股票代號"] || row["代號"];
                    const sName = row["股票名稱"] || row["名稱"];
                    const rowJson = JSON.stringify(row).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
                    return `<div class="flex gap-1 justify-center">
                        <button class="bg-cyan-600 text-black px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold" onclick="${tutorFunc}(${rowJson})">解盤</button>
                        <button class="bg-yellow-500 text-black px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold" onclick="runBacktest('${sId}', '${sName}')">🎯勝率</button>
                    </div>`;
                }
            });

            stockTable = $('#stockTable').DataTable({
                data: data, columns: cols, scrollX: true, scrollY: "500px", scrollCollapse: true,
                pageLength: 50, language: { url: "//cdn.datatables.net/plug-ins/1.13.6/i18n/zh-HANT.json" },
                drawCallback: function() { $('.pagination').addClass('justify-content-end'); }
            });
        }

        // --- 解盤與圖表功能 ---
        function startTutor(rowData) { tutorBase(rowData, "StockAI.aspx/AnalyzeStockData", "AI 助教"); }
        function startTutor1(rowData) { tutorBase(rowData, "StockAI.aspx/AnalyzeStockData1", "專家導師"); }

        function tutorBase(rowData, url, label) {
            const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            const sName = rowData["股票名稱"] || rowData["名稱"];
            const sId = rowData["股票代號"] || rowData["代號"];
            $("#tutorSection").removeClass("hidden");
            $("#tutorText").html(`<i class='fas fa-sync fa-spin'></i> ${label}正在分析 <b class="text-white">${sName}</b>...`);
            window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
            drawTrendChart(sId);
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: url,
                data: JSON.stringify({ stockDataJson: JSON.stringify(rowData), userApiKey: key }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    if(res.d.success) {
                        let analysis = res.d.analysis.replace(/[\$\\]/g, '').replace(/\*/g, '').replace(/ge\s/g, '>=');
                        $("#tutorText").html(`<b class='text-cyan-400'>[${sName} ${sId}]</b><br>${analysis}`);
                        speak(analysis);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function drawTrendChart(sId) {
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "StockAI.aspx/GetStockTrendData",
                data: JSON.stringify({ stockId: sId }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    if(!res.d.success) return;
                    if (chartInstance) chartInstance.destroy();
                    const history = res.d.data;
                    const ctx = document.getElementById('stockTrendChart').getContext('2d');
                    chartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
                        type: 'line',
                        data: {
                            labels: history.map(h => h.date),
                            datasets: [{ label: '價', data: history.map(h => h.price), borderColor: '#00f2fe', tension: 0.3, yAxisID: 'y' },
                                       { label: '金叉', data: history.map(h => h.goldCount), type: 'bar', backgroundColor: 'rgba(59,130,246,0.3)', yAxisID: 'y1' }]
                        },
                        options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false } }, 
                                   scales: { y: { display: true, position: 'left', grid: { color: '#222' } }, y1: { display: false, position: 'right', min: 0, max: 10 } } }
                    });
                }
            });
        }

        async function runIndustryAI() {
            const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            Swal.fire({ title: '掃描產業熱力', html: '運算各族群動能中...', background: '#050a15', color: '#fff', didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "StockAI.aspx/GetIndustryAnalysis",
                data: JSON.stringify({ userApiKey: key }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    Swal.close();
                    if(res.d.success) {
                        $("#tutorSection").removeClass("hidden");
                        $("#tutorText").html(`<b class='text-purple-400'>[產業熱力診斷]</b><br>${res.d.analysis}`);
                        drawIndustryChart(res.d.rawData);
                        speak(res.d.analysis);
                        document.getElementById('tutorSection').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        function drawIndustryChart(rawData) {
            if (chartInstance) chartInstance.destroy();
            const ctx = document.getElementById('stockTrendChart').getContext('2d');
            chartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: rawData.map(i => i.industry.replace('電子','電')),
                    datasets: [{ data: rawData.map(i => i.avg_change), backgroundColor: rawData.map(i => i.avg_change > 0 ? '#ff4d4d' : '#2ea043') }]
                },
                options: { indexAxis: 'y', responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { legend: { display: false } } }
            });
        }

        function runBacktest(sId, sName) {
            const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
            $("#tutorSection").removeClass("hidden");
            $("#tutorText").html(`<i class='fas fa-microchip fa-spin'></i> 回測 <b class="text-white">${sName}</b> 歷史數據...`);
            $.ajax({
                type: "POST", url: "StockAI.aspx/GetWinRateAnalysis",
                data: JSON.stringify({ stockId: sId, userApiKey: key }),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                success: function(res) {
                    if(res.d.success) {
                        $("#tutorText").html(`<b class='text-yellow-400'>[${sName} 歷史勝率分析]</b><br>${res.d.analysis}`);
                        speak(res.d.analysis);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // --- 語音輸入邏輯 ---
        const recognition = new (window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition)();
        recognition.lang = 'zh-TW'; recognition.continuous = true;
        recognition.onresult = (e) => {
            let transcript = ''; for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) transcript += e.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (transcript.includes("清除")) $("#userInput").val("");
            else {
                transcript = transcript.replace(/逗號/g, "，").replace(/句號/g, "。");
                $("#userInput").val($("#userInput").val() + transcript);
            }
        };

        function toggleRecord() {
            if (isRecording) { recognition.stop(); $("#recordBtn").removeClass("active"); }
            else { recognition.start(); $("#recordBtn").addClass("active"); }
            isRecording = !isRecording;
        }

        function resetBtn() { $("#aiBtn").prop("disabled", false).html('<i class="fas fa-robot"></i> 啟動 AI 篩選'); }
        function speak(text) { const msg = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text); msg.lang = 'zh-TW'; msg.rate = 1.1; window.speechSynthesis.speak(msg); }
        function loadHistory() { /* 歷史讀取略 */ }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

SQL 欄位錯誤：AI (Gemma) 把「今日/昨日/前日分數」當成了資料庫的實體欄位。事實上，那是我們計算出的別名，過濾條件必須針對實體欄位 `[專家實戰總分]`。 2. 勝率亂碼：AI 回傳了 LaTeX 數學格式（如 `$ \ge $`），導致顯示與朗讀異常。 3. 圖形未出現：這通常是因為 `startTutor` 在切換時，Canvas 的寬度重繪發生衝突。 以下是為您優化後的 v22.0 終極修復版。 --- ### 1. 後端修正：`StockAI.aspx.vb` (精準 SQL 與去亂碼版) 請取代您原本的 `TranslateToSQL1` 與 `CallGemini` 部分。我特別強化了對「專家總分」的過濾邏輯。

// --- 核心修復：解決圖表不見與文字亂碼 ---
function tutorBase(rowData, url, label) {
    const key = $("#geminiKey").val().trim();
    const sName = rowData["股票名稱"] || rowData["名稱"] || "該股";
    const sId = rowData["股票代號"] || rowData["代號"] || "";

    // 1. 顯示面板
    $("#tutorSection").removeClass("hidden");
    $("#tutorText").html(`<i class='fas fa-sync fa-spin'></i> ${label} 正在診斷 <b class="text-white">${sName}</b>...`);
    
    // 2. 停止語音
    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();

    ' --- [修正版] CallOllama1：防止「索引鍵不在字典中」錯誤 ---
    Private Shared Function CallOllama1(ByVal prompt As String) As String
        Dim modelName As String = "gemma4:e4b" 
        Try
            Dim request As HttpWebRequest = CType(WebRequest.Create("http://localhost:11434/api/generate"), HttpWebRequest)
            request.Method = "POST" : request.ContentType = "application/json" : request.Timeout = 120000 ' 延長至 120 秒

            Dim jss As New JavaScriptSerializer()
            Dim body = New Dictionary(Of String, Object) From {{"model", modelName}, {"prompt", prompt}, {"stream", False}}
            
            Using sw As New StreamWriter(request.GetRequestStream())
                sw.Write(jss.Serialize(body))
            End Using

            Using resp As HttpWebResponse = CType(request.GetResponse(), HttpWebResponse)
                Dim resText = New StreamReader(resp.GetResponseStream()).ReadToEnd()
                Dim resObj = jss.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, Object))(resText)
                
                ' 【核心修正】：檢查 Key 是否存在
                If resObj IsNot Nothing AndAlso resObj.ContainsKey("response") Then
                    Return resObj("response").ToString().Trim()
                Else
                    Throw New Exception("Ollama 服務忙碌中，未回傳有效 response，請稍後再試。")
                End If
            End Using
        Catch ex As Exception
            Throw New Exception("連線失敗: " & ex.Message)
        End Try
    End Function

    ' --- [專家選股 1]：Ollama (Gemma) 專用邏輯 - 支援 CTE 連三升與日期跳轉 ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL1(ByVal userSpeech As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 定義資料庫中「絕對真實」的欄位清單 (共 42 欄)
            Dim realCols As String = "[名稱],[代號],[產業分類],[股本億],[盤中現價],[盤中漲幅],[盤中總量],[價五日乖離],[量倍數],[OBV分],[價均分],[技術分],[籌碼分],[量能分],[專家實戰總分],[實戰標籤],[日期],[資使用率],[資使用率黃金交叉次數],[券使用率],[券使用率黃金交叉次數],[券資比],[券資比黃金交叉次數],[站均],[均價黃金交叉次數],[均量黃金交叉次數],[三大法人黃金交叉次數],[外資黃金交叉次數],[投信黃金交叉次數],[k9],[d9],[週k9],[週d9],[月k9],[月d9],[macd],[紅綠棒值],[集中度1日],[集中度5日],[集中度10日],[集中度20日],[集中度60日]"

            ' 2. 建立精準 Prompt：教導 AI 使用 ROW_NUMBER 處理不連續日期
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。請針對 [StockScore] 表寫指令。" &
                "【重要環境】：[日期] 是整數(如 20260612)，會跳過假日。嚴禁使用 DATEADD。" &
                "【任務】：若要找『連三升』或比較『前幾日』，必須使用以下 CTE 模板：" &
                "WITH Ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn FROM StockScore) " &
                "SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 A.* FROM Ranked A " &
                "INNER JOIN Ranked B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.rn = 2 " &
                "INNER JOIN Ranked C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.rn = 3 " &
                "WHERE A.rn = 1 AND A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分 " &
                "【規則】： " &
                "1. SELECT 後必須列出所有欄位：" & realCols & "。 " &
                "2. 產業搜尋必須用：[產業分類] LIKE '%關鍵字%'。 " &
                "3. 嚴禁 Markdown 標籤，只回傳純 SQL 字串。 " &
                "使用者選股需求：" & userSpeech

            ' 3. 呼叫本地 Ollama
            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama1(prompt)
            
            ' --- 4. 【智慧語法修復引擎】 ---
            ' A. 移除常見雜質
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

            ' B. 移除 AI 慣性產生的 DATEADD (若出現則強行修復為子查詢日期)
            If aiSql.Contains("DATEADD") Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Replace("DATEADD(day, -1, (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM StockScore))", "(SELECT DISTINCT TOP 1 日期 FROM StockScore WHERE 日期 < (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM StockScore) ORDER BY 日期 DESC)")
            End If

            ' C. 【關鍵修正】：確保擷取從 WITH 或 SELECT 開始
            ' 解決 AI 前面帶廢話的問題，並確保支援 CTE 語法
            Dim upperSql As String = aiSql.ToUpper()
            Dim startPos As Integer = -1
            
            Dim withIdx As Integer = upperSql.IndexOf("WITH")
            Dim selectIdx As Integer = upperSql.IndexOf("SELECT")

            ' 找到最前面的有效關鍵字位置
            If withIdx <> -1 And selectIdx <> -1 Then
                startPos = Math.Min(withIdx, selectIdx)
            ElseIf withIdx <> -1 Then
                startPos = withIdx
            ElseIf selectIdx <> -1 Then
                startPos = selectIdx
            End If

            If startPos <> -1 Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Substring(startPos)
            End If

            ' D. 欄位別名過濾器 (防止 AI 寫出無效欄位名)
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("今日分數", "[專家實戰總分]").Replace("昨日分數", "[專家實戰總分]").Replace("前日分數", "[專家實戰總分]")

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "轉譯失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function

            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

            ' A. 確保擷取 SQL 起始點
            Dim upperSql As String = aiSql.ToUpper()
            Dim startPos As Integer = If(upperSql.Contains("WITH"), upperSql.IndexOf("WITH"), upperSql.IndexOf("SELECT"))
            If startPos <> -1 Then aiSql = aiSql.Substring(startPos)

            Dim checkCols As String() = {"[名稱]", "[代號]", "[專家實戰總分]", "[日期]"}
            For Each col In checkCols
                If aiSql.Contains(col) And Not aiSql.Contains("A." & col) And Not aiSql.Contains("B." & col) And Not aiSql.Contains("C." & col) Then

                End If
            Next

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception

        End Try
    End Function

vb
    ' --- [專家選股]：解決 DATEADD 溢位與連三升邏輯 ---
    <WebMethod()>
    Public Shared Function TranslateToSQL1(ByVal userSpeech As String) As Object
        Try
            ' 1. 定義標準欄位清單 (全部帶 A. 前綴)
            Dim realCols As String = "A.[名稱],A.[代號],A.[產業分類],A.[股本億],A.[盤中現價],A.[盤中漲幅],A.[盤中總量],A.[價五日乖離],A.[量倍數],A.[OBV分],A.[價均分],A.[技術分],A.[籌碼分],A.[量能分],A.[專家實戰總分],A.[實戰標籤],A.[日期]"

            ' 2. 建立 Prompt：嚴厲禁止 DATEADD，強迫使用 ROW_NUMBER 模板
            Dim prompt As String = "你是一個 T-SQL 專家。請針對 [StockScore] 表寫指令。" &
                "【環境警告】：[日期] 是 YYYYMMDD 整數，嚴禁使用 DATEADD 函數，否則會溢位報錯！ " &
                "【連三升標準模板 (必須照抄)】： " &
                "WITH Ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn FROM StockScore) " &
                "SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM Ranked A " &
                "INNER JOIN Ranked B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.rn = 2 " &
                "INNER JOIN Ranked C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.rn = 3 " &
                "WHERE A.rn = 1 AND A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分 " &
                "【任務】：如果使用者提到『連三升』或『連續三天』，請務必套用上述模板，並根據需求加入其他 WHERE 條件。 " &
                "使用者需求：" & userSpeech

            Dim aiSql As String = CallOllama1(prompt)
            
            ' --- 3. 【智慧語法強制修復】 ---
            aiSql = aiSql.Replace("
sql", "").Replace("
", "").Replace(";", "").Trim()

            ' A. 如果 AI 還是寫了 DATEADD，我們直接「攔截並替換」為正確的保險語法
            If aiSql.ToUpper().Contains("DATEADD") Then
                aiSql = "WITH Ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn FROM StockScore) " &
                        "SELECT DISTINCT TOP 100 " & realCols & " FROM Ranked A " &
                        "INNER JOIN Ranked B ON A.代號 = B.代號 AND B.rn = 2 " &
                        "INNER JOIN Ranked C ON A.代號 = C.代號 AND C.rn = 3 " &
                        "WHERE A.rn = 1 AND A.專家實戰總分 > B.專家實戰總分 AND B.專家實戰總分 > C.專家實戰總分 AND A.專家實戰總分 > 25"
            End If

            ' B. 確保擷取 SQL 起始點
            Dim upperSql As String = aiSql.ToUpper()
            Dim startPos As Integer = -1
            Dim withIdx As Integer = upperSql.IndexOf("WITH")
            Dim selectIdx As Integer = upperSql.IndexOf("SELECT")

            If withIdx <> -1 Then
                startPos = withIdx
            ElseIf selectIdx <> -1 Then
                startPos = selectIdx
            End If

            If startPos <> -1 Then
                aiSql = aiSql.Substring(startPos)
            End If

            Return New With {.success = True, .sql = aiSql}
        Catch ex As Exception
            Return New With {.success = False, .msg = "轉譯失敗: " & ex.Message}
        End Try
    End Function
